meta.title: 六级考纲词汇 79 天计划

ex.en: He had to cancel his flight because the airport was closed by heavy snow.
ex.zh: 由于大雪机场关闭，他只好取消航班。

words.note: cancel 可接 meeting、order；与 call off 近义但更正式。

ex.en: Numerous studies have shown that regular exercise improves both mood and memory.
ex.zh: 众多研究表明，经常锻炼能改善情绪和记忆力。

words.note: numerous 修饰可数复数名词，比 many 正式，多用于书面语。

ex.en: The surgeon explained the operation clearly before the patient signed the form.
ex.zh: 病人在表格上签字前，外科医生清楚地解释了手术。

words.note: sur- 表「外科」；physician 是内科医生，注意区分。

ex.en: Researchers analysed the data for three months before publishing their conclusions.
ex.zh: 研究人员分析了三个月的数据才发表结论。

words.note: 英式拼作 analyse，美式为 analyze；名词形式是 analysis。

words.cn: 突然的；意外的；唐突的；鲁莽的

ex.en: His abrupt departure surprised everyone at the party last night.
ex.zh: 他昨晚突然离席，让聚会上的人都很惊讶。

words.note: ab-（离开）+ rupt（断裂）→ 突然断开，故表「突然的、唐突的」。

ex.en: The new apartment is bright and spacious, with a large balcony.
ex.zh: 新公寓明亮宽敞，还带一个大阳台。

words.note: space + -ious；同根词 spatial 也含「空间」义。

ex.en: She shook her head in disapproval when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 听到这个消息，她不以为然地摇了摇头。

words.note: dis-（否定）+ approval（赞成）；动词是 disapprove of。

words.cn: 自发的；无意识的；自然的；天真率直的

ex.en: The audience broke into spontaneous applause as soon as the singer appeared.
ex.zh: 歌手一出现，观众就自发地鼓起掌来。

words.note: spont-（自愿）+ -aneous；指未经外力促成的「自发」。

words.cn: 遥远的；偏僻的；关系疏远的；脱离的；绝少的；微乎其微的；孤高的；冷淡的

ex.en: People in remote villages still have limited access to medical services.
ex.zh: 偏远村庄的人获得医疗服务的机会仍然有限。

words.note: remote 除「遥远的」，还常说 remote control（遥控器）。

ex.en: We usually have lunch in the cafeteria on the second floor.
ex.zh: 我们通常在二楼的食堂吃午饭。

words.note: cafeteria 多指学校、公司内部的自助食堂，餐厅常用 restaurant。

words.cn: 破裂；破裂；裂开；决裂；断绝

ex.en: The water pipe ruptured last night and flooded the entire basement.
ex.zh: 昨晚水管破裂，整个地下室都被淹了。

words.note: rupt-（断裂）同根词：abrupt、interrupt、erupt、corrupt。

words.cn: 失事；残骸；精神或身体已垮的人；破坏

ex.en: The storm wrecked several boats along the coast within a single night.
ex.zh: 一夜之间，风暴摧毁了沿海的几艘船。

words.note: 口语 a nervous wreck 指精神濒临崩溃的人，并非「残骸」。

words.cn: 未经开发的；未经使用的；未经触动的；处女的；处女；未婚女子

ex.en: Logging is strictly forbidden in this stretch of virgin forest.
ex.zh: 这一片原始森林严禁伐木。

words.note: virgin forest / virgin land 是固定搭配，义为未被开发的。

ex.en: Thousands of families are afflicted with hunger after the long drought.
ex.zh: 长期干旱之后，成千上万个家庭饱受饥饿折磨。

words.note: 常用被动 be afflicted with/by，主语多为疾病、灾难。

ex.en: His mother reproached him for coming home so late again.
ex.zh: 母亲责备他又这么晚回家。

words.note: reproach sb for sth；beyond reproach 意为无可指责。

ex.en: Vegetable prices fluctuated sharply between seasons throughout last year.
ex.zh: 去年蔬菜价格在不同季节间大幅波动。

words.note: fluct-（流动）加 -ate；常与 between、with 连用。

words.cn: 卧车包房；隔间；分隔的空间

ex.en: She put her suitcase in the luggage compartment above the seat.
ex.zh: 她把手提箱放进了座位上方的行李舱。

words.note: com-（共同）+ part（部分）→ 分隔出的小空间。

words.cn: 忧郁的；沮丧的；令人沮丧的；昏暗的；阴沉的

ex.en: The report paints a gloomy picture of the company's financial future.
ex.zh: 这份报告对该公司的财务前景描绘出悲观的景象。

words.note: gloom 原指「阴暗」，引申为情绪低落、前景悲观。

ex.en: The businessman was kidnapped on his way home and held for three days.
ex.zh: 那名商人在回家途中遭绑架，被关押了三天。

words.note: kid（小孩）+ nap（抓走）→ 绑架；过去式为 kidnapped。

words.cn: 授权令；理由；根据；证明…是正当的

ex.en: The police obtained a warrant before searching the suspect's apartment.
ex.zh: 警方在搜查嫌疑人的公寓前取得了搜查令。

words.note: warrant 作名词指「授权令」，作动词指「使…有正当理由」。

ex.en: Please calculate the total cost before you sign the contract.
ex.zh: 签合同之前请先算出总成本。

words.note: calcul-（石子，古人以石子计数）→ 计算；calculator 计算器。

words.cn: 坚持不懈的；执意的；持续的

ex.en: Her persistent efforts finally won her a place at the university.
ex.zh: 她坚持不懈的努力终于为她赢得了大学名额。

words.note: per-（贯穿）+ sist（站立）→ 一直站住不放，故「坚持的」。

ex.en: Only the director can authorize payments above ten thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 只有主管才能批准一万美元以上的付款。

words.note: author（作者、创始人）+ -ize → 授予权力；名词是 authority。

ex.en: He moved to the countryside for the sake of his children's health.
ex.zh: 为了孩子的健康，他搬到了乡下。

words.note: 几乎只用于 for the sake of（为了…）和 for ...'s sake。

ex.en: The speaker paused until the audience stopped talking and settled down.
ex.zh: 演讲者停下来，等观众停止交谈并静下来。

words.note: aud-（听）同根词：audio、audible、auditorium。

ex.en: The whole cast stayed until midnight for the final dress rehearsal.
ex.zh: 全体演员为最后一次彩排留到午夜。

words.note: re-（再）+ hear（听）→ 反复听练，即排练；动词是 rehearse。

words.cn: 以鼻吸气；用力吸入；嗅；闻；吸气；嗅；闻

ex.en: The dog sniffed at the ground and then ran towards the gate.
ex.zh: 狗嗅了嗅地面，然后朝大门跑去。

words.note: sniff at 意为「嗤之以鼻」，sniff out 意为「嗅出、发现」。

ex.en: Her novel offers a vivid narrative of life in a small fishing town.
ex.zh: 她的小说生动地叙述了渔镇生活。

words.note: narr-（讲述）同根词：narrate、narrator、narration。

ex.en: Few candidates possess both the language skills and the patience required.
ex.zh: 很少有应聘者同时具备所需的语言能力和耐心。

words.note: be possessed of 意为「具有」；名词 possession 指所有物。

words.cn: 同时发生；相符；相一致；位置重合；重叠

ex.en: His holiday happened to coincide with the busiest week of the year.
ex.zh: 他的假期恰好赶上一年中最忙的一周。

words.note: co-（共同）+ incide（落下）→ 同时落下，故「同时发生」。

ex.en: The judge must remain neutral while both sides present their arguments.
ex.zh: 双方陈述观点时，法官必须保持中立。

words.note: neutr-（两者皆非）同根词：neuter、neutrality（中立）。

words.cn: 抓；搔；扒；刮擦；刻划；抓痕；划痕；抓；搔；刮

ex.en: They rebuilt the website from scratch after the old system failed.
ex.zh: 旧系统失效后，他们从零开始重建了网站。

words.note: from scratch 意为「从零开始」，是高频固定搭配。

words.cn: 分析；分析报告；分解；解析

ex.en: A careful analysis of the survey revealed two unexpected trends.
ex.zh: 对调查的仔细分析揭示出两个意外的趋势。

words.note: 复数是 analyses；动词 analyse/analyze，注意词形变化。

ex.en: Engineers devised a simple method to cut energy use by half.
ex.zh: 工程师想出一个简单方法，把能耗削减一半。

words.note: devise 侧重设计出方法、方案；与名词 device（装置）区分。

words.cn: 有合作意向的；乐意合作的；合作的；协作的；合作社；合作商店

ex.en: The staff were cooperative and answered every question with patience.
ex.zh: 员工很配合，耐心回答了每一个问题。

words.note: co-（共同）+ operate（操作）→ 合作的；名词是 cooperation。

words.cn: 三部分的；三方的；三倍的；三重的；增至三倍

ex.en: Online sales tripled in three years and now exceed store sales.
ex.zh: 网上销售三年间增长两倍，现已超过门店销售。

words.note: tri-（三）；double 两倍、triple 三倍、quadruple 四倍。

words.cn: 企图抓住；抓紧；紧握；离合器；掌握；控制；把握；抓紧

ex.en: She clutched the railing tightly as the ferry began to rock.
ex.zh: 渡轮开始摇晃时，她紧紧抓住栏杆。

words.note: clutch at straws 意为「抓救命稻草」，表绝望中挣扎。

words.cn: 韧度；心情；情绪；调和；使缓和；回火

ex.en: He lost his temper when the train was delayed for the third time.
ex.zh: 火车第三次晚点时，他发火了。

words.note: lose one's temper 发火，keep one's temper 忍住不发火。

words.cn: 暗中摸索；搜索；探索；搜寻；摸索

ex.en: She groped for the light switch in the dark hallway.
ex.zh: 她在漆黑的走廊里摸索着找电灯开关。

words.note: grope for 意为「摸索着找」；grope in the dark 暗中摸索。

ex.en: The whole village rejoiced when the missing child was found safe.
ex.zh: 失踪的孩子平安找到后，全村人都欢欣鼓舞。

words.note: rejoice at/over sth 为…欣喜；与 joy 同根，多用于书面。

words.cn: 慌乱不安的；发疯似的；发狂的

ex.en: She made a frantic search for her passport before the flight.
ex.zh: 起飞前她发疯似地到处找护照。

words.note: be frantic with worry 表示「急得发疯」，语气很强。

words.cn: 发痒；使发痒；使高兴；逗乐；痒

ex.en: The idea of working abroad tickled his fancy for a while.
ex.zh: 出国工作的念头一度让他心动。

words.note: tickle sb's fancy 意为「使某人动心」，是常见习语。

words.cn: 反对；不赞成；实物；物体；目的；目标；对象；客体；宾语

ex.en: Several residents objected to the plan to build a factory nearby.
ex.zh: 几位居民反对在附近建厂的计划。

words.note: 作动词读 /əbˈdʒekt/；object to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词。

words.cn: 谦逊的；地位低下的；简陋的；使谦恭；使卑下

ex.en: He rose from a humble background to become a respected scientist.
ex.zh: 他出身卑微，后来成为受人尊敬的科学家。

words.note: in my humble opinion 是委婉表达个人意见的常用套语。

ex.en: Clean water is becoming a precious commodity in many dry regions.
ex.zh: 在许多干旱地区，清洁的水正成为珍贵之物。

words.note: com-（共同）+ mod（量度）→ 可交易之物，即商品。

ex.en: The path along the cliff was narrow, wet and dangerously slippery.
ex.zh: 沿悬崖的小路又窄又湿，滑得危险。

words.note: 复数是 cliffs；悬崖边可说 on the edge of a cliff。

ex.en: The dog was well trained and obedient to every simple command.
ex.zh: 这条狗训练有素，对每个简单口令都服从。

words.note: be obedient to sb/sth；动词 obey，名词 obedience。

ex.en: Learning a language demands infinite patience and daily practice.
ex.zh: 学一门语言需要极大的耐心和每日练习。

words.note: in-（不）+ finite（有限的）→ 无限的；finite 是其反义词。

words.cn: 痛苦；苦恼；苦难；悲惨的境遇；贫苦

ex.en: The long war brought misery to millions of ordinary families.
ex.zh: 漫长的战争给数百万普通家庭带来苦难。

words.note: miser-（悲惨）同根词：miserable、miserably。

words.cn: 变模糊；模糊；模糊的东西

ex.en: Tears blurred her vision as she read the letter.
ex.zh: 她读信时，泪水模糊了视线。

words.note: blur 可作动词也可作名词，如 a blur of colours（一片模糊）。

ex.en: A short note will suffice; there is no need for a long report.
ex.zh: 简短说明就够了，不必写长篇报告。

words.note: suffice 常与 for 连用；suffice it to say 是书面套语。

words.cn: 让步；认输；承认；承认…为真；承认失败；允许；让予

ex.en: After two hours of argument, he finally conceded that she was right.
ex.zh: 争论两小时后，他终于承认她是对的。

words.note: concede defeat 认输；concede that... 承认某事为真。

words.cn: 值得注意的；显著的；著名的；名人；要人

ex.en: The town is notable for its old bridge and narrow streets.
ex.zh: 这个小镇以古老的桥和狭窄的街道著称。

words.note: be notable for 意为「因…而著称」，近义词是 famous。

words.cn: 似有道理的；似乎正确的；貌似可信的

ex.en: His explanation sounded plausible, but the facts did not support it.
ex.zh: 他的解释听起来合理，但事实并不支持。

words.note: plaus-（鼓掌）→ 值得喝彩的，故「看似可信的」。

ex.en: The ship crossed the equator early in the morning of the fifth day.
ex.zh: 第五天清早，船越过了赤道。

words.note: equ-（相等）→ 昼夜等长之线，即赤道；同根词 equality。

words.cn: 委任状；委员会；佣金；回扣；授权；委托；委任；委托

ex.en: The artist received a commission to paint a portrait of the mayor.
ex.zh: 这位画家受托为市长画一幅肖像。

words.note: com-（共同）+ miss（送）→ 委托；on commission 抽取佣金。

ex.en: She hurried down the wooden staircase without turning on the light.
ex.zh: 她没开灯就匆匆下了木楼梯。

words.note: stair（楼梯）+ case（箱、容器）→ 整段楼梯。

words.cn: 〈口〉无理的；轻率的；轻浮的；快速翻动；转动；捻掷；轻抛；轻拍

ex.en: He flipped through the magazine while waiting for his train.
ex.zh: 等火车时，他随手翻着那本杂志。

words.note: flip through 意为「快速翻阅」；flip a coin 是掷硬币。

ex.en: It is hard to stay rational when your plans keep failing.
ex.zh: 计划一再失败时，很难保持理性。

words.note: rat-（计算、推理）同根词：rate、ratio、reason。

words.cn: 路障；栅栏；障碍；设路障于；挡住

ex.en: Protesters built a barricade across the road and stopped the traffic.
ex.zh: 抗议者在路上筑起路障，阻断了交通。

words.note: 源自法语，指临时搭起的路障；动词义为「设障阻挡」。

words.cn: 重新开始；继续；恢复；摘要；概要；简历

ex.en: She resumed her studies after a year of working abroad.
ex.zh: 在国外工作一年后，她恢复了学业。

words.note: 作「重新开始」时重音在第二音节；作「简历」时重音在前。

words.cn: 挑衅的；煽动的；刺激的；挑逗的

ex.en: His provocative remarks about the new policy angered many of the listeners.
ex.zh: 他就新政策发表的挑衅性言论激怒了许多听众。

words.note: provoke（激起）+ -ative；provocative 多指故意惹人反应。

ex.en: The committee will meet on Friday to discuss next year's budget.
ex.zh: 委员会将于周五开会讨论明年的预算。

words.note: com + mit + tee，注意双写 t 和 e；committee 是集体名词。

words.cn: 摆出姿势；装模作样；姿势；姿态；看法；态度

ex.en: Sitting at a desk for hours can damage your posture and cause back pain.
ex.zh: 长时间伏案会损害体态并引起背痛。

words.note: posture 可指身体姿势，也可指公开摆出的「姿态、立场」。

words.cn: 盘旋上升；不断急剧地上升；螺旋的；螺旋；螺旋式的上升

ex.en: After the layoffs, the company's losses began to spiral out of control.
ex.zh: 裁员之后，公司的亏损开始急剧失控。

words.note: spiral 由「螺旋」引申为「急剧上升或恶化」，常接 out of control。

words.cn: 微妙的；难以捉摸的；诡秘的；狡诈的；隐约的

ex.en: There is a subtle difference between these two shades of blue.
ex.zh: 这两种蓝色之间有细微的差别。

words.note: subtle 与 slight 都表「细微」，subtle 强调不易察觉；b 不发音。

words.cn: 组成的；构成的；组成部分；部件；组件

ex.en: The new engine has fewer components, so it is cheaper to repair.
ex.zh: 新发动机的零件更少，因此维修费用更低。

words.note: com-（一起）+ pon（放置）+ -ent → 组装在一起的部件。

words.cn: 使受不了；使不知所措；征服；制服

ex.en: She felt overwhelmed by the amount of work before the deadline.
ex.zh: 面对截止日期前的大量工作，她感到不知所措。

words.note: overwhelm 指气势或数量上压过来；overwhelming 表「压倒性的」。

words.cn: 套间；一套家具；套；组；系列

ex.en: They booked a suite on the top floor for their anniversary.
ex.zh: 他们为结婚纪念日在顶层订了一间套房。

words.note: suite 与 sweet 同音；a suite of 指成套的一组事物。

words.cn: 顾问；会诊医师；专科医生

ex.en: The company hired a consultant to improve its customer service.
ex.zh: 公司聘请了一位顾问来改善客户服务。

words.note: consult（咨询）+ -ant（人）→ 顾问；动词 consult 也表「查阅」。

words.cn: 假扮；化装；伪装；掩盖；掩饰；用来伪装的东西；伪装；掩饰

ex.en: The thief entered the building in disguise and left unnoticed.
ex.zh: 窃贼化了装进入大楼，离开时无人察觉。

words.note: in disguise 是固定短语；disguise 作动词重音在第二音节。

ex.en: The museum was once part of the imperial palace of the old dynasty.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆曾属于旧王朝的皇宫。

words.note: imper-（统治）+ -ial；imperial units 指英制单位。

ex.en: Online privacy is only one facet of the wider digital security problem.
ex.zh: 网络隐私只是更广泛的数字安全问题的一个方面。

words.note: facet 原指宝石的「刻面」，引申为事物的「一个方面」。

words.cn: 心胸宽大的；慷慨的；自由的；自由主义的

ex.en: Her parents hold liberal views on education and let her choose her own path.
ex.zh: 她父母在教育上持开明态度，让她自己选择道路。

words.note: liber（自由）+ -al；liberal arts 指人文学科，不是「自由艺术」。

ex.en: He needs surgery on his knee and will be off work for a month.
ex.zh: 他的膝盖需要手术，将停工一个月。

words.note: surgery 指「外科、手术」；英式口语中也指「诊所」。

ex.en: The two communities have lived in harmony for more than a century.
ex.zh: 这两个社区和睦相处已有一百多年。

words.note: harmony 常与 in 连用：in harmony with 表「与…协调」。

words.cn: 暴力引起的；强暴的；猛烈的；剧烈的

ex.en: A violent storm hit the coast last night and damaged several houses.
ex.zh: 昨夜一场猛烈的暴风雨袭击了海岸，损坏了几座房屋。

words.note: violent 既修饰人（暴力），也修饰自然现象（猛烈）；名词 violence。

ex.en: The two sides finally resolved the dispute without going to court.
ex.zh: 双方最终未上法庭就解决了纠纷。

words.note: 表「决心」时后接 to do；表「解决」时比 solve 更正式。

ex.en: We spent the whole evening in a cozy café near the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边一家舒适的小咖啡馆待了一整晚。

words.note: 美式拼 cozy，英式拼 cosy；多指小而温暖的舒适感。

words.cn: 迎面遇到；遭遇；勇敢地面对；正视；使对质；使当面对证

ex.en: Young graduates are often confronted with difficult choices about their future.
ex.zh: 年轻毕业生常常面临关于未来的艰难选择。

words.note: confront 是及物动词；be confronted with 表「面临」。

words.cn: 在…中占首要地位；支配；统治；耸立于；俯视；拥有优势

ex.en: A few large firms dominate the market and set most of the prices.
ex.zh: 少数大公司主导市场，并决定大部分价格。

words.note: domin（主人）+ -ate；指占主导地位，名词 dominance。

ex.en: Young children often imitate the way their parents speak.
ex.zh: 幼儿常常模仿父母说话的方式。

words.note: imitate 直接接宾语，不说 imitate from；名词 imitation。

words.cn: 非常；极度地；致死的；致命的；不共戴天的；极度的；十足的

ex.en: The snake's bite can be deadly if the patient is not treated quickly.
ex.zh: 如果病人得不到及时治疗，这种蛇咬伤可能致命。

words.note: deadly 作形容词表「致命的」，作副词表「极其」，如 deadly serious。

ex.en: The software computes the total cost of the trip in a few seconds.
ex.zh: 该软件几秒钟就算出了这次出行的总费用。

words.note: compute 偏正式、技术性，日常多说 calculate。

ex.en: The university is one of the oldest educational institutions in the country.
ex.zh: 这所大学是该国最古老的教育机构之一。

words.note: institution 兼指「机构」与「制度」，如婚姻制度。

words.cn: 聚集在一起；挤作一团；把身子蜷成一团；蜷缩；使聚集在一起；挤在一起的人；一堆杂乱的东西

ex.en: The children huddled together under the umbrella while the rain poured down.
ex.zh: 大雨倾盆时，孩子们挤在伞下。

words.note: huddle 指因寒冷或害怕而蜷缩、挤在一起，常与 together 连用。

words.cn: 骨骼；框架；骨干；梗概；提要

ex.en: At night the office runs on a skeleton staff of just three people.
ex.zh: 夜间办公室只留三名骨干人员运转。

words.note: a skeleton staff 指维持运转的最少人员；skeleton 也指「框架」。

words.cn: 雄心；抱负；野心；期望得到的东西

ex.en: Her ambition is to become the first woman to lead the firm.
ex.zh: 她的抱负是成为这家公司首位女性掌门人。

words.note: ambition 可褒可贬：抱负或野心；形容词 ambitious。

ex.en: Turn left at the next intersection and the library will be on your right.
ex.zh: 在下一个路口左转，图书馆就在你右边。

words.note: inter-（在…之间）+ sect（切）→ 相交之处、十字路口。

ex.en: The results exceeded all expectations and surprised even the researchers.
ex.zh: 结果超出了所有人的预期，连研究人员都感到惊讶。

words.note: exceed 直接接宾语，不说 exceed more than；名词 excess。

words.cn: 使生效；履行；实施；工具；器具；用具

ex.en: The government plans to implement the new policy early next year.
ex.zh: 政府计划明年年初实施这项新政策。

words.note: implement 作动词重音在首音节；名词是 implementation。

words.cn: 分散；赶散；消散；驱散；使分散；散开；使消散；消失

ex.en: The police asked the crowd to disperse after the concert ended.
ex.zh: 音乐会结束后，警察要求人群散去。

words.note: disperse 与 scatter 近义，disperse 更正式，多指人群散开。

ex.en: Quick action by the pilot averted a serious accident.
ex.zh: 飞行员的果断操作避免了一场严重事故。

words.note: avert 后接灾难类名词表避免；avert one's eyes 是移开视线。

ex.en: He still lives in a fantasy world where everything goes his way.
ex.zh: 他仍活在一切顺他心意的幻想世界里。

words.note: fantasy 指脱离现实的想象；形容词 fantastic 意为「极好的」。

ex.en: The shipment of coffee beans arrived two weeks later than expected.
ex.zh: 这批咖啡豆比预期晚了两个星期到货。

words.note: shipment 兼指「装运」和「所运的货物」；动词是 ship。

words.cn: 恶毒的；凶残的；剧烈的；严重的

ex.en: Cutting prices led to a vicious circle of falling profits.
ex.zh: 降价导致了利润下滑的恶性循环。

words.note: vicious circle 恶性循环，是六级常见固定搭配。

words.cn: 网眼花边；透孔织品；鞋带；系带；用系带束紧

ex.en: She laced up her boots and stepped out into the snow.
ex.zh: 她系好靴子，走进了雪地里。

words.note: lace 作名词指鞋带、花边；作动词常与 up 连用。

ex.en: The project required an enormous amount of time and money.
ex.zh: 这个项目需要投入大量的时间和金钱。

words.note: enorm-（巨大）；enormous 可修饰具体或抽象事物。

ex.en: The report was written by an external expert, not a company employee.
ex.zh: 这份报告由外聘专家撰写，并非公司员工。

words.note: extern-（外部）对应 internal（内部）；也指「外来的」。

words.cn: 华丽的；灿烂的；绚丽的；令人十分愉快的；极好的

ex.en: From the top of the hill we had a gorgeous view of the valley.
ex.zh: 从山顶上，我们看到山谷的绝美景色。

words.note: gorgeous 口语中常表「极好的」，语气比 beautiful 强。

ex.en: Under no circumstances should you leave the door unlocked.
ex.zh: 在任何情况下你都不应不锁门就离开。

words.note: under no circumstances 置于句首时，句子要部分倒装。

words.cn: 官方；权力；当权者；行政管理机构；权威；专家

ex.en: Only the manager has the authority to approve such large payments.
ex.zh: 只有经理有权批准这样的大额付款。

words.note: authority 表权力、权威；the authorities 指官方当局。

words.cn: 腐蚀；侵蚀；磨损；削弱；减少

ex.en: Planting trees along the river helps slow down soil erosion.
ex.zh: 沿河种树有助于减缓水土流失。

words.note: e-（向外）+ ros（咬）→ 逐渐侵蚀掉；动词 erode。

words.cn: 渐渐上升；升高；攀登；登上

ex.en: The balloon slowly ascended into the clear morning sky.
ex.zh: 气球缓缓升入晴朗的晨空。

words.note: a-（向上）+ scend（爬）→ 上升；反义词 descend。

ex.en: You can borrow the car provided that you return it by six.
ex.zh: 你可以借用这辆车，只要你六点前还回来。

words.note: provided (that) 引导条件从句，比 if 更正式。

ex.en: The piano is the only instrument she has ever learned to play.
ex.zh: 钢琴是她唯一学过演奏的乐器。

words.note: instrument 指工具、仪器或乐器；instrumental 表「起作用的」。

words.cn: 中等的；媒质；媒介物；传导体

ex.en: English serves as a medium of communication at many international meetings.
ex.zh: 英语在许多国际会议上是交流媒介。

words.note: medium 复数为 media；a medium-sized 表「中号的」。

ex.en: A good dictionary is indispensable to anyone learning a foreign language.
ex.zh: 一本好词典对学外语的人来说必不可少。

words.note: in-（不）+ dispens（免除）+ -able → 不可或缺；后接 to。

ex.en: He cleaned the lens of his camera before taking the photo.
ex.zh: 拍照前他擦干净了相机的镜头。

words.note: lens 复数 lenses；contact lenses 指隐形眼镜。

words.cn: 代表；表现；体现；包括；包含；收录

ex.en: The old bridge is said to embody the history of the small town.
ex.zh: 据说这座老桥体现了这个小镇的历史。

words.note: em-（使进入）+ body → 使理念具象化、体现。

words.cn: 致命的；灾难性的；毁灭性的；重大的；决定性的

ex.en: One fatal mistake in the experiment destroyed months of careful work.
ex.zh: 实验中一个致命错误毁掉了数月的细致工作。

words.note: fatal 表致命的；fate 是命运，fatal 也可指决定性的。

ex.en: The police could find no motive for the attack.
ex.zh: 警方找不到袭击的动机。

words.note: motive 后接 for 表动机；动词 motivate，形容词 motivated。

ex.en: Few people could envisage such rapid changes in technology.
ex.zh: 很少有人能预见到技术如此迅速的变化。

words.note: envisage 后接名词或动名词，不接 to do；美式常用 envision。

ex.en: Managers continue to wrestle with the problem of staff shortages.
ex.zh: 管理者仍在努力应对人手不足的问题。

words.note: wrestle 作名词指摔跤；wrestle with 引申为竭力应对。

ex.en: Good teachers know how to motivate students to work on their own.
ex.zh: 好老师懂得如何激励学生自主学习。

words.note: motivate sb to do sth；motivated 表「有积极性的」。

words.cn: 微小的；少量的；不重要的；仅以微弱多数票获胜的；记在页边的；有旁注的

ex.en: The new tax made only a marginal difference to most families.
ex.zh: 新税对大多数家庭只产生了微小的影响。

words.note: margin（边缘）+ -al；marginal cost 指边际成本。

words.cn: 变质；损坏；糟蹋；宠坏；溺爱；战利品；掠夺物

ex.en: Heavy rain spoiled our plan for a picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 大雨打乱了我们湖边野餐的计划。

words.note: spoil 过去式有 spoiled 和 spoilt 两种；兼指宠坏与破坏。

ex.en: If you multiply six by four, the answer is twenty-four.
ex.zh: 六乘以四，答案是二十四。

words.note: multiply A by B 表 A 乘以 B；也表「繁殖、增加」。

ex.en: The cows were moved to a new pasture with fresh grass.
ex.zh: 牛群被转移到了一片长着新草的新牧场。

words.note: pasture 指牧草地；greener pastures 引申为更好的去处。

ex.en: The plan cannot go ahead without the approval of the board.
ex.zh: 没有董事会的批准，这个计划无法推进。

words.note: approve of 表赞成；名词 approval 常与 give、win 连用。

words.cn: 运动的；流动的；多变的；移动电话

ex.en: Most students now use a mobile phone instead of a watch to check the time.
ex.zh: 现在多数学生用手机而不是手表看时间。

words.note: mobile phone 是英式说法；美式多直接说 cell phone。

words.cn: 复合的；多重的；多样的；倍数

ex.en: The exam consists of multiple-choice questions and one short essay.
ex.zh: 这场考试由选择题和一篇短文组成。

words.note: multi-（多）+ -ple → 多重的；与 multiply 同源。

ex.en: The exhibition shows the evolution of printing over five centuries.
ex.zh: 展览呈现了印刷术五个世纪以来的演变。

words.note: e-（向外）+ volv（卷）→ 逐渐展开、演变；动词 evolve。

words.cn: 达到高峰；达到最大值；最大值的；高峰的；山顶；顶点；顶峰

ex.en: Hotel prices rise sharply during the peak season in summer.
ex.zh: 夏季旺季时酒店价格大幅上涨。

words.note: peak 指山顶或最高点；at one's peak 表处于最佳状态。

words.cn: 磁铁；磁体；有吸引力的人和事物

ex.en: The old town is a magnet for tourists from all over the world.
ex.zh: 这座老城吸引着世界各地的游客。

words.note: magnet 由磁铁引申为有吸引力的人或地方；magnetic 有磁性的。

words.cn: 全神贯注；全力以赴；集中；聚集；浓缩；浓缩物；浓缩液

ex.en: It is hard to concentrate on reading when the television is on.
ex.zh: 电视开着时很难专心阅读。

words.note: concentrate on 后接名词或动名词；名词 concentration。

ex.en: The report exposed serious weaknesses in the safety system.
ex.zh: 这份报告揭露了安全系统中的严重缺陷。

words.note: expose sb to sth 表使接触、使暴露；名词 exposure。

words.cn: 多才多艺的；有多种技能的；有多种用途的；多功能的；万用的

ex.en: This versatile little tool can cut, open bottles and tighten screws.
ex.zh: 这件多用途小工具可以切割、开瓶和拧螺丝。

words.note: vers-（转）+ -atile → 可多向发展的，即多用途、多才。

words.cn: 以…为对手；对；与…相对；与…相比之下

ex.en: The article compares quality versus quantity in language learning.
ex.zh: 这篇文章比较了语言学习中的质量与数量。

words.note: versus 常缩写成 vs.，用于比较或比赛双方。

ex.en: The hotel received several complaints about the noise from the street.
ex.zh: 酒店收到了几起关于街道噪音的投诉。

words.note: complain 是动词，complaint 是名词，常与 make 连用。

ex.en: Smoking is not permissible anywhere inside the building.
ex.zh: 大楼内任何地方都不允许吸烟。

words.note: per-（通过）+ miss（放行）→ 可允许的；反义 impermissible。

ex.en: Early tests can greatly increase the chances of surviving cancer.
ex.zh: 早期检查能大大提高癌症存活的机会。

words.note: cancer 表疾病时不可数，指种类时可数；形容词 cancerous。

words.cn: 溅；泼；溅泼声；溅出的水；斑点

ex.en: The children splashed water at each other in the pool.
ex.zh: 孩子们在泳池里互相泼水。

words.note: make a splash 引申为引起轰动；splash out 指花钱。

words.cn: 注射；给…注射；注入；引入；投入

ex.en: The nurse injected the vaccine into his arm without any pain.
ex.zh: 护士把疫苗注射到他的手臂里，一点也不疼。

words.note: inject A into B 或 inject B with A，都是正确搭配。

words.cn: 恋爱；恋爱关系；浪漫气氛；传奇色彩；爱情小说；传奇故事

ex.en: Their romance began on a train journey through southern Italy.
ex.zh: 他们的恋情始于一次穿越意大利南部的火车旅行。

words.note: romance 兼指恋情、浪漫气氛与传奇故事；形容词 romantic。

words.cn: 犯规；违法行为；冒犯；得罪

ex.en: He took offense at the joke, though it was meant kindly.
ex.zh: 他对这个玩笑感到不快，尽管对方本是好意。

words.note: take offense at 表因…见怪；英式拼 offence。

ex.en: She found the small island in an old atlas of the Pacific.
ex.zh: 她在一本旧的太平洋地图集里找到了那个小岛。

words.note: atlas 源自希腊神话中托举天空的阿特拉斯。

ex.en: These bacteria are invisible to the naked eye.
ex.zh: 这些细菌肉眼看不见。

words.note: in-（不）+ vis（看）+ -ible → 看不见的。

ex.en: The camera focused on the child playing in the garden.
ex.zh: 相机对焦在花园里玩耍的孩子身上。

words.note: focus 复数可为 focuses 或 foci；focus on 表专注于。

ex.en: Heavy snow hampered rescue efforts in the mountain area.
ex.zh: 大雪阻碍了山区的救援工作。

words.note: hamper 指妨碍进展或行动，常用于救援、调查等语境。

ex.en: We stopped at a roadside motel because the highway was closed.
ex.zh: 因为高速公路封闭，我们在一家路边汽车旅馆过夜。

words.note: motel 由 motor 与 hotel 缩合而成，多建于公路旁。

ex.en: We need a new approach to the problem of traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 我们需要用新方法解决交通拥堵问题。

words.note: an approach to doing sth 中 to 是介词，后接动名词。

ex.en: It is no exaggeration to say that the film changed her life.
ex.zh: 说这部电影改变了她的人生，毫不夸张。

words.note: it is no exaggeration to say 意为毫不夸张地说。

words.cn: 小钉；栓；挂物钉；桩；用钉子钉；用钉固定；限定；将…看成；将…归入

ex.en: The government pegged the price of fuel for six months.
ex.zh: 政府把燃油价格固定了六个月。

words.note: peg 作动词可表固定、限定价格或汇率。

ex.en: It is a common myth that we use only ten percent of our brains.
ex.zh: 我们只用了大脑的百分之十，这是一个常见的错误看法。

words.note: myth 指神话，也常指广为流传的错误看法。

words.cn: 决定性的；坚定的；果断的；决断的

ex.en: Her decisive answer ended the argument at once.
ex.zh: 她果断的回答立刻结束了争论。

words.note: decisive 表决定性的或果断的；名词 decision。

ex.en: Please write a concise summary of the report in no more than two pages.
ex.zh: 请写一份不超过两页的报告摘要。

words.note: concise 强调用词少而清楚；与 brief 近义但更正面。

words.cn: 含意；暗示；暗指；卷入；牵连

ex.en: The decision has serious implications for the future of the industry.
ex.zh: 这一决定对行业的未来有重大影响。

words.note: implication 常用复数表影响、后果，也指暗示。

words.cn: 论文；毕业论文；论题；论点

ex.en: She spent two years collecting data for her doctoral thesis.
ex.zh: 她花了两年时间为博士论文收集数据。

words.note: thesis 复数为 theses；也指文章或演讲的中心论点。

ex.en: I bumped into an old classmate at the railway station yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我在火车站偶然遇到了一位老同学。

words.note: bump into 既表撞上也表偶然遇见，口语常用。

ex.en: She made a reservation at the restaurant for seven o'clock.
ex.zh: 她在餐厅预订了七点的位子。

words.note: make a reservation 是订位、订房的固定说法，动词是 reserve。

ex.en: Government spending helped revive the economy after the long recession.
ex.zh: 政府支出帮助经济在长期衰退后复苏。

words.note: re-（再）+ vive（生命），指重新恢复活力，可用于经济、传统、记忆。

ex.en: The two leaders held a cordial meeting despite their differences.
ex.zh: 尽管存在分歧，两位领导人仍进行了友好的会晤。

words.note: cordial 侧重真诚热情，多形容欢迎、关系、气氛，比 friendly 更正式。

ex.en: The timid boy stood at the back and said nothing.
ex.zh: 那个羞怯的男孩站在后面，一言不发。

words.note: timid 指因缺乏自信而胆怯，与 bold、confident 相对。

ex.en: He showed great loyalty to the company during the crisis.
ex.zh: 危机期间他对公司表现出极大的忠诚。

words.note: loyal 是形容词，be loyal to sb；loyalty 是名词。

words.cn: 不再考虑；解雇；解散；驳回

ex.en: The manager dismissed the suggestion without giving any reason.
ex.zh: 经理没有给出任何理由就否定了这个建议。

words.note: dismiss 主要指“不再考虑”，也可指解雇；名词为 dismissal。

words.cn: 在下面的；含蓄的；潜在的

ex.en: Doctors are still trying to find the underlying cause of her pain.
ex.zh: 医生仍在努力寻找她疼痛的根本原因。

words.note: underlie 是动词“位于…之下、构成…基础”，underlying 为形容词。

words.cn: 改革；改良；改造；改正；改过自新

ex.en: The government promised to reform the tax system within two years.
ex.zh: 政府承诺在两年内改革税制。

words.note: re-（重新）+ form（形式），即重新塑造；作名词常指制度改革。

ex.en: Engineers will install the new equipment next Monday.
ex.zh: 工程师们将于下周一安装新设备。

words.note: install 接设备、软件等；名词 installation 拼写时注意双 l。

words.cn: 接着发生；接踵而来；因而产生

ex.en: A heated argument ensued after the announcement was made.
ex.zh: 消息公布后，随即爆发了一场激烈的争论。

words.note: ensue 为不及物动词，常与 from 连用，表示“由…引起”。

ex.en: There is little indication that prices will fall this year.
ex.zh: 几乎没有迹象表明今年物价会下降。

words.note: indicate 是动词；indication 常接 that 从句或 of 短语。

words.cn: 变得越来越大；使更大；物体；体积；大批

ex.en: The bulk of the students passed the examination easily.
ex.zh: 大部分学生轻松通过了考试。

words.note: the bulk of + 名词表示“大部分”；in bulk 指大批量购买或散装。

words.cn: 公牛；雄兽；买进证券投机图利者；看涨的人

phr.en: take the bull by the horns

ex.en: Investors stayed confident during the long bull market.
ex.zh: 在漫长的牛市中，投资者一直保持信心。

words.note: bull market（牛市）与 bear market（熊市）相对。

words.cn: 冠军；得胜者；捍卫者；拥护者

ex.en: She became world champion at the age of nineteen.
ex.zh: 她十九岁时成为世界冠军。

words.note: champion 作名词指冠军，作动词指拥护、支持某项事业。

ex.en: The kitchen floor is covered with blue ceramic tiles.
ex.zh: 厨房地面铺着蓝色的瓷砖。

words.note: ceramic 作形容词指陶瓷的；复数名词 ceramics 指陶瓷器。

words.cn: 奇怪的；异常的；不舒服的；眩晕的

ex.en: She gave me a queer look and walked away.
ex.zh: 她奇怪地看了我一眼就走开了。

words.note: queer 指奇怪、反常，近义词为 odd、strange，语域偏旧。

words.cn: 接替的人或事物；继任者

ex.en: He was chosen as the successor to the retiring director.
ex.zh: 他被选为那位即将退休董事的继任者。

words.note: successor 后接介词 to；反义词为 predecessor（前任）。

ex.en: The book offers real enlightenment on how children learn languages.
ex.zh: 这本书对儿童如何学习语言提供了真正的启示。

words.note: enlighten 是动词“启发”；大写 the Enlightenment 指启蒙运动。

ex.en: The hotel provides a free booklet about local attractions.
ex.zh: 酒店提供一本介绍当地景点的免费小册子。

words.note: -let 是表示“小”的后缀，如 booklet 小册子、leaflet 传单。

ex.en: From the top of the hill we enjoyed a magnificent view.
ex.zh: 从山顶上我们欣赏到壮丽的景色。

words.note: magnificent 强调宏伟壮丽，语气远强于 good、great。

words.cn: 摇晃；蹒跚；使吃惊；使错开；使交错；蹒跚；踉跄

ex.en: The injured man staggered to his feet and called for help.
ex.zh: 受伤的男子摇晃着站起来呼救。

words.note: stagger 指摇晃着走；be staggered by 表示“对…大为震惊”。

words.cn: 反话；冷嘲；嘲弄；具有讽刺意味的事

ex.en: The irony is that the safety expert was hurt in an accident.
ex.zh: 讽刺的是，那位安全专家在一次事故中受伤了。

words.note: irony 指言语反讽或事情的讽刺意味，形容词为 ironic。

ex.en: The new rules restrict access to the research laboratory.
ex.zh: 新规定限制了研究实验室的进入。

words.note: restrict 常与 to 连用；名词形式是 restriction。

ex.en: The nurse cleaned the cut and put a bandage on it.
ex.zh: 护士清洗了伤口并贴上绷带。

words.note: bandage 作名词指绷带，作动词指用绷带包扎，可及物。

ex.en: The prevalence of online shopping has changed city life.
ex.zh: 网购的普及改变了城市生活。

words.note: prevalent 是形容词“普遍的”；prevalence 多用于疾病、现象。

words.cn: 碎片；碎屑；废金属；残羹剩饭；少量；点滴；废弃；抛弃

ex.en: He wrote the address on a scrap of paper.
ex.zh: 他把地址写在一小片纸上。

words.note: scrap 作名词指碎片、废料，作动词指废弃、取消计划。

words.cn: 综合病症；综合症状；一系列表现

ex.en: Doctors have identified a rare syndrome affecting young children.
ex.zh: 医生已确认一种影响幼儿的罕见综合征。

words.note: syndrome 指一组症状构成的综合征，也喻指某种不良现象。

ex.en: The broken car was towed away by a truck.
ex.zh: 那辆坏了的汽车被卡车拖走了。

words.note: tow away 指把违章或故障车辆拖走；in tow 表示“跟随”。

words.cn: 必要的；紧急的；极重要的；命令的；必要的事；必须完成的事；【语】祈使语气

ex.en: It is imperative that we act before the situation gets worse.
ex.zh: 我们必须在情况恶化之前采取行动。

words.note: it is imperative that 从句用虚拟语气 (should + 原形)。

ex.en: Cows were grazing quietly in the green meadow.
ex.zh: 奶牛在绿色的草地上安静地吃草。

words.note: meadow 指长草的开阔地，多用于乡村、牧场语境。

ex.en: The disease was hitherto unknown in this part of the world.
ex.zh: 这种疾病此前在世界这一地区从未出现过。

words.note: hitherto 意为“迄今”，多修饰形容词，语气正式。

words.cn: 精力充沛的；充满活力的

ex.en: She felt energetic after a good night's sleep.
ex.zh: 睡了一夜好觉后她感到精力充沛。

words.note: energy 是名词，energetic 是形容词，重音在第三音节。

words.cn: 拖；拉；拖运；运送；拖；拉；托运；一次获得的数量

ex.en: Fishermen hauled the heavy nets onto the boat.
ex.zh: 渔民们把沉重的渔网拖上船。

words.note: haul 指用力拖运，常与 up、in 连用；a long haul 喻漫长过程。

words.cn: 有帮助；有益；有用；效用；利益；帮助

ex.en: She availed herself of every chance to practise English.
ex.zh: 她利用每一个机会练习英语。

words.note: avail oneself of 意为利用；to no avail 指毫无效果。

ex.en: He ignored the warning and as a consequence lost his job.
ex.zh: 他无视警告，因此丢了工作。

words.note: consequence 多指不好的结果；as a consequence 意为因此。

words.cn: 线的；直线的；线状的；长度的；线性的

ex.en: The two variables show a clear linear relationship.
ex.zh: 这两个变量呈现出明显的线性关系。

words.note: linear 由 line 加后缀 -ar 构成，指线性的、直线的。

ex.en: The country's economy remained robust despite global uncertainty.
ex.zh: 尽管全球形势不确定，该国经济依然强劲。

words.note: robust 既指身体强健，也指经济、系统稳固有力。

words.cn: 占优势的；支配的；统治的；居高临下的；高耸的

ex.en: The company holds a dominant position in the mobile market.
ex.zh: 这家公司在手机市场占据主导地位。

words.note: dominant 由 dominate 变来，常修饰 position、role。

words.cn: 首要的；首位的；首次的；总理；首相

ex.en: It is widely regarded as the premier university in the country.
ex.zh: 它被普遍认为是该国最顶尖的大学。

words.note: premier 作形容词指首要的，作名词指总理、首相。

words.cn: 剥落；脱皮；削…的皮；剥…的壳；皮；外衣

ex.en: Peel the potatoes and cut them into small pieces.
ex.zh: 把土豆削皮并切成小块。

words.note: peel 指削果皮，也指油漆、皮肤剥落，常与 off 连用。

ex.en: The university attracts students with strong intellectual curiosity.
ex.zh: 这所大学吸引着求知欲强的学生。

words.note: intellectual 作形容词指智力的，作名词指知识分子。

ex.en: Farmers have reclaimed large areas of land from the sea.
ex.zh: 农民们已从大海中开垦出大片土地。

words.note: reclaim 指取回、回收或开垦；re-（回）+ claim（要求）。

ex.en: The government denounced the attack as a violation of international law.
ex.zh: 政府谴责这次袭击违反了国际法。

words.note: denounce 指公开谴责，常用 denounce sth as sth 结构。

ex.en: The company is on the verge of bankruptcy.
ex.zh: 这家公司濒临破产。

words.note: on the verge of 后接名词，表示“即将、濒临”。

ex.en: She bought a fresh pastry and a cup of coffee.
ex.zh: 她买了一块新鲜糕点，还有一杯咖啡。

words.note: pastry 指酥皮糕点；可数时指一块块点心，不可数指面团。

ex.en: The messenger delivered the letter and left at once.
ex.zh: 信使送到信后立刻离开了。

words.note: messenger 由 message 加 -er 变来，指送信的人。

ex.en: A virus can disable your computer within seconds.
ex.zh: 病毒能在几秒内使你的电脑无法运行。

words.note: disable 指使失效或使无能为力，disabled 指残疾的。

ex.en: The job is open to all, irrespective of age or background.
ex.zh: 这份工作对所有人开放，不论年龄或背景。

words.note: irrespective 只与 of 连用，相当于 regardless of。

words.cn: 实体；独立存在体；实际存在物

ex.en: The two companies operate as a single legal entity.
ex.zh: 这两家公司作为一个法律实体运营。

words.note: entity 指独立存在的事物，常见搭配 legal entity（法人）。

ex.en: The law prohibits smoking in all public buildings.
ex.zh: 法律禁止在所有公共建筑内吸烟。

words.note: prohibit 常用 prohibit sb from doing sth 结构。

ex.en: Washing your hands with soap helps remove harmful bacteria.
ex.zh: 用肥皂洗手有助于去除有害细菌。

words.note: bacteria 是复数，单数为 bacterium，谓语用复数。

words.cn: 燃料；燃料剂；给…加燃料；刺激

ex.en: Burning fossil fuels releases large amounts of carbon dioxide.
ex.zh: 燃烧化石燃料会释放大量二氧化碳。

words.note: fuel 作名词指燃料，作动词指刺激、加剧。

ex.en: The proposal met with a hostile reaction from local residents.
ex.zh: 该提议遭到当地居民的强烈反对。

words.note: be hostile to/towards sb 表示对某人有敌意。

words.cn: 当政；统治；占主导地位；君主的统治；君主的统治时期

ex.en: The queen reigned over the country for forty years.
ex.zh: 女王统治这个国家长达四十年。

words.note: reign 指君主统治；与 rein（缰绳）拼写近，别混用。

ex.en: The tempo of life in the village is slow and peaceful.
ex.zh: 这个村庄的生活节奏缓慢而宁静。

words.note: tempo 源自意大利语，指音乐速度或活动节奏。

ex.en: She is a direct descendant of the country's first president.
ex.zh: 她是这个国家首任总统的直系后裔。

words.note: descendant 由 descend（下来）加 -ant 构成，指后代。

ex.en: No one could have foreseen the scale of the disaster.
ex.zh: 没有人能预见到这场灾难的规模。

words.note: foresee 由 fore-（前）+ see（看）构成，指事先预见。

words.cn: 青肿；挫伤；伤痕；擦痕；打青；使受淤伤；挫伤；伤害

ex.en: She fell off her bike and got a bruise on her knee.
ex.zh: 她从自行车上摔下来，膝盖上留下了瘀伤。

words.note: bruise 指碰撞后的青肿，作动词指使受瘀伤。

words.cn: 把…联系在一起；使联合；结合；交往	[ə'səuʃiət]；副的；伙伴；同事

ex.en: People often associate this city with heavy industry.
ex.zh: 人们常把这座城市与重工业联系在一起。

words.note: associate 作动词常接 with；作名词指同事、伙伴。

words.cn: 女礼服；女裙服；长袍；罩衣

ex.en: She wore a long white gown to the ceremony.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件白色的长礼服参加典礼。

words.note: gown 指正式场合的长袍或礼服，如 wedding gown。

ex.en: The baby crawled across the floor towards the door.
ex.zh: 婴儿从地板上爬向门口。

words.note: crawl 指手脚着地爬行，也指车辆缓慢行进。

ex.en: The two copies are identical to the original.
ex.zh: 这两份副本与原版完全相同。

words.note: identical 常接 to，表示“与…完全相同”。

words.cn: 恳求；请求；申诉；答辩；辩护；为…辩护；提出…为理由

ex.en: She pleaded with her parents to let her study abroad.
ex.zh: 她恳求父母让她出国留学。

words.note: plead 指恳求或法庭申辩；plead guilty 意为认罪。

ex.en: He has been waiting for a kidney transplant for two years.
ex.zh: 他已经等了两年，想接受肾移植。

words.note: kidney 指肾脏，常见搭配 kidney disease、transplant。

ex.en: The lights of the city gleamed in the distance.
ex.zh: 城市的灯火在远处闪烁。

words.note: gleam 指微弱闪光，也喻希望、兴趣的闪现。

words.cn: 有抱负的；雄心勃勃的；有野心的

ex.en: The city has announced an ambitious plan to cut pollution.
ex.zh: 该市公布了一项减少污染的宏大计划。

words.note: ambitious 指有雄心的，注意与 ambiguous（含糊的）区分。

words.cn: 学院的；学术的；纯理论的；不切实际的；大学教师

ex.en: Her academic performance improved a lot this term.
ex.zh: 这学期她的学业成绩提高了很多。

words.note: academic 指学术的、学业的，作名词指大学教师。

words.cn: 工作；运行；起作用；功能；职务；【数】函数；重大聚会

ex.en: The spare room now functions as a small office.
ex.zh: 这间备用房间现在用作小办公室。

words.note: function 作动词常与 as 连用，表示“起…作用”。

words.cn: 储备；常用的；常备的；原料；库存品；股本；公债；世系；血统；汤汁；家畜；牲畜

ex.en: The book you want is out of stock at the moment.
ex.zh: 你想要的那本书目前缺货。

words.note: in stock 有存货，out of stock 缺货。

ex.en: He sneaked into the room without making a sound.
ex.zh: 他悄无声息地溜进了房间。

words.note: sneak 指偷偷地走或做，常与 in、out 连用。

words.cn: 无效的；没有的；缺乏的；空虚感；寂寞感；真空；空白；使无效

ex.en: The contract was declared null and void by the court.
ex.zh: 法院宣布该合同无效。

words.note: void 指法律上无效，也指空虚；null and void 为固定搭配。

ex.en: In comparison with last year, prices have risen sharply.
ex.zh: 与去年相比，价格上涨了很多。

words.note: in comparison with 意为与…相比；by comparison 相比之下。

words.cn: 蜂拥而出；洋溢；奔放；汹涌；奔腾；洋溢；奔放；急剧上升；猛增；浪涛般汹涌奔腾

ex.en: There has been a surge in demand for electric cars.
ex.zh: 电动汽车的需求出现了激增。

words.note: surge 指猛增、涌动，常用 a surge in + 名词。

ex.en: I swapped my old phone for a newer model.
ex.zh: 我用旧手机换了一部更新的型号。

words.note: swap 指交换，常用 swap sth for sth。

words.cn: 作为仪式一部分的；例行的；仪式；例行公事；老规矩

ex.en: Making coffee is part of my morning ritual.
ex.zh: 煮咖啡是我早晨例行程序的一部分。

words.note: ritual 指仪式或固定不变的习惯做法，可数名词。

words.cn: 责任；负债；债务；不利条件；起妨碍作用的人

ex.en: The firm accepts no liability for damage to parked cars.
ex.zh: 公司对停放车辆受损不承担责任。

words.note: liability 指法律责任或债务，也指带来麻烦的人或事。

words.cn: 孵出；筹划；舱门；开口；孵化

ex.en: The eggs will hatch in about three weeks.
ex.zh: 这些蛋大约三周后孵化。

words.note: hatch 指小鸟破壳孵化，也指密谋策划。

ex.en: He was a patriot who devoted his life to his country.
ex.zh: 他是一位把一生献给祖国的爱国者。

words.note: patriot 来自希腊语 patris（祖国）；patriotic 爱国的。

words.cn: 发出滴答声；记号；勾号；滴答声；给…标记号

ex.en: Please tick the box next to your answer.
ex.zh: 请在答案旁的方框内打勾。

words.note: tick 指打勾或发出滴答声；tick the box 打勾。

ex.en: The team meets on a regular basis to discuss progress.
ex.zh: 团队定期开会讨论进展。

words.note: on the basis of 意为根据；on a ... basis 表方式。

words.cn: 当…导师；当…家庭教师；导师；家庭教师；私人教师

ex.en: She works as a private tutor in the evenings.
ex.zh: 她晚上做私人家庭教师。

words.note: tutor 指个别辅导的教师，作动词常接 in。

ex.en: The senator spoke in favour of the new education bill.
ex.zh: 这位参议员发言支持新的教育法案。

words.note: senator 指参议员，senate 指参议院。

ex.en: The team won the cup for the third successive year.
ex.zh: 该队连续第三年赢得奖杯。

words.note: successive 指连续的；successful 指成功的。

ex.en: It is difficult to quantify the effect of the new policy.
ex.zh: 新政策的影响难以量化。

words.note: quantify 由 quantity（数量）变来，指确定数量。

words.cn: 使协调；使和解；使顺从；使甘心

ex.en: It is hard to reconcile these two conflicting views.
ex.zh: 很难使这两种相互冲突的观点协调起来。

words.note: reconcile 指使和解或使一致，be reconciled to 接受。

words.cn: 吸引；引起…的兴趣；引诱；诱惑

ex.en: I was tempted to buy the expensive coat but walked away.
ex.zh: 我很想买那件昂贵的大衣，但还是走开了。

words.note: tempt 指引诱、吸引；be tempted to do 表示很想做。

ex.en: The company has a legal obligation to protect customer data.
ex.zh: 该公司有保护客户数据的法律义务。

words.note: obligation 指法律或道义上的义务，比 duty 更强调约束。

ex.en: The novel is now available in paperback at most bookshops.
ex.zh: 这部小说现在在多数书店都能买到平装本。

words.note: paperback 指平装本，与 hardback（精装本）相对。

ex.en: The story is about the struggle between good and evil.
ex.zh: 这个故事讲的是善与恶的斗争。

words.note: evil 作形容词指邪恶的，作名词指邪恶、祸害。

ex.en: Such mistakes are rarely seen in professional writing.
ex.zh: 这类错误在专业写作中很少见。

words.note: rarely 是否定副词，置于句首要部分倒装。

words.cn: 鹰；隼；“鹰派”人物；叫卖；兜售

ex.en: The coach watched the young players like a hawk during the whole match.
ex.zh: 整场比赛中，教练像鹰一样紧盯着年轻球员。

words.note: hawk 作动词指沿街叫卖；watch sb like a hawk 表严密监视。

words.cn: 缠绕；盘绕；转动；旋动；捻；搓；歪曲；曲解；扭歪；扭伤；曲折前进；转身；扭弯；转折；转变；弯曲；曲折处

ex.en: She twisted her ankle while running down the stairs this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上她跑下楼梯时扭伤了脚踝。

words.note: twist one's ankle 指崴脚；twist 也可指转折。

words.cn: 即将到来的；可得到的；乐于提供消息的

ex.en: The minister was not forthcoming about his plans for the coming year.
ex.zh: 部长不愿透露他来年的计划。

words.note: forthcoming 除「即将到来」，还指人「乐于提供信息」，多用于否定句。

words.cn: 爱国的；有爱国心的；显示爱国精神的

ex.en: The old soldiers sang patriotic songs at the memorial ceremony.
ex.zh: 老兵们在纪念仪式上唱起了爱国歌曲。

words.note: patriot 是爱国者，-ic 构成形容词，patriotism 指爱国主义。

ex.en: The surgery went well, but the patient later developed a serious complication.
ex.zh: 手术很顺利，但病人后来出现了严重的并发症。

words.note: complication 医学上指「并发症」；动词是 complicate。

words.cn: 使困惑；使费解；使复杂化

ex.en: The students were perplexed by the question and asked for a hint.
ex.zh: 学生们被这道题难住了，请求给点提示。

words.note: perplex 与 confuse 近义，常用 be perplexed by。

words.cn: 战争；斗争；格斗；与…斗争；与…战斗

ex.en: The government has promised to spend more money on combating pollution.
ex.zh: 政府承诺投入更多资金治理污染。

words.note: combat 作动词重音在后 /kəmˈbæt/，作名词重音在前；常表示与不良事物斗争。

ex.en: She despised him for lying to his own parents.
ex.zh: 她因他对自己的父母撒谎而看不起他。

words.note: despise 语气强，指轻蔑地看不起，与 hate 的单纯厌恶略有不同。

ex.en: The city plans to levy a tax on empty houses.
ex.zh: 这座城市计划对空置房屋征税。

words.note: levy a tax on 是固定搭配；levy 作名词时指征收的税款。

words.cn: 沉溺；纵容自己；肆意从事；使沉溺于；满足；纵容；迁就

ex.en: He rarely indulges in expensive meals, even on his birthday.
ex.zh: 即使在生日，他也难得吃顿昂贵的大餐。

words.note: indulge in 接名词或动名词；indulge a child 指纵容孩子。

ex.en: The witness said she had been intimidated into keeping silent.
ex.zh: 证人说她受到恐吓而保持沉默。

words.note: intimidate sb into doing 是常用结构；强调以威胁使人害怕而屈从。

ex.en: The new drug proved highly effective against the virus.
ex.zh: 这种新药被证明对这种病毒非常有效。

words.note: effective 指有效果，efficient 指效率高，两者常被混用，注意区分。

words.cn: 单一；统一；团结；和睦；协调

ex.en: The crisis brought a sense of unity to the small community.
ex.zh: 这场危机让这个小社区产生了团结感。

words.note: unit 是单位，unite 是联合，unity 指团结统一的状态。

words.cn: 继续；从事；追赶；追踪；追求

ex.en: She moved to another city to pursue a career in design.
ex.zh: 她搬到另一座城市去从事设计工作。

words.note: pursue 常接 career、dream；名词是 pursuit。

words.cn: 粗野的；下流的；庸俗的；粗俗的

ex.en: He told a vulgar joke that made everyone at the table uncomfortable.
ex.zh: 他讲了个粗俗的笑话，让在座的人都不自在。

words.note: vulgar 指言语举止粗俗下流；口语中 cheap 有相近义，但语气较轻。

ex.en: The flood was the worst catastrophe the region had seen in decades.
ex.zh: 这场洪水是该地区几十年来最严重的灾难。

words.note: cata- 表「向下」，strophe 表「转」，原指剧情突转，现指大灾难。

ex.en: Words alone cannot convey how grateful I am for your help.
ex.zh: 单靠言语无法表达我对你帮助的感激。

words.note: convey 可指传递信息、表达感情或运送，比 tell 更书面。

words.cn: 设计；预定；指定；设计；构想；图样；企图

ex.en: The course is designed to help students write clear reports.
ex.zh: 这门课旨在帮助学生写出清楚的报告。

words.note: by design 意为故意，反义是 by accident。

ex.en: He is generous with his time and often helps younger colleagues.
ex.zh: 他很舍得花时间，经常帮助年轻同事。

words.note: generous with 指在某方面大方；generous to sb 指对某人慷慨。

ex.en: By coincidence, we booked seats on the same flight.
ex.zh: 碰巧我们订了同一班飞机的座位。

words.note: by coincidence 是固定短语；动词 coincide 指同时发生或相一致。

ex.en: Many small shops fell victim to the sudden rise in rent.
ex.zh: 许多小店成了租金暴涨的受害者。

words.note: fall victim to 中不加冠词；victim 常与 of 连用。

words.cn: 爆裂；坏掉；打破；打碎；胸像；半身像；胸部；胸围

ex.en: The airline went bust after the sudden drop in passengers.
ex.zh: 客流量骤降后，这家航空公司破产了。

words.note: go bust 是口语说法，指生意破产；bust 也指半身像或警方的突击搜查。

ex.en: He fell from the ladder and suffered a fractured skull.
ex.zh: 他从梯子上摔下来，颅骨骨折。

words.note: skull 指整个头骨，brain 是大脑；fractured skull 是常见搭配。

words.cn: 情绪异常激动的；歇斯底里般的

ex.en: She became hysterical when she heard the news of the accident.
ex.zh: 听到事故的消息，她变得歇斯底里。

words.note: hysterical 形容情绪失控；hysterical laughter 指狂笑。

ex.en: The driver changed lanes without signalling and nearly caused a crash.
ex.zh: 那名司机没打灯就变道，差点造成撞车。

words.note: lane 指车道或乡间小路；change lanes 是变道，注意用复数。

ex.en: The river was contaminated with waste from the nearby factory.
ex.zh: 这条河被附近工厂的废料污染了。

words.note: contaminate 强调有害物混入水源、食物等；名词是 contamination。

ex.en: The soldiers were running low on ammunition after two days of fighting.
ex.zh: 打了两天，士兵们的弹药快用完了。

words.note: ammunition 不可数；give sb ammunition 指给对方把柄。

words.cn: 主要的；为首的；总的；首领；长官；酋长；族长

ex.en: The chief reason for his failure was a lack of preparation.
ex.zh: 他失败的主要原因是准备不足。

words.note: chief 作形容词只作定语；也可作名词指首领。

words.cn: 相符合；相一致；相和谐；授予；赠与；给予；一致；符合；谅解；协议

ex.en: Her account is in accord with what the other witnesses said.
ex.zh: 她的说法与其他证人的说法一致。

words.note: of one's own accord 意为自愿；in accord with 表一致。

words.cn: 最好的；最著名的；最重要的

ex.en: She is one of the country's foremost experts on climate change.
ex.zh: 她是该国最著名的气候变化专家之一。

words.note: first and foremost 意为首要的是；只作定语。

words.cn: 自动的；必然发生的；无意识的；自动机械

ex.en: My automatic response was to say sorry, even though I had done nothing wrong.
ex.zh: 我下意识地说了声抱歉，尽管我并没有做错。

words.note: automatic 还指无意识的本能反应；副词是 automatically。

ex.en: Despite the heavy rain, the match went on as planned.
ex.zh: 尽管下着大雨，比赛仍按计划进行。

words.note: despite 是介词，接句子要用 despite the fact that。

ex.en: Prices have risen for three consecutive years, worrying many families.
ex.zh: 物价连续三年上涨，令许多家庭担忧。

words.note: consecutive 只作定语；口语连续几天说 in a row。

words.cn: 探索；查究；调查；用探针探查；探测；探针；探测器；探索；调查

ex.en: The police have launched a probe into how the documents were leaked.
ex.zh: 警方已就文件如何泄露展开调查。

words.note: probe into 指深入调查；probe 也指探测器。

ex.en: The assimilation of new arrivals takes time and often meets resistance.
ex.zh: 新来者的同化需要时间，且常遇阻力。

words.note: assimilate 是动词；assimilation 也指知识的吸收。

words.cn: 呻吟；抱怨；发出呻吟般的声音；呻吟；抱怨；呻吟般的声音

ex.en: He groaned with pain as the nurse cleaned the wound.
ex.zh: 护士清洗伤口时，他痛得呻吟起来。

words.note: groan 指低沉呻吟，多因痛苦；moan 语气更弱。

ex.en: The town grew quickly during the industrial boom of the 1950s.
ex.zh: 在二十世纪五十年代的工业繁荣中，这座城镇迅速发展。

words.note: industrial 指工业的；industrious 指人勤勉，勿混。

words.cn: 举止；行为；指导；管理；实施	[kən'dʌkt]；进行；管理；指挥；引导；传输；传导

ex.en: The students conducted a survey on how people spend their weekends.
ex.zh: 学生们就人们如何过周末做了一项调查。

words.note: 名词重音在前，动词在后；conduct a survey 是常用搭配。

ex.en: The actress wore a deep blue velvet dress to the ceremony.
ex.zh: 那位女演员穿着深蓝色天鹅绒长裙出席典礼。

words.note: velvet 不可数，作定语直接修饰名词，如 velvet dress。

ex.en: The study combines quantitative data with interviews of local farmers.
ex.zh: 这项研究把定量数据与对当地农民的访谈结合起来。

words.note: quantitative 指定量，qualitative 指定性，成对记忆。

words.cn: 稳定的；不变的；沉稳的；持重的；厩；马厩；牛棚

ex.en: The patient's condition has remained stable since the operation.
ex.zh: 手术后病人的病情一直保持稳定。

words.note: stable 作形容词指稳定，作名词指马厩；名词 stability。

words.cn: 重聚；团聚；聚会；联谊活动

ex.en: The family reunion brought together relatives who had not met for years.
ex.zh: 家庭团聚让多年未见的亲戚聚在一起。

words.note: re- 表「再」+ union 表「联合」，故为团聚。

words.cn: 极好的；极出色的；了不起的；极大的；难以相信的；异想天开的；不实际的；奇异的；古怪的

ex.en: You look fantastic in that jacket, and the colour suits you.
ex.zh: 你穿那件夹克真好看，颜色也很适合你。

words.note: fantastic 口语常表极好；也可指荒诞不实的。

words.cn: 排水系统；下水道；排水；放水

ex.en: Heavy rain flooded the streets because the drainage system was blocked.
ex.zh: 大雨淹了街道，因为排水系统堵塞了。

words.note: drain 是动词排水，drainage 是名词，指排水系统。

words.cn: 回答；答复；作出反应；响应

ex.en: The company responded to the complaints by changing its refund policy.
ex.zh: 公司通过修改退款政策来回应这些投诉。

words.note: respond 不及物，接宾语用 respond to；名词 response。

ex.en: The flight landed safely, and the whole trip passed without incident.
ex.zh: 航班安全降落，整个旅程平安无事。

words.note: incident 指偶发事件，多不愉快；accident 指意外。

words.cn: 跛的；瘸的；站不住脚的；差劲的；蹩脚的

ex.en: He gave a lame excuse for missing the deadline again.
ex.zh: 他又一次错过了截止日期，还给了个站不住脚的借口。

words.note: lame 本义瘸的，引申指借口理由站不住脚。

words.cn: 桶；塑料杯；纸杯；盆；洗澡盆；浴缸

ex.en: She soaked in a hot tub after the long hike.
ex.zh: 长途徒步后，她泡了个热水浴缸。

words.note: tub 指桶、盆或浴缸；a tub of 可作量词。

words.cn: 群集；丛生；串；簇；群；组；使群集；集中

ex.en: A cluster of small shops has grown up around the new station.
ex.zh: 新车站周围开起了一小片商店。

words.note: cluster 指同类事物聚成一簇，动词常接 around。

words.cn: 捕食；折磨；使烦恼；被捕食的动物；捕获物；受害者

ex.en: Elderly people often fall prey to telephone scams.
ex.zh: 老年人常常成为电话诈骗的受害者。

words.note: fall prey to 中 prey 前不加冠词；prey on 指捕食。

words.cn: 器械；器具；仪器；机构；组织

ex.en: The lab bought new apparatus for measuring air quality.
ex.zh: 实验室购买了测量空气质量的新仪器。

words.note: apparatus 单复数同形；计量用 a piece of apparatus。

ex.en: He was promoted to lieutenant after three years of service.
ex.zh: 服役三年后，他被提升为中尉。

words.note: 英式发音中 f 音特殊；lieutenant 也可比喻副手。

ex.en: The little boy kept tugging at his mother's sleeve.
ex.zh: 小男孩不停地拽他妈妈的袖子。

words.note: tug at 指反复用力拉；tug 也指拖船。

words.cn: 旅行；远征；远征队；探险队；考察队；迅速；动作敏捷

ex.en: The team set off on an expedition to the Arctic last spring.
ex.zh: 去年春天，这支队伍出发去北极探险。

words.note: expedition 指有组织的考察；expedite 是加快，勿混。

words.cn: 腐烂；衰败；腐烂；衰败状态

ex.en: Sugar left on the teeth speeds up tooth decay.
ex.zh: 留在牙齿上的糖分会加速蛀牙。

words.note: decay 不及物，指逐渐腐烂衰败；tooth decay 固定。

words.cn: 感到悲痛；伤心；使伤心；为…而伤心

ex.en: She continues to grieve for her father, who died last winter.
ex.zh: 她仍在为去年冬天去世的父亲悲伤。

words.note: grieve for sb 表为失去的人悲伤；名词是 grief。

words.cn: 吸收；吸引…的注意；使全神贯注；把…并入；同化

ex.en: He was so absorbed in his book that he missed the stop.
ex.zh: 他太专注于看书，结果坐过了站。

words.note: be absorbed in 表全神贯注；absorb 本义吸收。

words.cn: 关切的事；有关的事；关心；挂念；关系；关联；公司；企业；涉及；有关；使关心；使担心

phr.en: as far as sth is concerned

ex.en: Parents are increasingly concerned about the time children spend online.
ex.zh: 家长们越来越担心孩子上网的时间。

words.note: concerned 表担心的，concerning 表关于，注意区分。

words.cn: 断裂；折断；裂缝；裂痕；折断

ex.en: The X-ray showed a small fracture in his left wrist.
ex.zh: 爱克斯光片显示他左手腕有一处小骨折。

words.note: fracture 比 break 正式，多用于医学；名词同形。

ex.en: The bank promised to rectify the mistake in my account immediately.
ex.zh: 银行承诺立即纠正我账户上的错误。

words.note: rectify 比 correct 正式，多用于错误、问题。

words.cn: 正直；诚实；诚恳；完整；完全；完善

ex.en: She is respected for her honesty and integrity at work.
ex.zh: 她因工作中的诚实正直而受人尊敬。

words.note: integrity 兼指正直与完整，后者见 territorial integrity。

words.cn: 抑制；克制；戒除；叠句；副歌

ex.en: Please refrain from using your phone during the performance.
ex.zh: 演出期间请勿使用手机。

words.note: refrain from 后接动名词，是正式用语。

ex.en: The two countries signed a pact to protect shared rivers.
ex.zh: 两国签署协定，共同保护共有的河流。

words.note: pact 多指国家或团体间的正式协定。

ex.en: The composer wrote the piece using a notation of his own invention.
ex.zh: 作曲家用了自己发明的记谱法来写这首曲子。

words.note: notation 指符号体系，如 musical notation。

ex.en: The two banks merged last year to cut costs.
ex.zh: 两家银行去年合并以削减成本。

words.note: merge 常接 with 或 into；名词 merger 指公司合并。

ex.en: Such old bridges are liable to collapse in an earthquake.
ex.zh: 这样的旧桥在地震中容易坍塌。

words.note: be liable to do 表易于；be liable for 表负责任。

ex.en: Our school recycles paper and plastic bottles every week.
ex.zh: 我们学校每周回收纸张和塑料瓶。

words.note: re- 表再 + cycle 循环；recyclable 是可回收的。

words.cn: 靠码头；进港；码头；船埠；被告席；使靠码头；扣

ex.en: The ship docked at the port just before sunset.
ex.zh: 船在日落前靠了港。

words.note: dock 作动词指船靠码头；at the dock 在码头。

ex.en: Thousands of birds nest in the salt marshes along this coast.
ex.zh: 成千上万的鸟在这片海岸的盐沼里筑巢。

words.note: marsh 指常年积水的低湿地；salt marsh 是固定说法。

words.cn: 成分；要素；元素；基础；纲要；自然力

ex.en: Trust is a key element of any successful partnership.
ex.zh: 信任是任何成功合作的关键要素。

words.note: element 指构成整体的要素；be in one's element 表得心应手。

words.cn: 秘密的；机密的；表示信任的；担任机密工作的

ex.en: All personal details will be kept strictly confidential.
ex.zh: 所有个人信息将被严格保密。

words.note: confident 是有信心，confidential 是机密的，勿混。

words.cn: 丰富的；富裕的；大量的；充足的

ex.en: There is abundant evidence that exercise lowers stress.
ex.zh: 有大量证据表明锻炼能减轻压力。

words.note: abundant 接不可数或复数名词；be abundant in 表盛产。

ex.en: She exclaimed in surprise when she saw the size of the cake.
ex.zh: 看到蛋糕那么大，她惊讶地叫了起来。

words.note: exclaim 指因强烈情绪喊出，常接 in surprise。

words.cn: 芭蕾舞；芭蕾舞剧；芭蕾舞团

ex.en: She has studied ballet since she was five years old.
ex.zh: 她从五岁起就学习芭蕾舞。

words.note: ballet 的 t 不发音；a ballet 可指一部舞剧。

words.cn: 缄默的；无声的；哑的；不会说话的；不发音的；消除；减轻

ex.en: She remained mute throughout the meeting, refusing to answer.
ex.zh: 整场会议她一言不发，拒不作答。

words.note: mute 指不发声；mute the sound 意为消音。

words.cn: 谦恭有礼；有礼貌的举止

ex.en: It is common courtesy to thank the host before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前向主人道谢是基本的礼貌。

words.note: courtesy 比 politeness 正式；by courtesy of 表承蒙。

ex.en: His health deteriorated rapidly after he stopped taking the medicine.
ex.zh: 停药后，他的健康状况迅速恶化。

words.note: deteriorate 不及物；名词是 deterioration。

ex.en: The goods were moved to a warehouse outside the city.
ex.zh: 货物被运到城外的一座仓库。

words.note: ware 指货物，house 指房屋，warehouse 指仓库。

words.cn: 认出；识别；承认；确认；认可；赏识；表彰；报偿

ex.en: I hardly recognized her after so many years.
ex.zh: 这么多年过去，我几乎认不出她了。

words.note: recognize 指认出或承认；recognize sb as 表承认身份。

words.cn: 抑制；限制；克制；约束措施；约束条件

ex.en: The police showed great restraint in dealing with the crowd.
ex.zh: 警方在处理人群时表现出极大的克制。

words.note: restraint 指克制或限制；动词 restrain 常接 from。

ex.en: Factories along the river release pollutants into the water every day.
ex.zh: 沿河的工厂每天向水中排放污染物。

words.note: pollutant 可数；pollute 是动词，pollution 是名词。

ex.en: Pandas spend most of the day eating bamboo.
ex.zh: 熊猫一天中大部分时间都在吃竹子。

words.note: bamboo 不可数，作定语用单数，如 bamboo shoots。

words.cn: 输入；投入的资金；输入的数据；把…输入计算机

ex.en: We welcome input from everyone before the plan is final.
ex.zh: 计划定稿前，我们欢迎所有人提意见。

words.note: input 指意见或数据时不可数；过去式也可用 inputted。

ex.en: Nothing could induce him to change his mind about leaving.
ex.zh: 什么也不能促使他改变离开的主意。

words.note: induce sb to do 表劝诱；也可指引起某状态。

ex.en: The doctor found nothing abnormal in the test results.
ex.zh: 医生在检查结果中没发现任何异常。

words.note: ab- 表偏离，normal 表正常，故为反常的。

ex.en: She made a shrewd guess about what the manager would decide.
ex.zh: 她对经理会如何决定作出了敏锐的猜测。

words.note: shrewd 褒义，指精明有眼光，比 clever 更实际。

words.cn: 陈规；老套；固定的模式；对…形成固定看法

ex.en: The film challenges the stereotype that engineers lack social skills.
ex.zh: 这部电影挑战了工程师缺乏社交能力这一刻板印象。

words.note: stereotype 常与 challenge、break 连用。

ex.en: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
ex.zh: 一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成。

words.note: molecule 是分子，atom 是原子；形容词 molecular。

ex.en: More than three hundred students enrolled in the evening course.
ex.zh: 三百多名学生报名了这门晚间课程。

words.note: 英式拼作 enrol，美式 enroll；后接 in。

words.cn: 辞职；听任；辞去；放弃；使顺从

ex.en: He resigned from the board after the scandal became public.
ex.zh: 丑闻公开后，他从董事会辞职。

words.note: resign from 表辞去职务；be resigned to 表无奈接受。

words.cn: 保护；维护；预防措施；保证条款

ex.en: New laws were introduced to safeguard the personal data of ordinary users.
ex.zh: 新法律出台，以保护普通用户的个人数据。

words.note: safe 加 guard 即安全守卫，多接 rights、data 等抽象宾语。

ex.en: She was a diligent student who reviewed her notes every evening after class.
ex.zh: 她是个勤奋的学生，每天课后都会复习笔记。

words.note: diligent 指长期认真刻苦，近义 hard-working，反义 lazy。

words.cn: 老于世故的；高级的；精密的；复杂的；高雅的

ex.en: This laboratory uses sophisticated equipment to analyse tiny samples of rock.
ex.zh: 这个实验室用精密设备分析微小的岩石样本。

words.note: 既指设备精密复杂，也指人老练，如 a sophisticated audience。

words.cn: 娱乐；文娱节目；表演会；招待；款待；请客

ex.en: The small town offers little entertainment for young people on weekday evenings.
ex.zh: 这个小镇在工作日的晚上没多少给年轻人的娱乐。

words.note: 可指抽象的娱乐，也可指具体文娱节目；动词是 entertain。

ex.en: Her family has resided in this coastal village for more than a century.
ex.zh: 她的家族在这个海边村庄居住了一个多世纪。

words.note: reside 比 live 正式；reside in 还可表示性质、权力存在于某处。

words.cn: 标示的；指示的；象征的；陈述的；【语】陈述语气

ex.en: The sudden drop in sales is indicative of a wider problem in the market.
ex.zh: 销售额骤降表明市场存在更大范围的问题。

words.note: 固定搭配 be indicative of sth，多用于书面语。

ex.en: The nurses on the hospital ward checked every patient twice during the night.
ex.zh: 病房里的护士夜里查了每位病人两次。

words.note: ward 作病房讲最常见；ward off 意为避开、防止。

words.cn: 担忧；忧虑；惧怕；担忧；畏惧

ex.en: Many students dread speaking in public more than taking written exams.
ex.zh: 许多学生害怕当众讲话甚于笔试。

words.note: dread 后多接动名词，不接 to do；形容词 dreadful 表示可怕的。

ex.en: The company's accounts came under close scrutiny after the scandal broke.
ex.zh: 丑闻曝光后，该公司的账目受到严密审查。

words.note: 多与 come under 连用，表示受到严密审查；动词 scrutinize。

ex.en: The dog chased the ball across the field and brought it back.
ex.zh: 狗在草地上追着球跑，又把球叼了回来。

words.note: chase 后可直接接宾语，也可用 chase after；pursue 更正式。

ex.en: He broke his arm in a traffic accident on his way to work.
ex.zh: 他在上班路上的一场交通事故中摔断了胳膊。

words.note: by accident 意为偶然，不是交通事故；反义表达是 on purpose。

words.cn: 促进；增进；发扬；提升；宣传；推销

ex.en: The new manager was promoted to head of department after only two years.
ex.zh: 这位新经理仅两年后就被提升为部门主管。

words.note: promote 表晋升时常用 be promoted to；名词 promotion。

words.cn: 例行的；常规的；例行公事；惯例；惯常的程序

ex.en: Regular exercise soon became part of his daily routine.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼很快成了他日常安排的一部分。

words.note: routine 作形容词表例行的，作名词表惯例、固定程序。

ex.en: The old man survived a heart attack last winter thanks to quick treatment.
ex.zh: 多亏抢救及时，这位老人去年冬天心脏病发作后活了下来。

words.note: attack 也指疾病突然发作，如 a heart attack。

words.cn: 离婚；离异；离婚；分离；脱离

ex.en: The couple decided to get a divorce after twenty years of marriage.
ex.zh: 这对夫妻结婚二十年后决定离婚。

words.note: divorce 可作名词也可作动词；be divorced from 还能喻指脱离。

words.cn: 关税；税率；价目表；收费表

ex.en: The government imposed high tariffs on imported steel to protect local factories.
ex.zh: 政府对进口钢材征收高关税以保护本地工厂。

words.note: tariff 多指关税，也可指价目表，如 the hotel tariff。

words.cn: 缚；系；贴；附加；使依恋；使喜爱；使附属；认为有

ex.en: Please attach your CV to the email before you send the application.
ex.zh: 发送申请前，请把简历附在邮件里。

words.note: attach importance to 是六级高频搭配，名词 attachment。

words.cn: 生动的；形象的；绘画的；文字的；图表的

ex.en: The witness gave a graphic account of the accident that shocked the court.
ex.zh: 目击者对事故作了生动的描述，令法庭震惊。

words.note: graphic 由图画引申为生动逼真的，如 graphic description。

words.cn: 证明…有罪；宣判…有罪['kɒnvɪkt]；囚犯

ex.en: The jury convicted him of fraud and he was sentenced to five years.
ex.zh: 陪审团判他犯有诈骗罪，他被判处五年徒刑。

words.note: 动词重音在第二音节；名词囚犯重音在第一音节。

ex.en: Regular review improves memory retention far more than reading alone.
ex.zh: 定期复习对记忆保持的作用远大于只阅读。

words.note: retention 来自 retain；常见搭配 memory retention。

words.cn: 创造；创建；创造的作品；产物；宇宙；天地万物

ex.en: The creation of new jobs is the government's top priority this year.
ex.zh: 创造新的就业岗位是政府今年的首要任务。

words.note: creation 指创造或创作的作品；动词 create，形容词 creative。

words.cn: 法律；法规；立法；法律的制定

ex.en: Parliament passed new legislation to limit the use of plastic bags.
ex.zh: 议会通过了限制使用塑料袋的新法规。

words.note: legislation 为不可数名词，说 a piece of legislation。

words.cn: 闪身躲开；回避；逃避；托辞；伎俩；躲闪；躲避

ex.en: The driver dodged the falling branch and stopped the car just in time.
ex.zh: 司机躲开掉落的树枝，及时刹住了车。

words.note: dodge 指迅速侧身躲开，也指用托辞逃避，如 dodge taxes。

ex.en: Trust is a key ingredient in any long and successful partnership.
ex.zh: 信任是任何长久成功的合作关系中的关键要素。

words.note: ingredient 既指食物原料，也喻指成功要素，常与 key 连用。

words.cn: 过剩的；多余的；过剩；剩余；盈余

ex.en: The country has run a trade surplus for six years in a row.
ex.zh: 该国已连续六年保持贸易顺差。

words.note: surplus 与 deficit 相对；trade surplus 即贸易顺差。

words.cn: 巩固；加强；联为一体；合并

ex.en: The firm consolidated its position in Asia by opening three new offices.
ex.zh: 该公司通过开设三家新办事处巩固了在亚洲的地位。

words.note: con 表共同、solid 表牢固，合起来即巩固；也可指企业合并。

words.cn: 信件；函件；通信；通信联系；符合；一致；相似

ex.en: She kept up a correspondence with her old teacher for over thirty years.
ex.zh: 她与以前的老师保持通信三十多年。

words.note: correspondence 指书信往来，不可数；动词 correspond。

ex.en: Fear of failure can inhibit students from trying new approaches to learning.
ex.zh: 害怕失败会阻碍学生尝试新的学习方法。

words.note: in 表否定、hibit 表拿住，合起来即抑制；搭配 inhibit from。

ex.en: A short walk after lunch refreshed me and I worked better all afternoon.
ex.zh: 午饭后短暂散步让我精神一振，整个下午效率更高。

words.note: refresh 指恢复精力；refresh one's memory 意为唤醒记忆。

words.cn: 亲密的；个人的；至交；密友；暗示；提示

ex.en: They have been intimate friends since they shared a flat at university.
ex.zh: 自大学合租以来，他们一直是亲密的朋友。

words.note: intimate 作形容词重音在第一音节；作动词暗示时读 /ˈɪntɪmeɪt/。

words.cn: 用力推；挤；乱推；挤；乱塞；随意放；猛推

ex.en: He shoved his hands into his pockets and walked silently down the street.
ex.zh: 他把手插进衣袋，默默沿街走去。

words.note: shove 比 push 用力更猛，常带粗鲁意味；shove off 意为走开。

ex.en: The police reported a sharp rise in car theft in the city centre.
ex.zh: 警方报告市中心的汽车盗窃案大幅上升。

words.note: theft 是名词，指偷窃行为；thief 指小偷，注意词性不同。

ex.en: The company refused to disclose the details of the new contract.
ex.zh: 公司拒绝透露这份新合同的细节。

words.note: dis 表相反、close 表关闭，合起来即揭开、揭露；比 reveal 正式。

ex.en: The law guarantees freedom of religion for every citizen in the country.
ex.zh: 法律保障该国每位公民的宗教自由。

words.note: religion 为名词，religious 为形容词；lig 词根表绑缚。

ex.en: They spent the summer sailing a small yacht around the islands.
ex.zh: 他们整个夏天驾着小游艇绕岛航行。

words.note: yacht 的 ch 不发音，读 /jɒt/；注意与 boat 的区别。

ex.en: As mistress of the house, she welcomed every guest at the door.
ex.zh: 作为女主人，她在门口迎接每一位客人。

words.note: mistress 由 master 变来，指女主人；现代也常指情妇。

ex.en: The red colour of the soil comes from iron oxide in the rock.
ex.zh: 土壤的红色来自岩石中的氧化铁。

words.note: oxi 与氧（oxygen）有关；-ide 表示化合物，如 oxide。

words.cn: 小型的；微小的；微小的模型；缩影；微型画；微型人物像

ex.en: The model village shows the whole city in miniature.
ex.zh: 这个模型村以缩影形式展现了整座城市。

words.note: in miniature 是固定短语，意为按比例缩小地、缩影。

ex.en: The whole clan gathered at the old house every spring festival.
ex.zh: 每逢春节，整个宗族都会聚在那座老宅里。

words.note: clan 指有共同祖先的宗族，比 family 范围大。

ex.en: This small car is economical to run and easy to park in the city.
ex.zh: 这辆小车使用成本低，在城里也容易停放。

words.note: economical 指节约的，economic 指经济的，勿混用。

ex.en: The port grew into a prosperous trading city within a single generation.
ex.zh: 这个港口在一代人的时间里发展成繁荣的贸易城市。

words.note: prosper 加 ous 即繁荣的；名词 prosperity 也是高频词。

words.cn: 磨光；修改；润色；使优美；擦光剂

ex.en: He polished his speech for two days before the final presentation.
ex.zh: 决赛演讲前，他把讲稿润色了两天。

words.note: polish 既指擦亮，也指润色文章、改进技艺。

ex.en: After the losses, the board reassessed its plan for overseas expansion.
ex.zh: 在遭受亏损后，董事会重新评估了海外扩张计划。

words.note: re 表再、assess 表评估，即重新评估；名词 reassessment。

ex.en: The prime minister called a cabinet meeting to discuss the budget.
ex.zh: 首相召开内阁会议讨论预算问题。

words.note: cabinet 既指橱柜，也指内阁，看上下文判断。

ex.en: The desert heat often creates an optical illusion of water on the road.
ex.zh: 沙漠高温常在路上造成有水的视觉错觉。

words.note: optic 与眼睛有关，optical 多指视觉的、光学的。

ex.en: The old song evoked memories of the summer we spent by the sea.
ex.zh: 那首老歌唤起了我们在海边度夏的回忆。

words.note: e 表出、voke 表喊，即唤出；多接 memory、feeling。

ex.en: You should take out travel insurance before you go abroad.
ex.zh: 出国之前你应该购买旅行保险。

words.note: insurance 不可数；take out insurance 意为购买保险。

words.cn: 使眩目；耀；使赞叹不已；使倾倒；耀眼的光；令人赞叹的东西

ex.en: The headlights of the truck dazzled him and he slowed down at once.
ex.zh: 卡车的前灯晃得他眼花，他立刻减速。

words.note: dazzle 指强光使人目眩，也可喻指使人倾倒。

words.cn: 原则；原理；道义；基本信念；信条

ex.en: He refused the offer on principle, though it would have made him rich.
ex.zh: 尽管那笔交易会让他发财，他还是出于原则拒绝了。

words.note: principle 是原则，principal 是主要的、校长，切勿混。

ex.en: The player pulled a muscle in his thigh during the second half.
ex.zh: 这名球员在下半场拉伤了大腿肌肉。

words.note: thigh 中 gh 不发音，读 /θaɪ/；注意与 thing 区别。

ex.en: Copying the same figures all day is tedious but it must be done.
ex.zh: 整天抄同样的数字很枯燥，但这项工作必须完成。

words.note: tedious 强调冗长而令人厌倦，比 boring 更书面。

ex.en: She tilted her head slightly and listened to the strange sound again.
ex.zh: 她微微歪着头，又听了听那奇怪的声音。

words.note: tilt 指轻微倾斜；at full tilt 意为全速地。

ex.en: Constant comparison with others can give children a lasting sense of inferiority.
ex.zh: 总与他人比较会让孩子产生长期的自卑感。

words.note: inferiority 来自 inferior（较差的），反义 superiority。

ex.en: Each participant in the study was asked to keep a daily diary.
ex.zh: 这项研究的每位参与者都被要求每天写日记。

words.note: participant 后接 in；动词 participate 也接 in。

words.cn: 开始；创造；发起；使初步了解；接纳；让…加入；新加入组织的人

ex.en: The city initiated a project to clean up the polluted river last year.
ex.zh: 该市去年启动了一个治理污染河流的项目。

words.note: initiate 重音在第二音节；名词 initiative 指主动性、倡议。

ex.en: Domestic flights are usually cheaper than international ones in this country.
ex.zh: 在这个国家，国内航班通常比国际航班便宜。

words.note: domestic 兼指国内的与家庭的，如 domestic market。

words.cn: 怒目而视；发射强光；发出刺眼的光线；强光；怒视；瞪眼；炫耀；张扬

ex.en: The driver glared at the cyclist who had cut in front of him.
ex.zh: 司机怒视着那个突然插到他前面的骑车人。

words.note: glare at 是怒目而视；作名词指刺眼的强光。

ex.en: Farmers here depend on an irrigation system built over fifty years ago.
ex.zh: 这里的农民依靠五十多年前修建的灌溉系统。

words.note: irrigation 来自 irrigate（灌溉），也可指冲洗伤口。

ex.en: The team compiled a list of every species found on the island.
ex.zh: 该团队编制了一份岛上所有物种的清单。

words.note: compile 指收集资料汇编成册；名词 compilation。

ex.en: The old market district is full of vitality again after the renovation.
ex.zh: 翻修之后，老市场区又充满了活力。

words.note: vital（有活力的）加 ity；同根词 vital、vitalize。

ex.en: The museum keeps a working steam locomotive from the last century.
ex.zh: 博物馆保存着一台上世纪还能运行的蒸汽机车。

words.note: loco 表地方、motive 表移动，即往返两地间的机车。

words.cn: 瓦；瓷砖；铺瓦于；贴瓷砖于

ex.en: Workers spent the whole week tiling the kitchen floor and walls.
ex.zh: 工人们花了一整周给厨房的地面和墙面贴瓷砖。

words.note: tile 作名词指瓷砖、瓦片，作动词指给…贴砖。

ex.en: The hospital received a large donation from a former patient.
ex.zh: 医院收到了一位老病人的大笔捐赠。

words.note: donation 可数，常与 make a donation to 搭配。

ex.en: The new bridge was built at immense cost to the local government.
ex.zh: 这座新桥让当地政府付出了巨大成本。

words.note: immense 强调体量或程度极大，比 huge 更正式；副词 immensely。

words.cn: 内在的；固有的；生来就有的

ex.en: There are risks inherent in any long-distance space mission.
ex.zh: 任何长距离太空任务都存在固有风险。

words.note: in 表内、here 表粘附，即内在固有的；常用 inherent in。

ex.en: Economic growth depends heavily on political stability in the region.
ex.zh: 经济增长在很大程度上取决于该地区的政治稳定。

words.note: stability 来自 stable；反义 instability 表示不稳定。

words.cn: 规划；安排；编预算；低廉的；收费公道的；预算；预算拨款

ex.en: We travelled across Europe on a tight budget and stayed in hostels.
ex.zh: 我们靠紧张的预算游遍欧洲，住在青年旅舍。

words.note: budget 可作名词和动词；on a tight budget 是常用表达。

ex.en: The old stove radiates enough heat to warm the whole room.
ex.zh: 这个旧火炉散发的热量足以让整个房间暖和起来。

words.note: radi 表光线、ate 动词后缀，即辐射；也指流露情感。

words.cn: 规定的；特定的；假设的；已知的；有癖好的；有倾向的；考虑到

ex.en: Given that the roads were icy, the journey took much longer than expected.
ex.zh: 考虑到路面结冰，这次行程比预想的花了更多时间。

words.note: given that 引导原因状语，意为考虑到；given 也可作形容词。

words.cn: 丧生；毁灭；消亡；失去弹性；老化

ex.en: Thousands of animals perished in the forest fires last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天，成千上万的动物在森林大火中丧生。

words.note: perish 是正式用语的死亡、毁灭；perishable 指易腐坏的。

ex.en: Fishing is a popular pastime among people living near the lake.
ex.zh: 钓鱼是住在湖边的人中很受欢迎的消遣。

words.note: pastime 是消遣，pass time 是两个词，意为打发时间。

words.cn: 最后的；最终的；终极；顶点

ex.en: The ultimate goal of the project is to cut carbon emissions by half.
ex.zh: 该项目的最终目标是把碳排放减少一半。

words.note: ultim 表最后；副词 ultimately 意为最终、归根结底。

ex.en: It took the students several weeks to adapt to life on campus.
ex.zh: 学生们花了几周时间才适应校园生活。

words.note: adapt to 是适应，adapt from 是根据…改编；勿与 adopt 混。

words.cn: 起诉；告发；对…提起公诉；告发；检举；继续从事

ex.en: The company was prosecuted for dumping waste into the river.
ex.zh: 这家公司因向河里倾倒废物而被起诉。

words.note: prosecute 指刑事起诉；名词 prosecutor 是检察官。

words.cn: 一批；一组；一群；一批生产量

ex.en: The first batch of new students arrived on campus last Monday.
ex.zh: 第一批新生上周一抵达校园。

words.note: batch 指同批生产或处理的一组，常与 of 连用；in batches 分批。

words.cn: 长处；优点；价值；功劳；成绩；值得；应受

ex.en: Promotion here is based on merit rather than on years of service.
ex.zh: 这里的晋升依据是个人能力而非资历。

words.note: merit 作名词指优点、价值，作动词是值得，如 merit attention。

words.cn: 口头的；用言辞的；用文字的；动词的

ex.en: They reached a verbal agreement, but nothing was put in writing.
ex.zh: 他们达成了口头协议，但没有留下书面记录。

words.note: verbal 指口头的，不等于 written；verbal abuse 意为辱骂。

ex.en: She asked her solicitor to check the contract before she signed it.
ex.zh: 她请律师在签字前检查一下合同。

words.note: solicitor 是英国的事务律师；出庭律师是 barrister。

ex.en: Learning driven by intrinsic motivation tends to last much longer.
ex.zh: 由内在动机驱动的学习往往能持续更久。

words.note: intrinsic 与 extrinsic（外在的）相对，多修饰 value。

ex.en: The house was chosen for its proximity to the railway station.
ex.zh: 选这套房子是因为它离火车站很近。

words.note: proximity 不可数，常用 in close proximity to 表紧邻。

ex.en: The hands of his watch are luminous, so he can read the time at night.
ex.zh: 他手表的指针是夜光的，所以夜里也能看时间。

words.note: lumin 表光、ous 形容词后缀；同根词 illuminate 照亮。

words.cn: 将系牢；鞭打；抽打；猛烈打击；猛烈抨击；严厉斥责；鞭打；假睫毛；鞭梢

ex.en: The minister lashed out at reporters who questioned the new policy.
ex.zh: 部长猛烈抨击了质疑新政策的记者。

words.note: lash out at 意为突然怒斥；lash 本义是鞭打、捆紧。

words.cn: 发票；收据；收入；进款；收到；接到

ex.en: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the shoes.
ex.zh: 保留收据，以备鞋子需要退货。

words.note: receipt 中 p 不发音；on receipt of 意为收到…就。

words.cn: 假定；假设；臆断；承担；担任；呈现

ex.en: Do not assume that everyone shares your opinion on this issue.
ex.zh: 不要以为每个人在这件事上都和你有相同看法。

words.note: assume 兼指假定和承担；名词 assumption，注意拼写。

ex.en: He believed his success was predestined and never doubted it for a moment.
ex.zh: 他相信自己的成功是命中注定的，从未有过一刻怀疑。

words.note: pre 表预先、destine 表注定；名词 predestination。

words.cn: 反复有节奏地喊叫；吟诵；咏唱；反复有节奏的喊叫；赞美诗；圣歌

ex.en: The crowd chanted the team's name as the players walked onto the field.
ex.zh: 球员们走上球场时，人群反复高喊球队的名字。

words.note: chant 指有节奏地重复喊或唱；口号、经文都可用。

ex.en: She left the small town determined to control her own destiny.
ex.zh: 她离开小镇，决心掌握自己的命运。

words.note: destiny 与 fate 近义，常带注定成就的意味。

ex.en: The astronauts returned to Earth in a small capsule after six months.
ex.zh: 宇航员在六个月后乘小型太空舱返回地球。

words.note: capsule 指胶囊或密封舱；in capsule form 表以胶囊形式。

ex.en: The concept of shared bicycles spread quickly through major cities.
ex.zh: 共享单车的概念迅速传遍各大城市。

words.note: concept 指抽象概念，conception 多指构想、构思。

ex.en: This new type of rice is resistant to both drought and disease.
ex.zh: 这种新型水稻既抗旱又抗病。

words.note: resistant 后接 to；名词 resistance 表抵抗力。

ex.en: Scientists warn that the ozone layer is recovering more slowly than expected.
ex.zh: 科学家警告，臭氧层的恢复速度比预期更慢。

words.note: ozone layer 指臭氧层；亦见 ozone depletion 臭氧消耗。

words.cn: 无限期的；模糊的；不确定的

ex.en: The project was postponed for an indefinite period because of the funding cuts.
ex.zh: 由于资金削减，该项目被无限期推迟。

words.note: in-（不）+ definite（确定的）→ 不确定的；副词 indefinitely。

words.cn: 灾难；灾祸；天灾；彻底的失败

ex.en: The government sent troops to help the victims of the natural disaster.
ex.zh: 政府派兵帮助这场自然灾害的受灾民众。

words.note: 常与 natural 连用；形容词 disastrous 表「灾难性的」。

ex.en: Building the dam may damage the ecology of the whole river valley.
ex.zh: 修建大坝可能破坏整个河谷的生态。

words.note: eco-（生态）+ -logy（学科）→ 生态学；形容词 ecological。

ex.en: The factory was rebuilt with minimal cost and almost no delay.
ex.zh: 工厂以最低成本重建，几乎没有延误。

words.note: minimal 强调「最低限度」；minimum 多指最低值，反义 maximal。

words.cn: 鸡尾酒；餐前开胃小吃；混合物

ex.en: They held a small cocktail party to celebrate the new contract.
ex.zh: 他们举办了一个小型鸡尾酒会庆祝新合同。

words.note: cocktail 除「鸡尾酒」外还指混合物，如 a cocktail of drugs。

ex.en: Adding fresh herbs can greatly enhance the flavour of the soup.
ex.zh: 加入新鲜香草能大大提升汤的风味。

words.note: enhance 强调提升品质或价值，不用于人；名词 enhancement。

ex.en: By convention the chairman opens the meeting with a short speech.
ex.zh: 按照惯例，主席以简短发言宣布会议开始。

words.note: 表「会议」时可数；表「惯例」时常用复数 conventions。

ex.en: Regular exercise lowers the risk of heart disease and diabetes.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可降低患心脏病和糖尿病的风险。

words.note: 指具体疾病；染上疾病说 contract 或 catch a disease。

ex.en: Milk and green vegetables are rich sources of calcium.
ex.zh: 牛奶和绿色蔬菜是钙的丰富来源。

words.note: 常用 rich in calcium 表「富含钙」，deficiency 指缺乏。

ex.en: Notwithstanding the bad weather, the outdoor concert went ahead as planned.
ex.zh: 尽管天气恶劣，露天音乐会仍按计划举行。

words.note: 较正式，可作介词或副词，相当于 despite / in spite of。

words.cn: 怀疑；疑心；猜疑；一点儿；少量

ex.en: The guard stopped the man on suspicion of stealing from the shop.
ex.zh: 保安因该男子涉嫌在店内行窃而拦住了他。

words.note: 常见搭配 arouse/raise suspicion；形容词 suspicious。

words.cn: 买；购买；购买；购买的物品

ex.en: Customers can return any purchase within thirty days of delivery.
ex.zh: 顾客可在收货后三十天内退回任何所购商品。

words.note: 作名词指「所购之物」，比 buy 正式；purchasing power 指购买力。

ex.en: His refusal to sign the contract surprised everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 他拒绝签署合同，这让在场的人都很惊讶。

words.note: refusal 后接 to do，不接 of doing；动词 refuse 用法相同。

words.cn: 可任意使用的；一次性物品；不回收物品

ex.en: The cafe now uses disposable cups made of recycled paper.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆现在使用再生纸制的一次性杯子。

words.note: disposable income 指扣除税费后的可支配收入，经济类高频。

words.cn: 旁道；迂回道；绕过；绕…走；越过；置…于不顾

ex.en: A new road was built to bypass the crowded town centre.
ex.zh: 新修了一条路以绕过拥挤的市中心。

words.note: 可作名词「旁道」；作动词表「绕过」，如 bypass the rules。

ex.en: Most computer chips are made from thin layers of silicon.
ex.zh: 大多数计算机芯片由薄薄的硅层制成。

words.note: silicon 是元素「硅」；silicon chip 指硅芯片，科技话题高频。

ex.en: The professor explained the theory with great clarity and patience.
ex.zh: 教授以极大的清晰度和耐心讲解了这个理论。

words.note: 形容词 clear 的名词形式；with clarity 相当于 clearly，更正式。

words.cn: 资金；基金；存款；为…提供资金

ex.en: The charity raised enough funds to rebuild the village school.
ex.zh: 这家慈善机构筹到足够资金重建村里的学校。

words.note: funds 复数表「资金」；作动词表「资助」，如 fund the project。

ex.en: It is typical of him to arrive late without calling.
ex.zh: 不打电话就迟到，这是他的典型做法。

words.note: be typical of sb/sth 表「具有…的典型特征」；名词 type。

ex.en: She was the first recipient of the award for young scientists.
ex.zh: 她是该青年科学家奖的首位获得者。

words.note: 常与 donor（捐赠者）相对，指「接受者、受赠者」。

ex.en: Many Commonwealth countries share English as an official language.
ex.zh: 许多英联邦国家把英语作为官方语言之一。

words.note: common（共同）+ wealth（财富）；首字母大写常指英联邦。

ex.en: This energy-saving lamp uses only nine watts of electricity.
ex.zh: 这种节能灯只消耗九瓦电。

words.note: 功率单位，符号 W；kilowatt-hour 即日常说的「度」。

words.cn: 发出嗡嗡声；忙乱；急行；发出嘈杂的谈话声；嗡嗡声；嘈杂的谈话声

ex.en: The classroom buzzed with excitement before the holiday began.
ex.zh: 假期开始前，教室里一片兴奋的嗡嗡声。

words.note: 拟声词，指蜜蜂般的嗡嗡声；give sb a buzz 口语指打电话。

words.cn: 财政；金融；财源；财务情况；为…提供资金

ex.en: The city plans to finance the new library through private donations.
ex.zh: 该市计划通过私人捐款为新图书馆提供资金。

words.note: 作名词指财政金融，作动词表「为…筹资」；形容词 financial。

ex.en: The company incurred heavy losses after the factory closed.
ex.zh: 工厂关闭后，公司蒙受了严重损失。

words.note: incur 后多接 loss、cost、debt 等，表「招致、蒙受」。

words.cn: 臭名昭著的；声名狼藉的

ex.en: The road is notorious for accidents during the rainy season.
ex.zh: 这条路因雨季事故频发而臭名昭著。

words.note: be notorious for sth；带贬义，与褒义的 famous 相对。

ex.en: The assassination attempt failed when the guard spotted the gunman.
ex.zh: 警卫发现枪手，暗杀企图失败了。

words.note: assassinate 指暗杀要人；注意双写 s，名词 assassination。

ex.en: The clinic offers free check-ups for mothers and their infants.
ex.zh: 该诊所为母亲和婴儿提供免费体检。

words.note: 比 baby 正式；infant mortality 指婴儿死亡率，新闻高频。

ex.en: The thyroid gland controls how quickly the body uses energy.
ex.zh: 甲状腺控制人体消耗能量的速度。

words.note: 常与身体部位连用：thyroid gland 甲状腺、sweat gland 汗腺。

words.cn: 房屋和地基；经营场址；前提；假设

ex.en: The argument rests on the premise that prices will keep rising.
ex.zh: 这一论点以价格将持续上涨为前提。

words.note: 常用 on the premise that；复数 premises 指房屋场地。

words.cn: 马戏；马戏团；喧闹的场面；环形广场

ex.en: The children cheered as the circus clowns tumbled into the ring.
ex.zh: 马戏团小丑翻着跟头进场，孩子们欢呼起来。

words.note: 源自拉丁语「圆圈」；口语 a circus 可指乱哄哄的场面。

ex.en: The new tax on plastic bags proved highly controversial among shoppers.
ex.zh: 新的塑料袋税在购物者中引起了极大争议。

words.note: 名词是 controversy，重音在第三音节 -ver-。

ex.en: Few runners attain such speed without years of hard training.
ex.zh: 没有多年刻苦训练，很少有跑者能达到这样的速度。

words.note: 强调经努力达到目标，比 reach 正式；名词 attainment。

ex.en: The new law would deprive many families of their homes.
ex.zh: 这项新法律将剥夺许多家庭的住房。

words.note: 必须与 of 连用：deprive sb of sth，不可省略 of。

ex.en: The landlord asked the tenant to move out by the end of June.
ex.zh: 房东要求房客在六月底前搬走。

words.note: 与 landlord（房东）相对；tenant farmer 指佃农。

words.cn: 作为结果的；因而发生的

ex.en: The heavy rain caused floods and the resultant damage was enormous.
ex.zh: 大雨引发洪水，由此造成的损失巨大。

words.note: 形容词，表「因而产生的」，多用于正式或学术文体。

words.cn: 有害生物；害虫；讨厌的人

ex.en: Farmers are using fewer chemicals to control pests in the fields.
ex.zh: 农民正在减少使用化学品来控制田里的害虫。

words.note: 指害虫或讨厌的人；pesticide 指杀虫剂，常一起出现。

words.cn: 踩踏板；骑车；踏板；踏脚；脚蹬；踩动…的踏板

ex.en: She pedalled slowly up the hill, breathing hard in the cold air.
ex.zh: 她慢慢地蹬车上坡，在冷空气中喘着粗气。

words.note: 作动词时英式双写 l（pedalled），美式 pedaled。

ex.en: Waves battered the small boat for hours before it reached the shore.
ex.zh: 海浪拍打了小船几个小时，它才靠岸。

words.note: 指反复猛击；battered 可形容「破旧不堪的」。

ex.en: The old town was listed as a world heritage site last year.
ex.zh: 这座古镇去年被列为世界遗产地。

words.note: 不可数，指世代相传的文化传统；常与 cultural 连用。

words.cn: 最高的；最大的；极度的；最重要的

ex.en: The Supreme Court agreed to hear the case again next month.
ex.zh: 最高法院同意下个月再次审理此案。

words.note: 表「最高的」，无比较级；the Supreme Court 最高法院。

ex.en: The robbers took two customers hostage and demanded a car.
ex.zh: 劫匪劫持了两名顾客作人质，索要一辆车。

words.note: take sb hostage 人质前不加冠词；release a hostage。

words.cn: 优先；重点；优先考虑的事

ex.en: Safety must take priority over speed when the roads are icy.
ex.zh: 路面结冰时，安全必须优先于速度。

words.note: 常用 give priority to、take priority over，注意介词。

ex.en: The garden slopes gently down to the river behind the house.
ex.zh: 花园缓缓下斜，一直延伸到屋后的河边。

words.note: 可作名词「斜坡」与动词「倾斜」；steep slope 高频。

ex.en: The fishing boats rested in a quiet inlet away from the wind.
ex.zh: 渔船停泊在一个避风的安静小湾里。

words.note: 与 outlet 相对：inlet 进口、小湾，outlet 出口、销路。

words.cn: 金属的；金属制的；有金属特性的；像金属的

ex.en: The water from the old pipe had a strange metallic taste.
ex.zh: 旧水管里的水有一股奇怪的金属味。

words.note: metal 是名词「金属」，metallic 形容金属般的。

words.cn: 穿梭般来回；短程穿梭运行的飞机；航天飞机；梭子；短程穿梭运送

ex.en: A free shuttle bus runs between the hotel and the airport.
ex.zh: 酒店和机场之间有免费穿梭巴士。

words.note: 作动词表「穿梭往返」；shuttle bus 最常见。

words.cn: 新生；再生；起革新作用；使新生；重建；改革；革新

ex.en: Lizards can regenerate their tails after they are attacked.
ex.zh: 蜥蜴遭袭击后能再生尾巴。

words.note: re-（再）+ generate（生成）→ 再生；名词 regeneration。

ex.en: The school allocated more money to sports facilities this year.
ex.zh: 学校今年拨出更多资金用于体育设施。

words.note: allocate sth to sb/sth 把…分配给；名词 allocation。

words.cn: 潜在的；隐伏的；不易察觉的

ex.en: The course helps students discover their latent talent for design.
ex.zh: 这门课帮助学生发现自己在设计方面的潜在才能。

words.note: 指存在但未显现的，常与 demand、talent 搭配。

words.cn: 极妙的；极大的；令人恐惧的

ex.en: You look terrific in that blue jacket, she said with a smile.
ex.zh: “你穿那件蓝色夹克真好看，”她笑着说。

words.note: 口语多表「极好的」，而非「可怕的」；与 terrible 区分。

ex.en: From a practical standpoint, the plan is too costly to carry out.
ex.zh: 从实际角度看，这个计划成本太高，难以实施。

words.note: 常与 from 连用，相当于 point of view，但更书面。

words.cn: 首要的；主要的；基本的；最初的；初级的

ex.en: Our primary concern is the safety of the children on the bus.
ex.zh: 我们首要关心的是车上孩子们的安全。

words.note: 指首要的、初级的；副词 primarily 表「主要地」。

words.cn: 非法盗印者；侵犯版权者；海盗；盗用；非法盗印

ex.en: Police seized thousands of pirated films from the market stall.
ex.zh: 警方从市场摊位上查获了数千张盗版影片。

words.note: 作动词表盗印；pirated software 指盗版软件。

words.cn: 顽固的；执拗的；倔强的；难对付的；难于克服的

ex.en: He was too stubborn to admit that his plan had failed.
ex.zh: 他太固执，不肯承认自己的计划失败了。

words.note: 既指人固执，也指问题难解决，如 a stubborn cough。

words.cn: 构想出；规划；系统地阐述

ex.en: The committee spent months trying to formulate a policy on data privacy.
ex.zh: 委员会花了几个月试图制定数据隐私政策。

words.note: 指系统地提出、制定，多接 policy、plan、theory。

words.cn: 消灭；毁灭；消费；吃完；喝光

ex.en: Older machines consume far more electricity than modern ones.
ex.zh: 旧机器比现代机器耗电多得多。

words.note: consumer 消费者，consumption 消耗量，注意词形。

ex.en: The golden dome of the cathedral shines in the morning sun.
ex.zh: 大教堂的金色穹顶在晨光中闪闪发亮。

words.note: 指圆屋顶，也比喻半球形结构，如 the dome of the sky。

ex.en: A thick layer of dust covered the old furniture in the room.
ex.zh: 房间里旧家具上覆盖着厚厚一层灰。

words.note: 常与 of 连用表「一层…」；动词 layer 表分层堆放。

words.cn: 外国的；外国人的；陌生的；性质不同的；不相容的；外国人；外侨；外星人

ex.en: The customs of the village seemed alien to the young reporter.
ex.zh: 这个村庄的习俗对年轻记者来说很陌生。

words.note: be alien to sb 表「对某人陌生」；作名词指外侨或外星人。

ex.en: The interview tested her competence in handling difficult customers.
ex.zh: 面试考察了她应对难缠顾客的能力。

words.note: 名词，形容词 competent，be competent in/at 擅长。

words.cn: 熔合；合并；因保险丝熔断而中断工作；保险丝；熔丝；导火线

ex.en: The lights went out when a sudden surge of power blew the fuse.
ex.zh: 电流突然激增烧断了保险丝，灯都灭了。

words.note: blow a fuse 字面指保险丝熔断，口语表「大发脾气」。

words.cn: [总称] 上层人士；掌权人物；实力集团；[总称]出类拔萃的人；精英

ex.en: The scholarship gives talented students from poor areas a chance to join the elite.
ex.zh: 这项奖学金让贫困地区的优秀学生有机会进入精英行列。

words.note: 集合名词，谓语可用单数或复数；elitist 精英主义的。

words.cn: 高级的；优质的；售价高的；保险金；额外费用；加付款；奖品；赠品；额外津贴

ex.en: Good housing is at a premium in the centre of the city.
ex.zh: 市中心的优质住房非常稀缺。

words.note: at a premium 表「稀缺、溢价」；作形容词指优质的。

words.cn: 装饰品；点缀品；装饰；点缀；装饰；点缀；美化

ex.en: The hall was ornamented with flowers and coloured lights for the wedding.
ex.zh: 大厅用鲜花和彩灯装饰，用于婚礼。

words.note: 作名词指装饰品，作动词表装饰，常用 be ornamented with。

ex.en: The doctor assured her that the test results were completely normal.
ex.zh: 医生向她保证检查结果完全正常。

words.note: assure 后接人；ensure 后接事，如 ensure safety。

ex.en: He left the meeting early on the pretext of an urgent phone call.
ex.zh: 他以有紧急电话为借口提前离开了会议。

words.note: on the pretext of doing 表「以…为借口」，多指借口不实。

ex.en: The ban on the ivory trade helped protect wild elephants.
ex.zh: 禁止象牙贸易帮助保护了野生大象。

words.note: ivory tower（象牙塔）指脱离现实的环境或学术生活。

ex.en: The theme of the conference is how cities can save energy.
ex.zh: 会议的主题是城市如何节约能源。

words.note: 比 topic 更强调贯穿全篇的中心思想；形容词 thematic。

ex.en: You should consult a doctor before taking these tablets.
ex.zh: 服用这些药片前你应该咨询医生。

words.note: consult a dictionary 查阅；consult with sb 商议。

ex.en: Workers marched to show solidarity with the striking miners.
ex.zh: 工人们游行，声援罢工的矿工。

words.note: 不可数，常与 with 连用，表「声援、团结一致」。

words.cn: 跌倒；摔下；滚下；翻滚；暴跌；不由自主地卷入；跌倒；摔倒

ex.en: The little boy tumbled down the last few steps and started crying.
ex.zh: 小男孩从最后几级台阶上摔了下来，哭了起来。

words.note: 指踉跄摔倒或翻滚；tumble down 也指建筑物倒塌。

words.cn: 亲切的；和蔼的；优美的；雅致的；雍容华贵的；天哪!

ex.en: Our host was gracious enough to drive us to the station.
ex.zh: 主人很客气，开车把我们送到车站。

words.note: 表亲切有礼，多形容主人或举止；与 graceful 优雅区分。

words.cn: 猛撞；猛冲；使粉碎；使打烂；狠打；猛击；使破灭；使失败；破碎；猛击；猛撞；轰动的演出；巨大的成功

ex.en: The ball smashed through the kitchen window and landed on the floor.
ex.zh: 球砸穿厨房窗户，落在地板上。

words.note: smash hit 表轰动的成功；smash 强调猛烈撞击致碎。

ex.en: He was not merely late; he had forgotten the tickets entirely.
