words.cn: 照字面的；原义的；逐字的

ex.en: A literal translation often fails to capture the humor of the original.
ex.zh: 直译往往无法传达原文的幽默。

words.note: literal 源自 letter（字母），指按字面；副词是 literally。

words.cn: 概念；观念；意图；想法；念头

ex.en: He rejected the notion that money alone can buy happiness.
ex.zh: 他不认同仅靠金钱就能买到幸福的说法。

words.note: notion 指朦胧的看法或念头，比 idea 更书面。

words.cn: 不履行义务；拖欠；违约；拖欠；弃权；预设；缺省

ex.en: Several companies defaulted on their loans when the market collapsed.
ex.zh: 市场崩盘后，几家公司拖欠了贷款。

words.note: default on 表拖欠债务；计算机语境指默认设置。

ex.en: The ball rose in a graceful arc and dropped through the basket.
ex.zh: 球划出一道优美的弧线，落进篮筐。

words.note: arc 指圆周的一段；彩虹常被描述为 an arc of colors。

ex.en: The cafe serves hot beverages and light meals throughout the day.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆全天供应热饮和简餐。

words.note: beverage 是饮料的正式说法，多见于菜单和广告。

words.cn: 被俘虏的；被捕获的；俘虏

ex.en: The rebels held the journalists captive for nearly three weeks.
ex.zh: 叛军把记者们关押了将近三周。

words.note: be held captive 是常见被动结构；captive 作名词指俘虏。

words.cn: 极蠢的；荒唐的；精神病的；精神失常的；疯狂的

ex.en: The constant noise from the building site nearly drove me insane.
ex.zh: 工地不断的噪音几乎把我逼疯了。

words.note: insane 与 crazy 近义但更正式；由 in- 加 sane（清醒的）构成。

ex.en: She attributes her success to hard work and a little luck.
ex.zh: 她把成功归因于努力加上一点运气。

words.note: 动词重音在后；attribute sth to sth，to 不能省略。

ex.en: The old cemetery at the edge of town is now a protected site.
ex.zh: 镇边那座老公墓如今成了保护区。

words.note: cemetery 结尾是 -tery，易与 symmetry 混淆。

ex.en: Scientists are studying the genetic causes of the disease.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究这种疾病的遗传成因。

words.note: gene 是基因，genetic 为形容词，genetics 指遗传学。

words.cn: 缝；绣；一针；线迹；缝法；针法；编结法；突然剧痛

ex.en: The doctor cleaned the cut and stitched it up in a few minutes.
ex.zh: 医生清理了伤口，几分钟就缝好了。

words.note: stitch up 表缝合；in stitches 是口语，指笑得前仰后合。

ex.en: The team returned home in triumph after winning the final.
ex.zh: 球队赢得决赛后凯旋而归。

words.note: triumph over 表战胜困难或对手；形容词是 triumphant。

ex.en: Gambling is a vice that has ruined many families.
ex.zh: 赌博是一种毁掉许多家庭的恶习。

words.note: vice 指恶习或罪恶；注意别与 vise（虎钳）混淆。

ex.en: Early detection of the disease greatly improves the patient's chances.
ex.zh: 及早发现这种疾病能大大提高患者的康复机会。

words.note: detect 是动词，detection 是名词；early detection 常用。

ex.en: A diet rich in fiber helps keep the bowels healthy.
ex.zh: 富含纤维的饮食有助于保持肠道健康。

words.note: bowel 常以复数出现，指肠道，多用于医学语境。

ex.en: His strange behavior aroused the suspicion of his neighbors.
ex.zh: 他古怪的举动引起了邻居的怀疑。

words.note: arouse 多接 interest、suspicion；arise 不及物。

words.cn: 最合适的；最优的；最佳的

ex.en: Plants grow best when the optimum temperature and moisture are maintained.
ex.zh: 保持最适宜的温度和湿度，植物生长得最好。

words.note: optimum 比 best 更书面，多修饰条件、温度、水平。

words.cn: 压制；镇压；禁止发表；查禁；抑制；忍住；阻止…的生长

ex.en: She could hardly suppress a smile when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 听到这个消息时，她几乎忍不住笑了。

words.note: suppress 可用于情绪、消息或生长；名词是 suppression。

ex.en: My grandmother always made rice pudding for us on winter evenings.
ex.zh: 冬天晚上奶奶总会给我们做米布丁。

words.note: 英式 pudding 泛指甜点，美式多指布丁状甜食。

ex.en: She wrinkled her nose at the smell of the medicine.
ex.zh: 闻到药味，她皱起了鼻子。

words.note: wrinkle 作动词指皱起，作名词指皮肤或布料的褶皱。

ex.en: After hours of discussion, the group finally reached a consensus.
ex.zh: 经过数小时讨论，小组终于达成共识。

words.note: consensus 是名词，习惯说 reach a consensus on sth。

words.cn: 令人厌烦的；乏味的；无聊的

ex.en: The lecture was so boring that half the audience fell asleep.
ex.zh: 讲座乏味得让一半听众睡着了。

words.note: boring 修饰令人厌的事物；bored 表人感到无聊。

words.cn: 最优秀的；典型的；标准的；传统式样的；典雅的；文学名著；经典作品；杰作；优秀的典范

ex.en: Her reaction was a classic example of how stress affects judgment.
ex.zh: 她的反应是压力如何影响判断的典型例子。

words.note: classic 指经典或典型；classical 多指古典音乐和古典文化。

ex.en: Two experienced teachers supervise the students during the experiment.
ex.zh: 实验期间由两名有经验的老师指导学生。

words.note: supervise 强调监督并指导；由 super-（在上）加 vise（看）构成。

words.cn: 传播流言蜚语；流言蜚语；爱说长道短的人

ex.en: She never joins in the office gossip about her colleagues.
ex.zh: 她从不参与办公室里关于同事的八卦。

words.note: gossip 可作名词和动词，指背后议论他人私事。

ex.en: He described the accident in detail to the police.
ex.zh: 他向警方详细描述了那起事故。

words.note: 习惯说 describe sth as sth，不用 describe sth like。

ex.en: She faced a real dilemma: accept the job offer or stay with her family.
ex.zh: 她面临真正的难题：接受这份工作还是留在家人身边。

words.note: 常见搭配是 face a dilemma、in a dilemma，指两难处境。

ex.en: They announced their engagement at a small family dinner.
ex.zh: 他们在一场小型家庭晚餐上宣布订婚。

words.note: engagement 指订婚或约定；engaging 意为迷人的，注意区分。

ex.en: The wealthy businessman donated a large sum to the local school.
ex.zh: 这位富商向当地学校捐了一大笔钱。

words.note: wealthy 比 rich 正式；the wealthy 指富人阶层。

ex.en: The charity works to improve housing in the city's slum areas.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构致力于改善城市贫民区的住房。

words.note: slum 常用复数 the slums 指贫民区，多与住房话题相关。

words.cn: 起泡沫；吐白沫；泡沫；泡沫材料；泡沫状物

ex.en: The waves crashed against the rocks and sent white foam into the air.
ex.zh: 海浪拍打岩石，白色泡沫飞溅到空中。

words.note: foam 多指泡沫；foam at the mouth 常比喻大怒。

ex.en: He was criticized for his complete disregard for safety rules.
ex.zh: 他因完全无视安全规定而受到批评。

words.note: disregard 后接名词；名词搭配是 disregard for sth。

words.cn: 管理；管理部门；行政机关；实行；执行

ex.en: She earned a degree in business administration before joining the firm.
ex.zh: 她加入公司前获得了工商管理学位。

words.note: administration 可指管理，也可指政府；动词是 administer。

ex.en: Apart from the occasional shower, the weather stayed fine all week.
ex.zh: 除偶尔的阵雨外，整周天气都不错。

words.note: occasional 是形容词，表偶尔；副词 occasionally 更常用。

ex.en: There is no point in dwelling on mistakes you cannot change.
ex.zh: 老想着无法改变的过错没有意义。

words.note: dwell in 现多用于文学；dwell on sth 指反复思虑。

words.cn: 包含；加上；吸收；把…合并；使并入

ex.en: The designer incorporated traditional patterns into the new building.
ex.zh: 设计师把传统图案融入了这座新建筑。

words.note: incorporate sth into sth 是固定搭配，含融为一体之意。

ex.en: The proposal sparked a heated debate among the committee members.
ex.zh: 该提案在委员会成员中引发了激烈辩论。

words.note: debate 可作名词和动词；debate on 或 over sth 更常见。

words.cn: 熄灭；扑灭；使消亡；使破灭

ex.en: Firefighters worked through the night to extinguish the flames.
ex.zh: 消防员连夜扑灭大火。

words.note: extinguish 比 put out 正式；extinguisher 是灭火器。

words.cn: 易受伤的；脆弱的；易受攻击的；难防御的

ex.en: Older people are more vulnerable to the flu in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天老年人更容易患流感。

words.note: be vulnerable to sth 是固定搭配；名词是 vulnerability。

ex.en: They bought most of their furniture at a second-hand market.
ex.zh: 他们的家具大多购自二手市场。

words.note: furniture 不可数，计量用 a piece of furniture。

ex.en: This segment of the market is growing faster than any other.
ex.zh: 这个市场板块比其他任何板块增长都快。

words.note: segment 指整体中划分出的一段；动词意为分割。

words.cn: 与对方地位相当的人；与另一方作用相当的物

ex.en: The minister met her French counterpart to discuss trade.
ex.zh: 部长会见了法国同僚，讨论贸易问题。

words.note: counterpart 指地位或作用相当者，常用于对比两国职位。

words.cn: 布道；说教；宣讲；布道；竭力鼓吹；宣传

ex.en: Parents should practice what they preach if they want children to listen.
ex.zh: 父母要想孩子听话，就该言行一致。

words.note: practice what you preach 是习语，指言行一致。

words.cn: 肋；肋腹；侧边；侧翼；位于…的侧面

ex.en: The stage was flanked by two large screens showing the speech.
ex.zh: 舞台两侧各有一块大屏幕播放演讲。

words.note: be flanked by 表两侧有…；flank 也指军事上的侧翼。

ex.en: Hundreds of residents donated blood after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震后数百名居民献血。

words.note: donate sth to sb 或 sth；名词是 donation。

words.cn: 摆；钟摆；摇摆不定的事态

ex.en: Public opinion has swung like a pendulum between the two extremes.
ex.zh: 舆论像钟摆一样在两种极端之间摇摆。

words.note: pendulum 常比喻局势或舆论的摇摆。

ex.en: He left the meeting in defiance of the chairman's orders.
ex.zh: 他违抗主席的命令离开了会场。

words.note: in defiance of 是固定搭配，后接规定、命令等。

words.cn: 拥有最高统治权的；至高无上的；具有独立主权的；君主；元首

ex.en: Every sovereign state has the right to control its own borders.
ex.zh: 每个主权国家都有权控制自己的边界。

words.note: sovereign 指拥有最高权力；名词是 sovereignty。

words.cn: 满足需要；迎合；提供饮食及服务；承办酒席

ex.en: The hotel caters mainly to business travelers and conference groups.
ex.zh: 这家酒店主要接待商务旅客和会议团体。

words.note: cater to 多指迎合需求，cater for 多指提供饮食。

words.cn: 有吸引力的；引起注意的

ex.en: The city offers an attractive package of jobs and affordable housing.
ex.zh: 这座城市提供了工作和可负担住房的诱人组合。

words.note: attractive 后接 to 表对某人有吸引力；名词是 attraction。

words.cn: 相当数量的；重要的；意义重大的；意味深长的

ex.en: There has been a significant increase in online sales this year.
ex.zh: 今年网上销售额显著增长。

words.note: significant 既可指重要，也可指数量可观，注意语境。

words.cn: 完全一样的；复制的；完全一样的东西；复制品；复制；复印；重复

ex.en: Please submit the form in duplicate to the front desk.
ex.zh: 请将表格一式两份交到前台。

words.note: in duplicate 表一式两份；作动词时重音在后。

words.cn: 出血；流血；泌脂；勒索…的钱

ex.en: His hand was bleeding heavily, so we rushed him to hospital.
ex.zh: 他的手流血不止，我们赶紧送他去医院。

words.note: bleed 是不规则动词，过去式为 bled；名词是 blood。

words.cn: 缰绳；勒缰使停步；控制；约束

ex.en: The government promised to rein in rising house prices.
ex.zh: 政府承诺抑制不断上涨的房价。

words.note: rein in 表约束；give free rein to 表放任，两者相反。

ex.en: The number of accidents decreased by nearly a third last year.
ex.zh: 去年事故数量减少了近三分之一。

words.note: decrease by 表减少幅度，decrease to 表减少到某值。

words.cn: 振翼；拍翅而飞；飘动；飘扬；快速跳动；紧张；激动不安

ex.en: Flags fluttered in the wind along the main street.
ex.zh: 主街道两旁的旗帜在风中飘扬。

words.note: flutter 指轻快地飘动或拍翅，比 fly 更轻。

words.cn: 自愿；自愿提供；志愿；志愿者；志愿兵

ex.en: She volunteered to help organize the charity concert.
ex.zh: 她自愿帮忙筹办慈善音乐会。

words.note: volunteer 后接 to do 或 for sth，一般不用动名词。

words.cn: 部分重叠；部分相同；重叠；重叠的部分

ex.en: Our two projects overlap in several areas, so we share resources.
ex.zh: 我们两个项目在几方面重叠，因此共享资源。

words.note: overlap 可作动词和名词，常与 with 连用。

ex.en: Critics say advertising encourages a shallow materialism among young people.
ex.zh: 批评者认为广告助长了年轻人的浅薄物质主义。

words.note: materialism 兼指哲学唯物主义和追求物质的价值观。

words.cn: 分期付款；分期交付；部分

ex.en: They paid for the car in monthly installments over two years.
ex.zh: 他们用两年时间按月分期付清了车款。

words.note: 英式拼作 instalment；in installments 为常用搭配。

ex.en: The whole nation mourned the death of the scientist.
ex.zh: 全国上下都为这位科学家的去世而哀悼。

words.note: mourn 可作及物动词；mourn for sb 更强调哀悼对象。

ex.en: After the operation, he walked with a cane for several months.
ex.zh: 手术后他拄了几个月手杖。

words.note: cane 指手杖或植物的茎；sugar cane 为甘蔗。

words.cn: 嘲笑；轻视；琐事；小事；无价值的东西

ex.en: Don't trifle with other people's feelings just for fun.
ex.zh: 不要为了好玩而玩弄别人的感情。

words.note: a trifle 等于 a little；trifle with 表不当回事。

ex.en: Thousands of birds migrate south before the cold season begins.
ex.zh: 数以千计的鸟在寒冷季节来临前南迁。

words.note: migrate 指人或动物迁移；emigrate 移出，immigrate 移入。

ex.en: Many families gather for a special meal on Easter Sunday.
ex.zh: 许多家庭在复活节星期日团聚享用特别的一餐。

words.note: Easter 前用介词 at，如 at Easter；注意首字母大写。

words.cn: 屈从；听从；忍受；甘心；屈从；听从；服从；呈送；提交；主张；建议

ex.en: Students must submit their essays by Friday afternoon.
ex.zh: 学生必须在周五下午之前提交论文。

words.note: submit sth to sb 表提交；submit to 表屈服听从。

words.cn: 新奇事物；新奇；新奇感；新奇性；新颖小巧而廉价的物品

ex.en: The novelty of city life soon wore off for the newcomer.
ex.zh: 对这位新来者而言，城市生活的新鲜感很快就消失了。

words.note: novelty 指新奇感或新奇物品；novel 作形容词表新颖的。

ex.en: The museum occupies a whole block in the city center.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆占了市中心整整一个街区。

words.note: occupy 表占空间或时间；be occupied 表忙碌。

ex.en: The team has won a string of victories this season.
ex.zh: 这支球队本赛季取得了一连串胜利。

words.note: a string of 后接可数名词复数，表一连串事物。

words.cn: 激增；繁荣；迅速发展；发出隆隆声；激增；繁荣；迅速发展；隆隆声；嗡嗡声

ex.en: The town's economy boomed after the new railway opened.
ex.zh: 新铁路开通后，小镇经济繁荣起来。

words.note: boom 可指经济繁荣或隆隆声；也说 a boom in prices。

words.cn: 缺席；不在；缺席的时间；外出期；缺乏；不存在

ex.en: In the absence of clear evidence, the police dropped the case.
ex.zh: 由于缺乏明确证据，警方撤销了此案。

words.note: in the absence of 表缺少…；同源词 absent 是形容词。

ex.en: The country abolished the death penalty more than twenty years ago.
ex.zh: 这个国家二十多年前就废除了死刑。

words.note: abolish 只用于制度、法律等抽象事物，不用于具体物品。

ex.en: The new policy is expected to attract foreign investment.
ex.zh: 新政策有望吸引外国投资。

words.note: attract 直接接宾语，不说 attract to sb attention。

ex.en: Investors remain cautious about putting money into new markets.
ex.zh: 投资者对向新市场投钱仍持谨慎态度。

words.note: be cautious about doing 是常用搭配；名词是 caution。

words.cn: 一把抓住；夺；夺走；抢走；一下子拉；一把抓住；抓住机会做；抽空做；片断

ex.en: A thief snatched her bag and ran off down the street.
ex.zh: 小偷抢走她的手提包，沿街跑掉了。

words.note: snatch 指突然抢夺；snatch at 表急切抓住机会。

words.cn: 眨眼睛；闪亮；闪烁；眨眼睛；一瞬间

phr.en: in the blink of an eye

ex.en: She blinked back tears and forced a smile for the camera.
ex.zh: 她强忍泪水，对着镜头挤出一个微笑。

words.note: in the blink of an eye 表瞬间；blink 指眨眼。

words.cn: 最高点；峰顶；最高级会议

ex.en: They reached the summit just before the sun went down.
ex.zh: 他们赶在日落前登上了峰顶。

words.note: summit 指山顶，也指最高级会议，需按语境理解。

words.cn: 香水；香料；香气；使充满芳香；洒香水于

ex.en: The air was filled with the perfume of the garden flowers.
ex.zh: 空气里弥漫着花园花卉的芬芳。

words.note: perfume 可指香水也可指香气；动词表使散发香气。

ex.en: The lenses magnify the tiny insects so students can see them clearly.
ex.zh: 透镜把微小的昆虫放大，学生能看得更清楚。

words.note: magnify 表放大或夸大；magnifying glass 是放大镜。

ex.en: The editor removed several redundant words from the sentence.
ex.zh: 编辑删去了句子中几个多余的词。

words.note: 英式 be made redundant 表被裁员，美式多用 laid off。

words.cn: 位于…的；坐落在…的；处于…境地的

ex.en: The hotel is situated in a quiet street near the station.
ex.zh: 酒店位于车站附近一条安静的街上。

words.note: situated 常与 in、on、near 连用，也可指处于某种境地。

ex.en: Many small businesses closed during the long recession.
ex.zh: 长期衰退中，许多小企业倒闭了。

words.note: recession 指经济衰退，别与 recess（休息）混淆。

ex.en: He will doubtless be disappointed, but the decision is final.
ex.zh: 他无疑会失望，但决定已不可更改。

words.note: doubtless 作副词等于 undoubtedly，多放动词前或句首。

words.cn: 否定的；消极的；负的；阴性的；负片；底片；负数

ex.en: Lack of sleep has a negative effect on memory and mood.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足对记忆和情绪有负面影响。

words.note: negative 与 positive 相对；也可指检测结果呈阴性。

ex.en: The government imposed new taxes on luxury imports.
ex.zh: 政府对进口奢侈品征收新税。

words.note: impose sth on sb 是固定搭配；名词是 imposition。

ex.en: The company issued a brief statement denying the rumors.
ex.zh: 公司发表简短声明，否认了谣言。

words.note: statement 指正式的陈述或书面单据，如 bank statement。

ex.en: The company registered its trademark in more than twenty countries last year.
ex.zh: 该公司去年在二十多个国家注册了商标。

words.note: trademark 指注册商标；brand 侧重品牌形象。

ex.en: Cost was the main factor in our decision to postpone the project.
ex.zh: 成本是我们决定推迟该项目的主要因素。

words.note: factor 后常接 in，说明在哪方面是因素。

words.cn: 类似的；相似的；可比拟的

ex.en: The structure of an atom is often said to be analogous to a tiny solar system.
ex.zh: 原子的结构常被说成类似一个微型太阳系。

words.note: analogous 固定接 to，不接 with；名词是 analogy。

words.cn: 物质；实质；大意；要旨；根据；理由

ex.en: Scientists found a harmful substance in the water supply of the village.
ex.zh: 科学家在村里的供水中发现了一种有害物质。

words.note: substance 指具体物质，抽象义常见于 in substance。

ex.en: Her fair complexion makes bright colors look especially good on her.
ex.zh: 她白皙的肤色使亮色衣服穿在她身上特别好看。

words.note: complexion 指天生肤色，也可引申指局面性质。

ex.en: The new manager tried to maintain continuity in the team's daily routine.
ex.zh: 新经理努力保持团队日常工作的连续性。

words.note: continuity 来自 continuous，指时间上不中断。

words.cn: 雕刻；雕塑；雕刻作品；雕塑品

ex.en: The museum has a fine collection of modern sculpture from Europe.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆收藏了一批精美的欧洲现代雕塑。

words.note: sculpture 不可数指雕塑艺术，可数指一件作品。

ex.en: Sales this quarter failed to meet the target set by the head office.
ex.zh: 本季度销售额未达到总部设定的目标。

words.note: target 后常接 for，如 a target for next year。

ex.en: The campaign gained momentum after several famous writers voiced support.
ex.zh: 几位知名作家表示支持后，这场运动势头渐强。

words.note: momentum 常与 gain、lose、build 搭配，指发展势头。

ex.en: The museum is famous for its lifelike wax figures of famous people.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆以名人逼真的蜡像闻名。

words.note: wax 作名词指蜡，作动词指上蜡；蜡像馆为 wax museum。

words.cn: 感觉能力；感觉；知觉；轰动；引起轰动的事件

ex.en: Her first novel caused a sensation and was soon translated into ten languages.
ex.zh: 她的第一部小说引起轰动，很快被译成十种语言。

words.note: sensation 既指身体感觉，也指轰动一时的人或事。

ex.en: More and more young people are moving to urban areas in search of work.
ex.zh: 越来越多年轻人迁往城市地区找工作。

words.note: urban 与 rural 相对；动词 urbanize 指使城市化。

ex.en: The plan is too expensive; furthermore, it would take years to complete.
ex.zh: 该计划花费太高，而且还要多年才能完成。

words.note: furthermore 是正式书面连接词，用于补充论点。

ex.en: The doctor's timely intervention saved the patient's life.
ex.zh: 医生及时的干预挽救了病人的生命。

words.note: timely 作定语表及时的；in time 表及时地。

ex.en: The superhero wore a long red cape that fluttered in the wind.
ex.zh: 那位超级英雄披着在风中飘动的红色长斗篷。

words.note: cape 指无袖斗篷，也指伸入海中的海角。

ex.en: Please discard any documents that are no longer needed for the audit.
ex.zh: 请丢弃审计不再需要的任何文件。

words.note: discard 强调当作无用之物扔掉，比 throw away 正式。

words.cn: 纤细的；易碎的；微妙的；精美的

ex.en: The two sides have reached a delicate balance after months of talks.
ex.zh: 经过数月谈判，双方达成了微妙的平衡。

words.note: delicate 可指易碎、纤细或微妙，如 delicate issue。

words.cn: 反叛；造反；反对；不服从；反叛分子；反对者

ex.en: Many teenagers rebel against their parents' strict rules at some point.
ex.zh: 许多青少年在某个阶段会反抗父母的严格规定。

words.note: rebel 后接 against；作名词指反叛者，重音在前。

ex.en: Farmers in the region receive a government subsidy for growing corn.
ex.zh: 该地区的农民种玉米可获得政府补贴。

words.note: subsidy 多指政府补贴，动词为 subsidize。

ex.en: The ball bounced off the wall and rolled across the floor.
ex.zh: 球从墙上弹开，滚过地板。

words.note: bounce back 除弹回外，常指受挫后迅速恢复。

words.cn: 淫秽的；下流的；可憎的；可恶的

ex.en: The film was banned in some countries for its obscene language.
ex.zh: 这部电影因语言下流在部分国家被禁。

words.note: obscene 除淫秽外，口语可指过分到令人反感的。

ex.en: The doctor examined a sample of muscle tissue under the microscope.
ex.zh: 医生在显微镜下检查了肌肉组织样本。

words.note: tissue 指生物组织，日常也指纸巾。

ex.en: The whole family gathers at Grandma's house for Thanksgiving every year.
ex.zh: 每年全家都到奶奶家过感恩节。

words.note: Thanksgiving 首字母大写，问候说 Happy Thanksgiving。

ex.en: Applicants must show a high level of proficiency in spoken English.
ex.zh: 申请者必须具备较高的英语口语水平。

words.note: proficiency 常接 in，表示某方面的熟练度。

ex.en: Despite his success, he remains modest about his own achievements.
ex.zh: 尽管取得成功，他对自己的成就仍很谦逊。

words.note: modest 除谦虚外还指数量适中，如 a modest price。

words.cn: 投；扔；抛；浇铸；演员表；全体演员；石膏绷带；铸型；铸件；投；抛

ex.en: The tall building casts a long shadow over the square in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午那栋高楼在广场上投下长长的阴影。

words.note: cast 的过去式和过去分词都是 cast。

ex.en: He chose vocational training instead of university and now runs a workshop.
ex.zh: 他选择职业培训而非上大学，如今经营一家车间。

words.note: vocational 来自 vocation，指技能型职业的。

ex.en: The government sent troops to crush the rebellion in the northern province.
ex.zh: 政府派兵镇压北部省份的叛乱。

words.note: crush 指压碎或彻底镇压；have a crush on 意为迷恋。

ex.en: Years of unfair treatment had filled the workers with hatred.
ex.zh: 多年的不公待遇使工人们心中充满仇恨。

words.note: hatred 后接 of、for 或 towards，是不可数名词。

ex.en: She cut herself a thick slice of bread and spread butter on it.
ex.zh: 她给自己切了一片厚面包，抹上黄油。

words.note: slice 作量词用 a slice of，作动词指切成薄片。

ex.en: The electron carries a negative charge and moves around the nucleus.
ex.zh: 电子带负电，围绕原子核运动。

words.note: electron 由 electric 加 -on 构成，形容词为 electronic。

words.cn: 把…嵌入；扎牢；使深留脑中

ex.en: The bullet was embedded deeply in the wall of the old house.
ex.zh: 子弹深深嵌在旧屋的墙里。

words.note: embed 常用被动 be embedded in，过去式双写 d。

ex.en: I am inclined to agree with you on this point.
ex.zh: 在这一点上我倾向于同意你的看法。

words.note: be inclined to 意为倾向于，比 want to 更正式。

words.cn: 提升…的职位；提高；改善；使情绪高昂；举起；使上升

ex.en: The new policy aims to elevate the status of rural teachers.
ex.zh: 新政策旨在提升农村教师的地位。

words.note: elevate 指位置或地位上升，也可指提高风险等。

words.cn: 指派；委任；标出；把…定名为

ex.en: The area was designated as a nature reserve twenty years ago.
ex.zh: 这片区域二十年前被指定为自然保护区。

words.note: designate 常用 be designated as 结构。

ex.en: She is one of the most promising young researchers in her field.
ex.zh: 她是本领域最有前途的年轻研究者之一。

words.note: promising 由 promise 加 -ing 而来，指有希望的。

words.cn: 圆滑的；口齿伶俐的；精巧的；巧妙的；灵巧的；光滑的；滑溜的

ex.en: The company's slick advertising made the product seem better than it was.
ex.zh: 公司圆滑的广告让产品显得比实际更好。

words.note: slick 褒义指娴熟利落，贬义指油滑、华而不实。

ex.en: The committee decided that the plan was not practicable at this stage.
ex.zh: 委员会认定该计划现阶段不可行。

words.note: practicable 指方案可实施；practical 多指实用的。

ex.en: The first item on the agenda is the budget for next year.
ex.zh: 议程第一项是明年的预算。

words.note: item 指清单中的一项；新闻一条常说 a news item。

words.cn: 律师；法律顾问；忠告；劝告；劝告；提议

ex.en: The company hired legal counsel to review the contract before signing.
ex.zh: 公司在签约前聘请法律顾问审阅合同。

words.note: counsel 作忠告时不可数，作律师指法律顾问。

ex.en: The artist spent two weeks painting the mountains on canvas.
ex.zh: 那位艺术家花了两周时间在画布上画这些山。

words.note: canvas 与 canvass（拉票）形近，勿混。

words.cn: 主管人；监管人；负责人；警长

ex.en: The superintendent of the building fixed the broken elevator within an hour.
ex.zh: 楼宇管理员一小时内修好了坏掉的电梯。

words.note: superintendent 由 super- 加 intendent 构成，指监管人。

words.cn: 可能性；可能发生的事；概率

ex.en: In all probability, the meeting will be postponed until next week.
ex.zh: 会议很可能推迟到下周。

words.note: in all probability 意为十有八九；形容词是 probable。

ex.en: The main point of contention was how to share the additional costs.
ex.zh: 争论的焦点是如何分摊额外费用。

words.note: contention 指争论或论点；in contention 意为有胜算。

words.cn: 高傲的；傲慢的；崇高的；高尚的；高耸的；极高的

ex.en: He left the company to pursue his lofty goal of teaching in the countryside.
ex.zh: 他离开公司去实现去乡村教书的崇高目标。

words.note: lofty 可指崇高的，也可指高傲的，感情色彩看语境。

words.cn: 详述的；明确的；明晰的；直言的；露骨的

ex.en: The teacher gave explicit instructions about how to format the report.
ex.zh: 老师就如何排版报告给出了明确指示。

words.note: explicit 与 implicit 相对，指明确说出、不含糊。

ex.en: You can rely on him to keep the schedule as planned.
ex.zh: 你可以指望他按计划推进日程。

words.note: rely 是不及物动词，必须接 on 或 upon。

words.cn: 滑；悄悄地移动；滑动；滑道；滑面；幻灯片

ex.en: Prices began to slide after the report on falling demand came out.
ex.zh: 需求下降的报告发布后，价格开始下滑。

words.note: slide 的过去式是 slid；slide into 指不知不觉陷入。

ex.en: The factory now utilizes solar energy to run most of its machines.
ex.zh: 工厂如今利用太阳能驱动大部分机器。

words.note: utilize 比 use 正式，强调有效利用资源或机会。

ex.en: We found ourselves in a sticky situation when the car broke down.
ex.zh: 汽车抛锚时我们陷入了一个棘手的处境。

words.note: sticky 除黏的外，口语可指棘手、难办的。

ex.en: This custom still prevails in some remote villages of the province.
ex.zh: 这一风俗在该省一些偏远村庄仍然盛行。

words.note: prevail 指盛行或获胜；prevail over 强调占上风。

ex.en: Excessive noise at night can seriously affect people's health.
ex.zh: 夜间过大的噪音会严重影响人们的健康。

words.note: excessive 带贬义，指超出合理限度；名词为 excess。

ex.en: The company issued a firm denial of the rumors about layoffs.
ex.zh: 公司坚决否认了有关裁员的传言。

words.note: in denial 指拒绝面对事实；动词为 deny。

ex.en: The soldiers carried out an assault on the enemy camp before dawn.
ex.zh: 士兵们在黎明前对敌营发动了攻击。

words.note: assault 常与 on 连用，指人身攻击或猛烈批评。

words.cn: 不言明的；含蓄的；内含的；固有的；无疑问的

ex.en: There is an implicit warning in the way she phrased the question.
ex.zh: 她提问的方式中含有一种隐含的警告。

words.note: implicit 与 explicit 相反，指含蓄的、不言明的。

ex.en: The government has promised to intensify efforts to reduce air pollution.
ex.zh: 政府承诺加大力度减少空气污染。

words.note: intensify 由 intense 加 -ify 构成，表示使更强。

words.cn: 女性的；女子的；女子气的

ex.en: The room was decorated in soft colors with a feminine touch.
ex.zh: 房间用柔和色彩装饰，带有女性气息。

words.note: feminine 指女性特质；female 只指性别，注意区分。

ex.en: Tests showed that the purity of the local water had improved.
ex.zh: 检测显示当地水的纯净度有所提高。

words.note: purity 由 pure 加 -ity 构成，指纯净或纯洁。

words.cn: 型；式样；模；模型；仿制；使…仿效

ex.en: His sleep pattern changed completely after he started working nights.
ex.zh: 开始上夜班后，他的睡眠规律完全变了。

words.note: pattern 后常接 of，如 a pattern of change；也指图案。

words.cn: 安排；安放；调停；支付；核算；安家；飞落；停留；安定

ex.en: The two companies finally settled the dispute out of court.
ex.zh: 两家公司最终在庭外解决了争端。

words.note: settle 可指安家、解决或支付；settle down 指安定下来。

ex.en: The incident heightened tensions between the two neighbouring countries.
ex.zh: 这一事件加剧了两个邻国之间的紧张关系。

words.note: heighten 由 height 加 -en 构成，多与 tension 搭配。

words.cn: 车辆；机动车；传播媒介；工具；手段

ex.en: The city plans to ban private vehicles from the old town centre.
ex.zh: 该市计划禁止私家车进入老城中心。

words.note: vehicle 除车辆外，可喻传播工具，如 a vehicle for change。

words.cn: 刮；擦；勉强过日子；刮；擦；刮擦声

ex.en: He scraped through the final exam with a score of just sixty.
ex.zh: 他仅以六十分的成绩勉强通过了期末考试。

words.note: scrape through 指勉强通过；scrape by 指勉强糊口。

words.cn: 网；网络；错综复杂的事物

ex.en: A spider had built a web between the two branches overnight.
ex.zh: 一只蜘蛛一夜之间在两根树枝间结了网。

words.note: web 指蛛网或网络，the Web 指万维网。

ex.en: The novel explores how traditional femininity shapes women's choices.
ex.zh: 这部小说探讨传统女性气质如何影响女性的选择。

words.note: femininity 是 feminine 的名词，指女性气质，不可数。

ex.en: Sales reached a plateau in the third quarter and stayed flat.
ex.zh: 销售额在第三季度趋于平稳并保持不动。

words.note: plateau 可指高原，也指发展后的停滞、平台期。

ex.en: The tragic accident left three families without a home.
ex.zh: 那场悲惨的事故使三个家庭失去了住所。

words.note: tragic 指悲剧性的；名词是 tragedy，注意拼写。

ex.en: He gave me a broad grin and waved from across the street.
ex.zh: 他在街对面朝我咧嘴大笑并挥手。

words.note: grin 指露齿笑；grin and bear it 意为苦笑着忍受。

words.cn: 握紧；抓牢；吸引住…的注意力；紧握

ex.en: She gripped the railing tightly as the ship began to rock.
ex.zh: 船开始摇晃时，她紧紧抓住栏杆。

words.note: grip 指紧握，也可指吸引注意；get a grip on 指掌控。

ex.en: The country's heavy reliance on imported oil makes its economy fragile.
ex.zh: 该国对进口石油的严重依赖使其经济脆弱。

words.note: reliance 后接 on；动词是 rely on，形容词是 reliant。

words.cn: 探险；探索；仔细查阅；探究

ex.en: The team met to explore ways of cutting costs without losing quality.
ex.zh: 团队开会探讨在不降低质量的情况下削减成本的方法。

words.note: explore 后可接名词或 how、what 从句，表示探究。

ex.en: Several rare paintings are now on display in the city museum.
ex.zh: 几幅珍稀画作正在市博物馆展出。

words.note: on display 表在展出；display 也可指表现出的情绪。

ex.en: The dam generates enough electricity for half a million homes.
ex.zh: 这座大坝发的电足够五十万户家庭使用。

words.note: electricity 不可数；形容词 electric 指用电的。

words.cn: 气候；风土；地带；风气；气氛

ex.en: The region has a mild climate that suits tea growing.
ex.zh: 该地区气候温和，适宜种茶。

words.note: climate 指长期气候，weather 指某天天气；也可指气氛。

ex.en: The two sides reached a tentative agreement on the price.
ex.zh: 双方就价格达成了初步协议。

words.note: tentative 指试探性、暂时性的，常修饰 plan、agreement。

ex.en: The room was in complete disorder after the party.
ex.zh: 聚会结束后房间一片凌乱。

words.note: in disorder 表凌乱；disorder 也指身心失调。

words.cn: 加重；加剧；使恶化；激怒；使恼火

ex.en: Cutting public spending could aggravate the problem of unemployment.
ex.zh: 削减公共开支可能使失业问题恶化。

words.note: aggravate 指使恶化；口语中也可指惹恼某人。

ex.en: The minister was widely criticized for his handling of the crisis.
ex.zh: 这位部长因处理危机的方式受到广泛批评。

words.note: criticize sb for sth 是常见结构；名词为 criticism。

ex.en: The mayor will preside over the opening ceremony tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 市长将于明天上午主持开幕仪式。

words.note: preside 不及物，后接 over 或 at，不直接跟宾语。

words.cn: 经济的；经济学的；经济学；经济状况

ex.en: The country has enjoyed steady economic growth over the past decade.
ex.zh: 过去十年该国经济保持了稳定增长。

words.note: economic 指经济的；economical 指节省的，勿混。

ex.en: The invention of the transistor changed the design of radios and computers.
ex.zh: 晶体管的发明改变了收音机和计算机的设计。

words.note: transistor 由 transfer 与 resistor 缩合而成，指晶体管。

ex.en: Recent statistics show that traffic accidents have fallen sharply.
ex.zh: 最新统计显示交通事故已大幅下降。

words.note: statistics 作统计学用单数动词，作数据用复数。

words.cn: 讨厌的；糟糕的；严厉的；冷酷的；无情的

ex.en: The report paints a grim picture of the region's future.
ex.zh: 报告描绘了该地区前景的暗淡景象。

words.note: grim 指严峻、阴沉；paint a grim picture 为常用搭配。

ex.en: The girls giggled at the joke and could not stop.
ex.zh: 女孩们听了那个笑话咯咯直笑，停不下来。

words.note: giggle 指压抑的咯咯笑，比 laugh 轻且多含傻气。

ex.en: Many animals will not produce offspring when food is scarce.
ex.zh: 食物稀少时，许多动物不会繁殖后代。

words.note: offspring 单复数同形，不加 -s，也可指产物。

words.cn: 逮捕；拘留；停止；阻止；吸引；逮捕；拘留；扣留

ex.en: The police arrested two men for stealing cars in the district.
ex.zh: 警方逮捕了两名在该区偷车的男子。

words.note: arrest 也指吸引（注意）或阻止，如 arrest attention。

words.cn: 成熟的；成年人的；深思熟虑的；到期的；应支付的；使成熟

ex.en: The business has matured into a serious competitor in the market.
ex.zh: 该企业发展成为市场中一个不容小觑的竞争者。

words.note: mature 也可指票据、债券到期，常见于金融语境。

ex.en: The new medicine can alleviate pain without causing side effects.
ex.zh: 这种新药能减轻疼痛且不产生副作用。

words.note: alleviate 指减轻痛苦或困难，多接 pain、pressure。

ex.en: You will receive a notification when your order has been shipped.
ex.zh: 订单发货后你会收到通知。

words.note: notification 是 notify 的名词；手机消息通知即此词。

words.cn: 满得外溢；外流；泛滥；充满；洋溢；淹没；从…中溢出；多得无法容纳；容纳不下的物；溢出；满出；溢流口；溢流管

ex.en: After heavy rain, the river overflowed its banks and flooded the road.
ex.zh: 大雨后河水漫过堤岸，淹没了道路。

words.note: overflow 可指液体溢出，也指充满情绪，如 overflow with joy。

ex.en: His rude remarks provoked an angry response from the audience.
ex.zh: 他粗鲁的言论激起了听众的愤怒回应。

words.note: provoke 多接 reaction、anger，指主动激起反应。

words.cn: 威胁；恐吓；预示快要来临；构成威胁；可能发生

ex.en: Rising sea levels threaten to flood many coastal cities.
ex.zh: 海平面上升预示许多沿海城市可能被淹。

words.note: threaten 后接不定式表示“预示可能发生”，接 with 表示以某物相要挟。

words.cn: 充实；使丰富；使富裕；使富有

ex.en: Reading widely can enrich your life and broaden your horizons.
ex.zh: 广泛阅读能丰富生活、开阔眼界。

words.note: enrich 由 en-（使）加 rich（富）构成，由“使富裕”引申为“丰富、充实”。

words.cn: 箔；金属薄片；陪衬；衬托；挫败；使受挫折

ex.en: The police foiled a plan to rob the bank.
ex.zh: 警方挫败了一起抢劫银行的计划。

words.note: foil 作动词指挫败计划或企图，作名词常见于 aluminium foil（铝箔）。

words.cn: 扭伤；拉伤；尽力使用；紧张；拉紧；尽力；拉紧；过劳；极度紧张；张力；扭伤；拉伤；旋律；品种；家系；气质；个性特点

ex.en: The long working hours put a great strain on her health.
ex.zh: 长时间工作给她的健康带来很大压力。

words.note: strain 兼指拉伤、紧张与压力，put a strain on 是高频搭配。

words.cn: 洽谈；协商；谈判；顺利通过；成功越过

ex.en: The two companies are negotiating a new contract.
ex.zh: 两家公司正在谈一份新合同。

words.note: negotiate 可直接接 deal，也可说 negotiate with sb。

ex.en: They stored the old wine in a cool cellar under the house.
ex.zh: 他们把陈酒存放在屋下阴凉的地窖里。

words.note: cellar 专指地下储藏室，尤指酒窖，与泛指房间的 basement 略有不同。

words.cn: 缠结；乱作一团；乱糟糟的一堆；混乱；复杂的问题；困惑

ex.en: The wires behind the desk were badly tangled.
ex.zh: 桌子后面的电线缠得乱七八糟。

words.note: tangle 常用 a tangle of（一团乱）与 get tangled up。

words.cn: 包裹；包装；一揽子交易；把…打包；包装

ex.en: The courier left a small package at the front desk.
ex.zh: 快递员在前台留下了一个小包裹。

words.note: 美式用 package 指包裹，英式多用 parcel。

words.cn: 耍阴谋；施诡计；激起…的好奇心；迷住；阴谋；诡计；密谋

ex.en: I was intrigued by the strange story she told me.
ex.zh: 她讲的离奇故事引起了我的浓厚兴趣。

words.note: intrigue 常用 be intrigued by，名词指阴谋。

words.cn: 转向特定方向；适应[theO-]；使适应；使熟悉情况；使朝向；以…为方向；东方；亚洲；东半球

ex.en: New students need time to orient themselves to campus life.
ex.zh: 新生需要时间适应校园生活。

words.note: orient 常用 orient oneself to，表示适应。

words.cn: 危机；存亡之际；关键阶段

ex.en: The company is trying to survive the worst financial crisis in its history.
ex.zh: 公司正努力度过史上最严重的财务危机。

words.note: crisis 复数为 crises，常见 economic crisis。

words.cn: 缺陷；障碍；不利条件；妨碍；使不利

ex.en: Poor eyesight is a serious handicap for a pilot.
ex.zh: 视力差对飞行员来说是很不利的条件。

words.note: handicap 作名词指障碍、不利条件，作动词常用 be handicapped by。

ex.en: The survival rate of these birds has fallen sharply in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年来这类鸟的存活率急剧下降。

words.note: survival 来自 survive，常用 survival rate。

words.cn: 碎裂；使粉碎；砸碎；使破灭；使震惊

ex.en: The glass shattered into a thousand pieces on the floor.
ex.zh: 玻璃杯在地板上摔得粉碎。

words.note: shatter 强调突然碎成小块，也可喻指希望、信念破灭。

words.cn: 恳求；请求；抗辩；答辩；辩护；借口；托辞

ex.en: The parents made an emotional plea for information about their missing son.
ex.zh: 这对父母动情地恳求提供失踪儿子的线索。

words.note: plea 指恳求，常用 make a plea for 表呼吁。

ex.en: It took a lot of persuasion to get him to change his mind.
ex.zh: 费了好一番劝说才让他改变主意。

words.note: persuasion 指说服的过程或能力，动词搭配为 persuade sb to do。

words.cn: 热心的；激烈的；敏锐的；敏捷的

ex.en: She is keen on learning Japanese and practises every day.
ex.zh: 她热衷学日语，每天都练习。

words.note: be keen on 表热衷，a keen eye for 表眼光敏锐。

ex.en: Good nutrition is essential for children's growth and development.
ex.zh: 良好的营养对儿童生长发育至关重要。

words.note: nutrition 是名词营养，形容词为 nutritional。

ex.en: The detective examined every detail of the crime scene.
ex.zh: 侦探仔细查看了犯罪现场的每个细节。

words.note: detective 可作定语，如 detective story。

words.cn: 搬；转移；调动；转学；转让；过户；乘车；转乘

ex.en: He asked the bank to transfer the money to his new account.
ex.zh: 他请银行把钱转到他的新账户。

words.note: transfer 作动词重音在后，名词重音在前。

ex.en: The veteran journalist has covered wars for over twenty years.
ex.zh: 这位资深记者报道战争已二十多年。

words.note: veteran 作定语指经验丰富，如 veteran teacher；作名词指老兵、老手。

words.cn: 加工而成的谷类食物；谷类植物；谷物

ex.en: He eats a bowl of cereal with milk every morning.
ex.zh: 他每天早上吃一碗加牛奶的麦片。

words.note: cereal 既指谷类作物也指麦片，注意与同音的 serial（连续的）区分。

words.cn: 美学的；审美的；悦目的；雅致的

ex.en: The building was praised for its esthetic appeal.
ex.zh: 这栋建筑因审美吸引力而受到称赞。

words.note: esthetic 是 aesthetic 的美式拼法，常用作定语。

words.cn: 冷漠的；不积极的；一般的；平平的

ex.en: He seemed indifferent to the criticism from his colleagues.
ex.zh: 他对同事的批评似乎毫不在意。

words.note: indifferent 意为“冷漠”，不是“无差别”。

ex.en: She has great affection for the village where she grew up.
ex.zh: 她对自己长大的村庄怀有很深的感情。

words.note: affection 指温和持久的喜爱，常接介词 for。

words.cn: 转移；转向；消遣；娱乐；临时绕行路

phr.zh: 制造转移注意力的举动

ex.en: A traffic diversion was set up while the bridge was repaired.
ex.zh: 修桥期间设置了交通绕行路线。

words.note: diversion 指改道或消遣，动词 divert 表示“转移、使改道”。

ex.en: My daughter started elementary school last September and loves it.
ex.zh: 我女儿去年九月上了小学，很喜欢那里。

words.note: elementary school 是美式“小学”，亦指基本的。

ex.en: The eagle circled high above the valley before diving for its prey.
ex.zh: 鹰在山谷上方盘旋，随后俯冲捕食。

words.note: eagle eye 指敏锐观察力，常与 keep 连用。

ex.en: He made a solemn promise never to lie to her again.
ex.zh: 他郑重承诺再也不对她撒谎。

words.note: solemn 强调庄重严肃，常与 promise、ceremony、vow 搭配。

ex.en: He was embarrassed by his mistake in front of the whole class.
ex.zh: 他在全班同学面前因自己的错误而难堪。

words.note: embarrass 常用被动式；embarrassing 多修饰事物。

ex.en: The report was based on erroneous information and had to be withdrawn.
ex.zh: 该报道依据错误信息写成，只好撤下。

words.note: erroneous 比 wrong 正式，多修饰 information 等。

words.cn: 选择；选择权；选择自由；选择的事物；选课

ex.en: We have no option but to cancel the trip.
ex.zh: 我们别无选择，只能取消这次旅行。

words.note: have no option but to do 为固定搭配，意为别无选择。

words.cn: 严重的；急性的；灵敏的；敏锐的；精明的

ex.en: The city faces an acute shortage of clean water.
ex.zh: 这座城市面临清洁用水的严重短缺。

words.note: acute 指急剧严重的，如 acute pain；反义词为 chronic。

ex.en: Every method has its limitations, so we should combine several.
ex.zh: 每种方法都有局限，所以应几种结合使用。

words.note: limitation 指局限，与 limit（界限）用法有别。

ex.en: She jogs in the park for half an hour every morning.
ex.zh: 她每天早上在公园慢跑半小时。

words.note: jog 指慢跑锻炼，常用 go jogging 表示去慢跑。

ex.en: The child was terrified of the dark and refused to sleep alone.
ex.zh: 孩子怕黑，不肯独自睡觉。

words.note: terrify 语气强于 frighten，常用 be terrified of。

ex.en: Please read the student handbook before you register for courses.
ex.zh: 选课前请先阅读学生手册。

words.note: handbook 指供查阅的手册，常用 student handbook。

ex.en: The police are trying to ascertain the cause of the fire.
ex.zh: 警方正设法查明起火原因。

words.note: ascertain 为正式用词，意为查明、确定。

ex.en: Early diagnosis plays a crucial role in the treatment of cancer.
ex.zh: 早期诊断在癌症治疗中起关键作用。

words.note: crucial 常搭配 role、factor，be crucial to 表关键。

ex.en: Regular exercise contributes to better sleep and lower stress.
ex.zh: 规律运动有助于改善睡眠、减轻压力。

words.note: contribute to 中 to 为介词，后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: Insert the card into the slot and wait for the light to turn green.
ex.zh: 把卡插入卡槽，等灯变绿。

words.note: insert 常用 insert A into B，名词为 insertion。

ex.en: She never lost faith in her son's ability to succeed.
ex.zh: 她从未对儿子取得成功的能力失去信心。

words.note: faith 常与 in 搭配，have faith in 表示信任。

ex.en: The painter drew inspiration from the colours of the desert.
ex.zh: 这位画家从沙漠的色彩中汲取灵感。

words.note: inspiration 常用 draw inspiration from 表汲取灵感。

ex.en: The marathon tested the runners' endurance to the limit.
ex.zh: 这场马拉松把选手的耐力考到了极限。

words.note: endurance 指忍耐力，常用 test one's endurance。

words.cn: 强调；突出；使显著；最精彩的部分；最重要的事件

ex.en: The report highlights the importance of early screening.
ex.zh: 报告强调了早期筛查的重要性。

words.note: highlight 作名词指最精彩部分，常用 the highlight of。

words.cn: 候选人；投考者；申请求职者

ex.en: She is the strongest candidate for the position of manager.
ex.zh: 她是经理一职最有力的竞争者。

words.note: candidate 后接 for 表示职位或考试。

ex.en: We must strive to reduce waste in every part of the process.
ex.zh: 我们必须努力减少流程各环节的浪费。

words.note: strive 过去式为 strove，常用 strive for sth。

ex.en: All customer records are stored in a secure database.
ex.zh: 所有客户记录都存放在安全的数据库中。

words.note: database 由 data 加 base 构成，常与 store 连用。

words.cn: 可理解的；明白易懂的；清楚的

ex.en: His lecture was clear and intelligible even to beginners.
ex.zh: 他的讲座清楚易懂，连初学者也能听明白。

words.note: intelligible 指可听懂的，与 intelligent 形近。

words.cn: 并列的；平行的；类似的；对应的；并联的；可相比拟的事物；相似处；平行线；平行面；纬线；与…相似；与… 相当；比得上

ex.en: The new road runs parallel to the river for several miles.
ex.zh: 新修的路有几英里与河平行。

words.note: parallel to 表平行；draw a parallel between 指类比。

words.cn: 拒绝；拒纳；退回；摈弃；被拒货品；不合格产品

ex.en: The committee rejected the proposal because of the high cost.
ex.zh: 因成本过高，委员会否决了该提案。

words.note: reject 语气强于 refuse，常接 offer、proposal。

ex.en: We thanked our hosts for their warm hospitality.
ex.zh: 我们感谢主人一家的热情款待。

words.note: hospitality 指热情款待，形容词为 hospitable。

words.cn: 垂直地；陡峭地；急转向；偏离；完全的；十足的；陡峭的；垂直的；极薄的；透明的

ex.en: We won the game by sheer luck, not by skill.
ex.zh: 我们赢下比赛纯靠运气，而非技术。

words.note: sheer 表纯粹的、十足的，如 sheer luck。

ex.en: Her style of painting is an imitation of her teacher's.
ex.zh: 她的画风是对老师的模仿。

words.note: imitation 前可加 in 表模仿，也可作定语。

words.cn: 赞美；恭维；致意；问候；赞美；恭维

ex.en: The teacher complimented her on the clear structure of her essay.
ex.zh: 老师称赞她文章结构清晰。

words.note: compliment 指赞美，与 complement（补充）形近。

words.cn: 跌跌撞撞地走；慌乱地走；犯错误；错误

ex.en: The government made a serious blunder in handling the crisis.
ex.zh: 政府在处理这场危机时犯了大错。

words.note: blunder 指粗心犯的大错，比 mistake 语气重。

words.cn: 破坏；违反；破裂；不和；缺口；裂口；攻破；在…造成缺口；破坏；违反

ex.en: The company was sued for breach of contract.
ex.zh: 该公司因违约被起诉。

words.note: breach 常搭配 of，breach of contract 表违约。

words.cn: 最初的；新颖的；原版的；原件；原作

ex.en: Please bring the original document and a photocopy of it.
ex.zh: 请带上文件原件及其复印件。

words.note: original 既指最初的，也指新颖独创的。

ex.en: All factories must comply with the new safety standards.
ex.zh: 所有工厂都必须遵守新的安全标准。

words.note: comply 为不及物动词，必须搭配 with。

ex.en: The pilot had to deviate from the planned route to avoid the storm.
ex.zh: 为避开暴风雨，飞行员不得不偏离原定航线。

words.note: deviate 常与 from 连用，名词为 deviation。

words.cn: 任务；指定的作业；分配；指派

ex.en: The students must hand in their assignments by Friday.
ex.zh: 学生必须在周五前交作业。

words.note: assignment 指分派的任务或作业，常用 hand in。

ex.en: She showed us a photo album from her trip to Italy.
ex.zh: 她给我们看了她意大利之行的相册。

words.note: album 指相册，也指音乐专辑，常用 release。

ex.en: The tax cut was intended as a stimulus to economic growth.
ex.zh: 减税意在刺激经济增长。

words.note: stimulus 复数为 stimuli，常用 a stimulus to。

ex.en: Electric cars are becoming cheaper and more popular.
ex.zh: 电动汽车正变得更便宜、更受欢迎。

words.note: electric 指用电的；electrical 指与电有关的。

ex.en: Many tourists are bewildered by the city's bus system.
ex.zh: 许多游客被这座城市的公交系统弄糊涂了。

words.note: bewilder 指使人完全迷惑，常用 be bewildered by。

words.cn: 团；大量；严格地管制；严密地编组

ex.en: He served in an infantry regiment during the war.
ex.zh: 战争期间他在一个步兵团服役。

words.note: regiment 指军队的团，注意与 regime（政权）区别。

words.cn: 变少；变小；降低；减少；减小；降低

ex.en: The pain gradually diminished after she took the medicine.
ex.zh: 她服药后疼痛渐渐减轻。

words.note: diminish 指逐渐减少减弱，反义词为 increase。

words.cn: 超过；优于；多于；超过…的界限；非…所能办到

ex.en: The film's box office takings surpassed all expectations.
ex.zh: 这部影片的票房超出了所有人的预期。

words.note: surpass 指超越，常用 surpass expectations。

ex.en: The museum displays various kinds of ancient pottery.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出各种古代陶器。

words.note: various 后接可数名词复数，与 varied 不同。

words.cn: 抑郁；沮丧；不景气；萧条；洼地；凹陷

ex.en: Many people suffer from depression during the long winter months.
ex.zh: 许多人在漫长的冬季患上抑郁症。

words.note: depression 兼指抑郁症与经济萧条。

words.cn: 使隶属于；附属机构；分公司

ex.en: The research centre is affiliated with a major university.
ex.zh: 该研究中心隶属于一所重点大学。

words.note: affiliate 常用 be affiliated to/with 表隶属。

ex.en: She unfolded the map and looked for the shortest route.
ex.zh: 她展开地图，寻找最短的路线。

words.note: unfold 指展开、打开，也指情节逐渐展现。

ex.en: To some extent, the success of the project depends on teamwork.
ex.zh: 在某种程度上，项目成败取决于团队合作。

words.note: to some extent 表在某种程度上，为固定短语。

words.cn: 相等的；等量的；相等物；等价物

ex.en: Roughly speaking, one mile is equivalent to 1.6 kilometres.
ex.zh: 粗略来说，一英里约等于1.6公里。

words.note: equivalent 常与 to 连用，可作形容词或名词。

words.cn: 轰动的；耸人听闻的；使人感动的；非常好的

ex.en: The newspaper is full of sensational stories about celebrities.
ex.zh: 这份报纸满是关于名人的耸人听闻的报道。

words.note: sensational 多含耸人听闻的贬义，也可表极好。

ex.en: He drove a wedge between the two old friends with his gossip.
ex.zh: 他散布流言，离间了这两位老朋友。

words.note: drive a wedge between 是习语，指挑拨离间。

words.cn: 使疏远；使不友好；离间；转让；让渡

ex.en: His harsh criticism alienated many of his supporters.
ex.zh: 他尖刻的批评使许多支持者疏远了他。

words.note: alienate 常接 from，指使某人与…疏远。

ex.en: The two countries were on the brink of war.
ex.zh: 两国当时处于战争边缘。

words.note: on the brink of 后接名词或动名词，表濒临。

words.cn: 瘟疫；鼠疫；灾难；祸患；使痛苦；给…造成困难

ex.en: The project was plagued by delays and budget cuts.
ex.zh: 该项目饱受延期和预算削减的困扰。

words.note: plague 作动词常用 be plagued by，表受困扰。

words.cn: 永久的；永恒的；长期的；无休止的；没完没了的

ex.en: They live in perpetual fear of another earthquake.
ex.zh: 他们一直生活在对再次地震的恐惧中。

words.note: perpetual 强调持续不断，常修饰 fear 等词。

ex.en: In retrospect, I should have studied harder for the exam.
ex.zh: 回想起来，我当初该为考试更用功些。

words.note: in retrospect 意为回顾起来，为固定短语。

ex.en: The children were fascinated by the magician's clever tricks.
ex.zh: 孩子们被魔术师的巧妙戏法迷住了。

words.note: fascinate 多用被动式，形容词为 fascinating。

ex.en: The city still has many buildings from the colonial period.
ex.zh: 这座城市仍保留着许多殖民时期的建筑。

words.note: colonial 指殖民地的，名词 colony 为殖民地。

ex.en: The soldiers were trained in jungle warfare before being sent abroad.
ex.zh: 士兵们出国前接受了丛林战训练。

words.note: warfare 指作战方式，多作不可数名词。

words.cn: 草稿；汇票；征兵；通风；起草；征募

ex.en: She wrote the first draft of her essay in one evening.
ex.zh: 她一个晚上就写出了文章的初稿。

words.note: draft 作名词指草稿，常用 first/rough draft。

words.cn: 由许多部分组成的；复合的；复杂的；难懂的；综合体；集合体；情结；夸大的情绪反应

ex.en: Climate change is a complex problem that no single country can solve.
ex.zh: 气候变化是任何单一国家都无法解决的复杂问题。

words.note: complex 作名词可指情结，如 inferiority complex。

ex.en: The plan rests on the assumption that prices will stay low.
ex.zh: 该计划的前提假设是物价将保持低位。

words.note: assumption 常用 on the assumption that 表假定。

ex.en: The heat and humidity made it hard to sleep.
ex.zh: 又热又潮，让人难以入睡。

words.note: humidity 指空气湿度，形容词为 humid。

words.cn: 列入；占特定等级；军衔；职衔；地位；社会阶层；排；行列；把…分等；给…评定等级

ex.en: The university ranks among the best in the country.
ex.zh: 这所大学跻身全国最好的大学之列。

words.note: rank 作动词表排名，常用 rank first/among。

ex.en: Volunteers handed out pamphlets explaining how to save water at home.
ex.zh: 志愿者分发小册子，讲解家庭如何节水。

words.note: pamphlet 指页数少的薄册子，brochure 多为宣传册。

ex.en: The team spent two months on preparatory work before the project began.
ex.zh: 团队在项目开始前花了两个月做准备工作。

words.note: preparatory 常作定语，如 preparatory work。

ex.en: He was criticized for neglecting his duty during the flood.
ex.zh: 他因在洪水期间玩忽职守而受到批评。

words.note: neglect 指疏忽未做；ignore 指故意不理。

ex.en: In addition to teaching, she runs a small language club on weekends.
ex.zh: 除了教书，她周末还办了一个小型语言俱乐部。

words.note: in addition 单独用；in addition to 后接名词。

words.cn: 静脉；血管；叶脉；纹理；纹路；方式；风格

ex.en: His later novels continue in a similar vein, full of quiet humour.
ex.zh: 他后来的小说沿袭相似风格，充满平静的幽默。

words.note: vein 指血管，也指矿脉和文风，如 in the same vein。

ex.en: The artist spent three years carving a statue from a single block of stone.
ex.zh: 这位艺术家花了三年时间，用一整块石头雕出一尊雕像。

words.note: carve 指雕刻或切熟肉；carve out 引申为开创。

words.cn: 面纱；面罩；遮盖物；掩饰物；掩盖；掩饰

ex.en: The government tried to veil the truth behind a vague statement.
ex.zh: 政府试图用含糊的声明掩盖真相。

words.note: veil 作动词表掩盖；draw a veil over 指避而不谈。

ex.en: Wool sweaters may shrink if you wash them in hot water.
ex.zh: 羊毛衫用热水洗可能会缩水。

words.note: shrink 过去式 shrank，过去分词 shrunk，注意不规则。

words.cn: 等级制度；统治集团；领导层

ex.en: In a strict hierarchy, junior staff rarely question their managers openly.
ex.zh: 在严格的等级制度里，下级员工很少公开质疑上司。

words.note: hierarchy 指等级体系，形容词 hierarchical。

ex.en: Scientists believe humans and apes share a common ancestor.
ex.zh: 科学家认为人类与猿类有共同祖先。

words.note: ancestor 指祖先，对应 descendant（后代），别混。

ex.en: Workers must wear gloves when handling hazardous waste.
ex.zh: 处理危险废物时工人必须戴手套。

words.note: hazardous 指对健康有潜在危害，比 dangerous 正式。

ex.en: Most people in the locality depend on farming for their income.
ex.zh: 当地大多数人靠务农为生。

words.note: locality 指附近地区，常用 in the locality。

ex.en: The company started legal proceedings against its former supplier.
ex.zh: 该公司对前供应商提起了法律诉讼。

words.note: proceeding 表诉讼常用复数 proceedings。

ex.en: The new road has become a major artery for traffic into the city.
ex.zh: 这条新路已成为通往市区的主要干道。

words.note: artery 指动脉，也比喻交通干线；形容词 arterial。

words.cn: 恐慌；惊慌失措；恐慌；惊慌；慌乱

ex.en: Shoppers were in a panic when the supermarket announced the closure.
ex.zh: 超市宣布停业时，顾客们惊慌失措。

words.note: panic 过去式 panicked，需先加 k 再加 ed。

words.cn: 对…估计不足；低估；估计不足；低估

ex.en: Never underestimate the difficulty of learning a language as an adult.
ex.zh: 永远不要低估成年后学一门语言的难度。

words.note: underestimate 反义词 overestimate，under- 表不足。

words.cn: 折叠；合拢；褶；折叠的部分

ex.en: She folded the letter carefully and put it in her pocket.
ex.zh: 她小心地把信折好，放进口袋。

words.note: fold up 指折叠收起；unfold 是展开。

words.cn: 短暂的；转瞬即逝的；临时的；暂住的

ex.en: The improvement in air quality was only transient, lasting a few days.
ex.zh: 空气质量的改善只是暂时的，仅持续了几天。

words.note: transient 强调转瞬即逝，比 temporary 更短暂。

ex.en: The boys hurled stones into the river to see who could throw farthest.
ex.zh: 男孩们把石头扔进河里，看谁扔得最远。

words.note: hurl 比 throw 用力更猛；hurl abuse 指辱骂。

words.cn: 竞争的；比赛的；好竞争的；求胜心切的；有竞争力的

ex.en: Firms must keep costs low to survive in a highly competitive market.
ex.zh: 企业必须保持低成本才能在激烈竞争中生存。

words.note: competitive 指竞争激烈或有竞争力，competent 是胜任的。

words.cn: 教长；主任牧师；学院院长；系主任；训导主任

phr.en: the dean of the law school

ex.en: The dean of students met the freshmen to explain the new rules.
ex.zh: 学生事务主任与新生见面，解释新规定。

words.note: dean 指大学院长或系主任，也指教长。

words.cn: 用湿海绵擦；揩；过寄生生活；海绵

ex.en: He lost his job and had to sponge off his friends for months.
ex.zh: 他失业后不得不靠朋友接济好几个月。

words.note: sponge 作动词指揩擦；sponge off 指白吃白拿。

words.cn: 滥用；虐待；辱骂；毁谤；滥用；虐待；辱骂

ex.en: The report accused several officials of the abuse of power.
ex.zh: 报告指控几名官员滥用职权。

words.note: abuse 作名词读 /s/，作动词读 /z/。

words.cn: 密谋；策划；计划；方案；阴谋

ex.en: The two men were arrested for scheming against the government.
ex.zh: 两名男子因密谋反对政府而被捕。

words.note: 英式 scheme 常指正式方案，美式多用 plan。

words.cn: 使绝缘；使隔热；使隔音；隔离；使隔绝

ex.en: Thick curtains help insulate the room against the winter cold.
ex.zh: 厚窗帘有助于让房间与冬季严寒隔绝。

words.note: insulate 指隔热隔音，也指使免受不良影响。

ex.en: Heavy rain hit the region, and consequently the harvest was poor.
ex.zh: 暴雨袭击了该地区，因此收成很差。

words.note: consequently 表结果，正式写作中替代 so。

words.cn: 慢慢减少；排去；放水；渐渐耗尽；耗竭；排水沟；排水管

ex.en: The rain drained away quickly through the new pipes.
ex.zh: 雨水通过新管道很快排走了。

words.note: drain 指排水，也指精力耗尽；brain drain 指人才外流。

ex.en: She agreed to help with some reluctance, saying she was very busy.
ex.zh: 她有些勉强地答应帮忙，说自己很忙。

words.note: reluctance 形容词 reluctant，后接 to do。

ex.en: The court sentenced him to ten years for rape.
ex.zh: 法院以强奸罪判处他十年监禁。

words.note: rape 多用于法律报道，常见 be charged with rape。

ex.en: Patients with the virus were isolated from other people for two weeks.
ex.zh: 感染病毒的病人被隔离两周，与其他人分开。

words.note: isolate 后接 from；名词 isolation，常用 in isolation。

ex.en: Online courses have gained popularity among working adults.
ex.zh: 网络课程在职成年人中越来越受欢迎。

words.note: popularity 常搭 gain/lose popularity。

ex.en: His teammates nicknamed him Tiger because of his speed.
ex.zh: 队友因他速度快，给他起了个绰号叫“老虎”。

words.note: nickname 可作动词，用 nickname sb sth。

ex.en: The first meeting was brief, and subsequent discussions lasted for hours.
ex.zh: 第一次会面很简短，随后的讨论持续了数小时。

words.note: subsequent 后接 to，副词 subsequently。

words.cn: 代谢作用的；新陈代谢的

ex.en: Regular exercise can raise your metabolic rate and help control weight.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼能提高你的代谢率，有助于控制体重。

words.note: metabolic 名词是 metabolism，表代谢的。

words.cn: 人类；人；人性；人道；博爱；人文学科

ex.en: Climate change is one of the greatest challenges facing humanity today.
ex.zh: 气候变化是当今人类面临的最大挑战之一。

words.note: humanity 表人类不可数；the humanities 为人文学科。

words.cn: 新方法；新事物；革新；创新

ex.en: The company invests heavily in technological innovation to stay ahead.
ex.zh: 公司大力投资技术创新以保持领先。

words.note: innovation 可数指新事物，不可数指创新。

words.cn: 乱扔废弃物；乱扔东西；废弃物；被胡乱扔掉的东西；一窝；杂乱的东西

ex.en: Visitors are asked not to drop litter in the park.
ex.zh: 请游客不要在公园里乱扔垃圾。

words.note: litter 作动词指乱扔；英式 litter bin 即垃圾箱。

words.cn: 索价；控告；使充电；使充满；向前冲；费用；管理；控告；指责；电荷；充电

ex.en: The hotel charges extra for breakfast and internet access.
ex.zh: 酒店早餐和上网另收费。

words.note: charge sb for sth 收费；in charge of 表负责。

ex.en: She pressed the shutter just as the sun rose over the hills.
ex.zh: 太阳从山头升起时，她按下了快门。

words.note: shutter 指窗板，也指相机快门。

words.cn: 交替的；轮流的；间隔的；轮流；交替

ex.en: The nurse alternates between day and night shifts every two weeks.
ex.zh: 这位护士每两周在日班和夜班之间轮换。

words.note: alternate 形容词重音在后，动词重音在前。

ex.en: She is writing a biography of the scientist who discovered penicillin.
ex.zh: 她正在写那位发现青霉素的科学家的传记。

words.note: biography 传记，autobiography 是自传。

ex.en: Staff must follow the safety procedure before entering the laboratory.
ex.zh: 员工进入实验室前必须遵守安全程序。

words.note: procedure 指固定步骤，process 强调过程。

words.cn: 样品；试样；样本；从…抽样；品尝；体验

ex.en: The doctor took a blood sample and sent it to the lab.
ex.zh: 医生取了血样，送到实验室。

words.note: sample 作动词可指抽样调查或品尝。

ex.en: Share prices plunged after the company announced its losses.
ex.zh: 公司公布亏损后，股价暴跌。

words.note: plunge 指突然下跌或跳入，常搭 into。

ex.en: Many economists remain skeptical about the accuracy of the forecast.
ex.zh: 许多经济学家仍对预测的准确性持怀疑态度。

words.note: 美式 skeptical，英式 sceptical，后接 about。

ex.en: Too much ultraviolet light can damage your skin and eyes.
ex.zh: 过多的紫外线会损伤皮肤和眼睛。

words.note: ultraviolet 缩写 UV，前缀 ultra- 表超出。

ex.en: Scientists are studying how planetary systems form around young stars.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究行星系统如何围绕年轻恒星形成。

words.note: planetary 由 planet 加 -ary 构成，指行星的。

ex.en: You need to apply for a visa at least a month before you travel.
ex.zh: 你至少要在出行前一个月申请签证。

words.note: visa 可数，常搭 apply for a visa。

ex.en: He was diagnosed with diabetes during a routine medical check.
ex.zh: 他在一次常规体检中被诊断出患有糖尿病。

words.note: diagnose 常搭 be diagnosed with。

words.cn: 请愿；正式请求；请愿书；申请书；诉状

ex.en: More than ten thousand residents signed the petition against the new road.
ex.zh: 一万多名居民签署了反对修建新路的请愿书。

words.note: petition 可作动词，petition sb for sth。

ex.en: There are no hotels in the vicinity of the airport.
ex.zh: 机场附近没有旅馆。

words.note: vicinity 常用 in the vicinity of。

ex.en: It would be naive to expect quick results from such a reform.
ex.zh: 指望这样的改革迅速见效未免太天真。

words.note: naive 指轻信幼稚，childlike 指天真可爱。

words.cn: 必要的；本质的；要素；必需品

ex.en: Clean water is essential to public health in every country.
ex.zh: 清洁的水对每个国家的公共卫生都必不可少。

words.note: essential 后接 to/for；essentials 指必需品。

words.cn: 经费；支出额；花费；支出；消耗

ex.en: The government plans to increase expenditure on education next year.
ex.zh: 政府计划明年增加教育支出。

words.note: expenditure 常与 on 连用，表某方面支出。

words.cn: 通风口；排放口；开衩；表达；发泄

ex.en: He vented his anger on the staff when the plan failed.
ex.zh: 计划失败后，他把怒气发泄在员工身上。

words.note: vent 作动词常搭 on，如 vent anger on sb。

words.cn: 常出没于；使苦恼；使担忧；萦绕在心头；缠绕；常去的地方

ex.en: She was haunted by memories of the accident for years.
ex.zh: 那起事故的回忆多年来一直缠绕着她。

words.note: haunt 指鬼魂出没，也指记忆萦绕心头。

ex.en: A short silence preceded his answer, which made everyone nervous.
ex.zh: 他回答前短暂沉默，让大家有些不安。

words.note: precede 是动词，precedent 是名词先例。

words.cn: 喘气；倒抽气；喘着气说出

ex.en: The audience gasped in surprise when the magician disappeared.
ex.zh: 魔术师消失时，观众惊讶得倒抽一口气。

words.note: gasp for breath 指急促呼吸；名词 gasp。

ex.en: They took a leisurely stroll along the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后他们沿河悠闲散步。

words.note: stroll 指悠闲散步，比 walk 更显轻松。

ex.en: The flat is furnished with a bed, a desk and two chairs.
ex.zh: 这套公寓配有床、书桌和两把椅子。

words.note: furnish sb with sth 表提供；furnished 带家具。

words.cn: 区分；区别；区分；区别；使不同；使有差异

ex.en: Young children cannot always differentiate between fact and fantasy.
ex.zh: 幼儿并不总能区分事实与幻想。

words.note: differentiate 后接 between 或 from，表区分。

words.cn: 接触；联系；交往；与…接触；与…取得联系

ex.en: Please contact the office if your address changes.
ex.zh: 如果你的地址有变，请联系办公室。

words.note: contact 作动词不接 to，直接 contact sb。

ex.en: Workers in the factory must wear protective garments at all times.
ex.zh: 工厂工人必须始终穿着防护服。

words.note: garment 是正式用词，指单件衣物。

words.cn: 释放；排出；卸货；释放；放电

ex.en: The factory was fined for discharging waste into the river.
ex.zh: 这家工厂因向河中排放废物被罚款。

words.note: discharge 指排放或释放，也可指出院。

ex.en: Nobody should be excluded from the club because of their background.
ex.zh: 不应因背景而把任何人排除在俱乐部之外。

words.note: exclude 反义词 include，名词 exclusion。

words.cn: 可怕的；骇人的；惊慌的；害怕的；胆小的；易受惊的

ex.en: Walking home alone at night can be scary for young people.
ex.zh: 夜里独自步行回家对年轻人来说可能很可怕。

words.note: scary 多用于口语，书面可用 frightening。

words.cn: 批评；批判；评论；评论文章

ex.en: The plan drew sharp criticism from local residents.
ex.zh: 该计划招致当地居民的尖锐批评。

words.note: criticism 后接 of，动词是 criticize。

ex.en: The lecture enlightened us about the causes of climate change.
ex.zh: 这场讲座让我们了解了气候变化的成因。

words.note: enlighten sb on/about sth 表使某人明白。

ex.en: Safety is of the utmost importance when working at heights.
ex.zh: 高空作业时，安全至关重要。

words.note: do one's utmost to do 表竭尽全力。

ex.en: The house was shown to prospective buyers over the weekend.
ex.zh: 周末带潜在买家看了这套房子。

words.note: prospective 指未来可能的，如潜在买家。

ex.en: A small amount is deducted from your salary each month for insurance.
ex.zh: 每月从你工资中扣除一小笔钱用于保险。

words.note: deduct 常搭 from；名词 deduction。

words.cn: 灰浆；灰泥；石膏；橡皮膏；膏药；在…上抹灰泥；厚厚地涂抹

ex.en: He broke his wrist and had to wear a plaster cast for six weeks.
ex.zh: 他手腕骨折，打了六周石膏。

words.note: 英式 plaster 指创可贴；plaster cast 是石膏。

ex.en: She left the bank to join a small management consultancy.
ex.zh: 她离开银行，加入一家小型管理咨询公司。

words.note: consultancy 指咨询公司或服务，consultant 是顾问。

words.cn: 大都市的；大都会的；首都的

ex.en: House prices in the metropolitan area have risen sharply.
ex.zh: 大都市区的房价大幅上涨。

words.note: metropolitan 指大城市的，名词 metropolis。

ex.en: The film portrays the scientist as a lonely but brilliant man.
ex.zh: 影片把这位科学家描绘成一个孤独而杰出的人。

words.note: portray sb as 表把某人描绘成。

words.cn: 垃圾；废物；废话；无用的资料

ex.en: Someone has to take out the garbage before the truck arrives.
ex.zh: 得有人赶在垃圾车来之前把垃圾拿出去。

words.note: garbage 是美式用词，英式多用 rubbish。

words.cn: 猜疑的；疑心的；可疑的；表示怀疑的

ex.en: The guards became suspicious of the man standing by the gate.
ex.zh: 警卫对站在门口的那个男人起了疑心。

words.note: be suspicious of sb 表怀疑某人。

words.cn: 用力擦洗；把…擦净；取消；矮树丛；灌木丛

ex.en: She spent the morning scrubbing the kitchen floor by hand.
ex.zh: 她一上午都在用手擦洗厨房地板。

words.note: scrub 指用力刷洗，也指取消计划。

ex.en: Several guests complained about the noise from the street.
ex.zh: 几位客人抱怨街上的噪音。

words.note: complain about sth；向某人投诉用 to sb。

words.cn: 同种类的；同性质的；有相同特征的

ex.en: The population of the town is small and fairly homogeneous.
ex.zh: 这个镇的人口不多，且相当单一。

words.note: homogeneous 反义 heterogeneous，homo 表相同。

words.cn: 断言；坚持声称；证实；确认

ex.en: The report affirms the importance of early education for children.
ex.zh: 报告肯定了幼儿早期教育的重要性。

words.note: affirm 指明确肯定，名词 affirmation。

words.cn: 深度的；深切的；深远的；知识渊博的；见解深刻的；深奥的

ex.en: The invention of printing had a profound effect on European society.
ex.zh: 印刷术的发明对欧洲社会产生了深远影响。

words.note: profound 指影响深远或见解深刻，比 deep 正式。

ex.en: The hall has a marble floor and a high painted ceiling.
ex.zh: 大厅铺着大理石地面，有高高的彩绘天花板。

words.note: marble 作材料不可数，作弹珠可数 marbles。

ex.en: Many students feel anxiety about finding a job after graduation.
ex.zh: 许多学生对毕业后找工作感到焦虑。

words.note: anxiety 后接 about/over，形容词 anxious。

ex.en: It took her a few weeks to adjust to the new climate.
ex.zh: 她花了几周时间才适应新气候。

words.note: adjust to sth 表适应；adjust sth 表调节。

ex.en: Her aspiration is to become a doctor in her home village.
ex.zh: 她的志向是在家乡当一名医生。

words.note: aspiration 常用复数表志向，后接 to do。

words.cn: 朝气蓬勃的；有力的；用力的

ex.en: Doctors recommend at least thirty minutes of vigorous exercise daily.
ex.zh: 医生建议每天至少进行三十分钟的剧烈运动。

words.note: vigorous 指有力或精力充沛，名词 vigour。

words.cn: 喜欢畅所欲言的；直言不讳的；嗓音的；发声的；声乐节目

ex.en: She has been a vocal critic of the plan since it was announced.
ex.zh: 该计划公布以来，她一直是直言不讳的批评者。

words.note: vocal 也指敢于直言的；vocal cords 指声带。

ex.en: The building was deemed unsafe and closed to the public.
ex.zh: 该建筑被认为不安全，已对公众关闭。

words.note: deem 是正式用词，常用 deem sth + adj.。

ex.en: The book traces the origin of the ancient festival.
ex.zh: 这本书追溯了这个古老节日的起源。

words.note: origin 常与 of 连用；original 指最初的。

words.cn: 发生冲突；不协调；砰地相撞；发出刺耳的撞击声；冲突；不协调；刺耳的撞击声

ex.en: Student protesters clashed with police outside the city hall yesterday morning.
ex.zh: 昨天上午，抗议学生在市政厅外与警察发生冲突。

words.note: 多指意见、利益冲突，也指双方人马相撞。

words.cn: 倾覆；翻转；翻倒；使翻转；使倾覆；使倒下；颠覆；推翻

ex.en: The appeal court overturned the original verdict after reviewing new evidence.
ex.zh: 上诉法院在审查新证据后推翻了原判决。

words.note: 本义是翻转，引申为推翻判决、决定或政权。

ex.en: Bad weather compelled the airline to cancel several flights this morning.
ex.zh: 恶劣天气迫使航空公司取消了今天上午的多趟航班。

words.note: 用法是 compel sb to do sth，被动表被迫。

ex.en: The steady rise in prices has depressed consumer spending across the country.
ex.zh: 物价持续上涨压低了全国的消费支出。

words.note: de-(向下)加 press(压)：压下、使沮丧、使不景气。

ex.en: She is perfectly capable of handling the project on her own.
ex.zh: 她完全有能力独自处理这个项目。

words.note: 常用 be capable of doing，比 able 更强调能力。

words.cn: 重担；精神负担；加重压于；烦扰；负担；装载

ex.en: Rising rents have become a heavy burden on young families in big cities.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的房租已成为大城市年轻家庭的沉重负担。

words.note: 可数名词，常用 a burden on sb；动词表使负担。

words.cn: 敬礼；致意；向…敬礼；向…致意；赞扬；颂扬

ex.en: The soldiers saluted the flag as the national anthem began to play.
ex.zh: 国歌奏响时，士兵们向国旗敬礼。

words.note: 指军队敬礼或公开赞扬，salute sb for sth 表赞扬。

words.cn: 扣子；钩子；紧抱；紧握；抱紧；握紧；扣住；扣紧

ex.en: She clasped the letter tightly in her hands and began to cry.
ex.zh: 她把信紧紧握在手里，哭了起来。

words.note: 作名词指搭扣，作动词指紧握、抱紧。

words.cn: 讨论会；专题报告会；专题论文集

ex.en: The university will hold a symposium on climate change next month.
ex.zh: 这所大学下个月将举办一场关于气候变化的研讨会。

words.note: 指学术性研讨会，比 meeting 更专、规模更小。

words.cn: 翱翔；逗留在近旁；徘徊；彷徨；犹豫

ex.en: A helicopter hovered over the stadium during the whole match.
ex.zh: 整场比赛期间，一架直升机在体育场上空盘旋。

words.note: 指鸟或飞机在空中盘旋，也指人在近处徘徊。

ex.en: Officers stopped drivers at random to check their licences.
ex.zh: 执法人员随机拦下司机检查驾照。

words.note: at random 表随机地，random 一般无比较级。

ex.en: We dined at a small restaurant near the river last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我们在河边一家小餐馆用餐。

words.note: dine out 指外出用餐，dine with sb 与某人共餐。

ex.en: Her warm personality makes her popular with both clients and colleagues.
ex.zh: 她热情的性格使她深受客户和同事的欢迎。

words.note: 指个人稳定的性格，也可指名人；作名词可数。

words.cn: 批准；认可；批准；认可；约束因素；约束力；国际制裁

ex.en: The government imposed sanctions on several companies for breaking trade rules.
ex.zh: 政府因多家公司违反贸易规定而对其实施制裁。

words.note: 作制裁义常用复数 sanctions，作批准义表许可。

words.cn: 警觉的；留神的；注意的；使认识到；使意识到；警戒；戒备；警报

ex.en: Drivers should stay alert when the road is covered with ice.
ex.zh: 路面结冰时，司机应保持警惕。

words.note: stay alert 保持警惕，be on alert 处于戒备状态。

ex.en: From these clues the detective deduced who had entered the room.
ex.zh: 侦探根据这些线索推断出谁进过这个房间。

words.note: de-(出)加 duce(引导)：把结论引出来，即推断。

ex.en: An old oak tree still stands in the middle of the village.
ex.zh: 村子中央仍矗立着一棵老橡树。

words.note: 指栎树或橡木；作树木可数，作木材不可数。

ex.en: The lawyer met her client to discuss the details of the case.
ex.zh: 律师与当事人会面，讨论案件的细节。

words.note: 指律师、银行的客户或委托人，一般不指普通顾客。

words.cn: 小口地喝；抿；呷；小口喝；一小口的量

ex.en: She sipped her tea slowly while reading the morning paper.
ex.zh: 她一边看晨报，一边慢慢啜着茶。

words.note: 指小口地喝，take a sip 即喝一小口。

ex.en: He was a dutiful son who visited his parents every weekend.
ex.zh: 他是个孝顺的儿子，每个周末都去看望父母。

words.note: 由 duty(责任)加 -ful 构成：尽职的、恭顺的。

words.cn: 争夺；竞争；搏斗；争斗；声称；主张

ex.en: Critics contend that the new law will hurt small businesses.
ex.zh: 批评者认为新法将损害小企业。

words.note: contend with 应对困难，contend that 主张、声称。

words.cn: 转变；变换；改变信仰；皈依

phr.en: the conversion of A into B

ex.en: The conversion of the old factory into apartments took three years.
ex.zh: 把旧工厂改造成公寓花了三年时间。

words.note: con-(完全)加 vert(转)：彻底转变，也指皈依。

ex.en: She came up with a brilliant idea for cutting production costs.
ex.zh: 她想出了一个降低生产成本的妙主意。

words.note: 强调才华出众或光线明亮，口语里也表很棒。

words.cn: 赌博；打赌；投机；冒险；赌；以…为赌注；赌博；投机；冒险

ex.en: Investing all his savings in one company was a huge gamble.
ex.zh: 把所有积蓄投进一家公司是一场巨大的赌博。

words.note: gamble on 表冒险押注，take a gamble 冒险一试。

words.cn: 一定的；有义务的；跳跃；弹回；反跃；成为…的界限；给…划界；跳跃；界限；限制

ex.en: Prices are bound to rise if the drought continues another month.
ex.zh: 如果干旱再持续一个月，价格必然上涨。

words.note: be bound to do 表必定，be bound by 表受约束。

words.cn: 规格；规范；明确说明；说明书

ex.en: The parts were rejected because they did not meet the specifications.
ex.zh: 这些零件因不符合规格而被退回。

words.note: 常用复数，meet the specifications 指符合规格。

ex.en: Two foreign workers were deported for entering the country illegally.
ex.zh: 两名外籍工人因非法入境被驱逐出境。

words.note: 指把外国人驱逐出境，deport sb from a country。

ex.en: She bought two tickets at the counter near the entrance.
ex.zh: 她在入口附近的柜台买了两张票。

words.note: 指柜台或计数器，over the counter 指非处方。

ex.en: The drummer kept a steady rhythm throughout the whole song.
ex.zh: 鼓手在整首歌中保持了稳定的节奏。

words.note: 指节奏、韵律，重音在首音节，拼写注意 th。

ex.en: The doctor explained the operation in layman's terms so the family could understand.
ex.zh: 医生用通俗的话解释手术，好让家属听懂。

words.note: in layman's terms 指用外行也听得懂的话说。

ex.en: Simple changes at home can help conserve water and electricity.
ex.zh: 家中一些简单的改变有助于节约水和电。

words.note: 指保护自然资源或节约能源，比 save 更正式。

words.cn: 中风；一举；一次努力；划桨；划水；击；敲；报时的钟声；笔画；一笔；抚摸；抚摸

ex.en: He suffered a stroke last year but has recovered almost completely.
ex.zh: 他去年中风，但已基本康复。

words.note: 指中风、一击或笔画，a stroke of luck 指运气。

words.cn: 繁殖；养育；培育；酿成；产生；品种

ex.en: The farm breeds horses for racing and for sale abroad.
ex.zh: 这家农场繁育赛马，并销往国外。

words.note: 过去式与过去分词同为 bred，注意这一不规则变化。

ex.en: The boys teased him about his new haircut all through lunch.
ex.zh: 整个午饭时间男孩们都拿他的新发型取笑他。

words.note: tease sb about sth 拿某事取笑某人，语气较轻。

words.cn: 轻率的；鲁莽的；疹；皮疹；爆发的一连串

ex.en: Do not make a rash decision before you know all the facts.
ex.zh: 弄清全部事实之前不要草率做决定。

words.note: 作形容词指轻率鲁莽，作名词指皮疹。

ex.en: The fragrance of jasmine filled the whole garden after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后茉莉的芳香弥漫整个花园。

words.note: 指好闻的香味，比 smell 更雅，作名词可数。

words.cn: 管理；处理；管理部门；管理人员

ex.en: Good time management helps students balance study and part-time work.
ex.zh: 良好的时间管理帮助学生在学习和兼职之间取得平衡。

words.note: 指管理或管理层，作主语时谓语可用复数。

ex.en: The mechanic found a crack in one of the engine cylinders.
ex.zh: 机械师发现其中一个发动机气缸有裂缝。

words.note: 指圆柱体或气缸，gas cylinder 指煤气罐。

ex.en: The soldiers defended the fort against repeated attacks for weeks.
ex.zh: 士兵们数周来抵御一次又一次进攻，守住了堡垒。

words.note: 指堡垒；hold the fort 指临时顶替负责。

ex.en: Leave home early to avoid the rush hour traffic.
ex.zh: 早点出门以避开高峰时段的交通。

words.note: 后接动名词 avoid doing，不能接不定式。

ex.en: The government ordered a comprehensive review of the safety rules.
ex.zh: 政府下令对安全规定进行全面审查。

words.note: 强调全面广泛，comprehensible 则指可理解。

ex.en: Workers spent five years digging a tunnel through the mountain.
ex.zh: 工人们花了五年时间挖通一条穿山隧道。

words.note: 作动词表挖隧道，过去式可双写 l 再加 ed。

ex.en: The teacher assigned each group a different topic for the presentation.
ex.zh: 老师给每个小组分配了不同的演讲题目。

words.note: assign sth to sb 把某物分给某人，也可指布置。

ex.en: She withdrew some cash from the bank before catching her train.
ex.zh: 她在赶火车前去银行取了些现金。

words.note: 指撤回或取钱，过去式为 withdrew。

words.cn: 正直的；坦率的；易懂的；简单的

ex.en: The instructions were so straightforward that anyone could follow them.
ex.zh: 说明非常简明，任何人都能照做。

words.note: 由 straight 加 forward 构成，表直截了当。

words.cn: 复杂的；精心制作的；详述；详细制定

ex.en: The architect showed us an elaborate design for the new library.
ex.zh: 建筑师向我们展示了新图书馆的精巧设计。

words.note: 作形容词表精心制作的，elaborate on 指详述。

ex.en: She is an expert in international trade law and teaches at the university.
ex.zh: 她是国际贸易法专家，并在大学任教。

words.note: an expert in/on sth 指某领域的专家。

ex.en: The city's population has doubled over the past two decades.
ex.zh: 过去二十年里，这座城市的人口翻了一番。

words.note: 指十年，复数 decades，常用 over the past decade。

words.cn: 履行；实现；完成；满足；使满意

ex.en: He finally fulfilled his childhood dream of becoming a pilot.
ex.zh: 他终于实现了儿时成为飞行员的梦想。

words.note: 指履行义务或实现愿望，英式拼作 fulfil。

words.cn: 聚集；挤；涌；群；一批；挤；挤满

ex.en: A large crowd gathered outside the stadium to welcome the players.
ex.zh: 一大群人聚集在体育场外欢迎球员。

words.note: a crowd of 指一群人，be crowded with 表挤满。

ex.en: Scientists from forty countries attended the congress on cancer research.
ex.zh: 来自四十个国家的科学家参加了这次癌症研究大会。

words.note: 指代表大会或国会，特指机构时首字母大写。

words.cn: 机械的；机械制造的；机械学的；力学的；呆板的

ex.en: The flight was delayed by a minor mechanical problem in the engine.
ex.zh: 航班因发动机的一个小机械故障而延误。

words.note: 指机械的，也形容动作呆板、缺乏感情。

words.cn: 神的；神授的；天赐的；极好的；极美的

ex.en: Ancient kings often claimed that their power came from divine will.
ex.zh: 古代国王常宣称自己的权力来自神的意志。

words.note: 指神的、天赐的，口语里也表极好的。

ex.en: The novel describes the slaughter of thousands during the civil war.
ex.zh: 这部小说描写了内战期间数千人被屠杀的惨状。

words.note: 指屠杀或屠宰，语气强烈，多用于负面。

words.cn: 难闻的；发臭的；令人不愉快的；糟透了的；污浊的；肮脏的；下流的；辱骂性的；恶劣的；有暴风雨的；邪恶的；罪恶的；对…犯规；弄脏；弄污；犯规

ex.en: A foul smell from the river made the whole neighbourhood complain.
ex.zh: 河水散发的臭味让整个街区怨声载道。

words.note: foul 指气味难闻，foul play 指犯规或谋杀。

words.cn: 产量；输出；输出功率；输出

ex.en: The factory increased its output by twenty percent last year.
ex.zh: 这家工厂去年产量提高了百分之二十。

words.note: 指产量或输出，与 input 相对，通常不可数。

words.cn: 错综复杂的；复杂精细的

ex.en: The carpet was covered with an intricate pattern of flowers and birds.
ex.zh: 地毯上布满了花鸟的繁复图案。

words.note: 强调细节繁多而复杂，多形容图案、情节。

ex.en: After the long march, many soldiers suffered from extreme fatigue.
ex.zh: 长途行军后，许多士兵极度疲劳。

words.note: 不可数名词，指极度疲劳，比 tiredness 正式。

ex.en: He lay in agony on the ground until the ambulance arrived.
ex.zh: 他躺在地上痛苦不堪，直到救护车赶到。

words.note: 指剧痛或精神折磨，in agony 表极度痛苦。

words.cn: 盘算；计议；思量；对…周密考虑；注视；凝视

ex.en: She is contemplating moving to another city for a better job.
ex.zh: 她正在考虑搬到另一座城市，以获得更好的工作。

words.note: contemplate doing sth 考虑做某事，较正式。

ex.en: The majority of members voted in favour of the new budget.
ex.zh: 大多数成员投票支持新预算。

words.note: the majority of 后接复数名词，谓语随之用复数。

words.cn: 拖；拉；迫使；硬拉；拖着脚步走；累赘；一吸；一抽

ex.en: We dragged the heavy box across the floor to the door.
ex.zh: 我们把沉重的箱子拖过地板，拉到门口。

words.note: drag one's feet 指故意拖延，drag out 指拖长。

ex.en: The roof is covered with zinc sheets that shine in the sun.
ex.zh: 屋顶覆盖着在阳光下闪亮的锌板。

words.note: 不可数名词，指锌，化学符号为 Zn。

words.cn: 服装；服饰；戏装；成套服装

ex.en: The children wore colourful costumes in the school play last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚孩子们在学校演出中穿着色彩鲜艳的戏服。

words.note: 指戏服或民族服装，不指日常穿的衣服。

words.cn: 夹紧；夹住；固定；夹头；夹具；夹钳

ex.en: The city has clamped down on cars parked on the pavement.
ex.zh: 该市已严厉打击在人行道上停车的行为。

words.note: clamp down on 指严厉打击，本义是用夹具夹紧。

words.cn: 发行；分发；发出；问题；发行；分发

ex.en: The company issued a statement denying the rumours about layoffs.
ex.zh: 公司发表声明，否认有关裁员的传言。

words.note: 作名词指议题，作动词指发布、发放。

ex.en: He showed great maturity in the way he handled the criticism.
ex.zh: 他处理批评的方式显示出极大的成熟。

words.note: 指成熟，reach maturity 表达到成熟期。

ex.en: They searched in vain for the missing child for three days.
ex.zh: 他们搜寻了三天，仍未找到走失的孩子。

words.note: in vain 指徒劳无功，vain 也可指自负的。

words.cn: 法令；政令；判决；裁决；判决；命令

ex.en: The government issued a decree banning single-use plastics.
ex.zh: 政府颁布法令，禁止使用一次性塑料制品。

words.note: 指官方法令或判决，语气正式，多用于政府。

words.cn: 保存；保护；避免浪费；守恒

ex.en: The group works on wildlife conservation in the mountains.
ex.zh: 该组织从事山区的野生动物保护工作。

words.note: 指保护与节约，注意与 conversation 区分。

words.cn: 增补；补充；增刊；副刊；增补；补充

ex.en: He took a part-time job to supplement his income.
ex.zh: 他做了一份兼职来补贴收入。

words.note: 作动词指补充增补，名词指补充物或增刊。

words.cn: 形成对比；对比之下显出区别；对比；对照；反差[kən'trɑːst]；对比；对照

ex.en: In contrast to his brother, Tom enjoys quiet evenings at home.
ex.zh: 与弟弟不同，汤姆喜欢在家安静地度过夜晚。

words.note: in contrast to 表对比，by contrast 表相比之下。

ex.en: The jury reached a verdict after six hours of discussion.
ex.zh: 陪审团经过六小时讨论后作出裁决。

words.note: 指陪审团的裁定，也可指最终的定论。

words.cn: 立体的；立体声的；立体声

ex.en: He turned up the stereo and the whole room shook.
ex.zh: 他把音响的声音调大，整个房间都震动了。

words.note: 指立体声音响，in stereo 表以立体声播放。

words.cn: 违抗；蔑视；使成为不可能；惹；激

ex.en: Some drivers openly defy the speed limits in this area.
ex.zh: 这一地区有些司机公然违反限速规定。

words.note: 指违抗；defy description 表美得难以描述。

ex.en: The party has never questioned its basic economic doctrine.
ex.zh: 该党从未质疑过自己的基本经济信条。

words.note: 指教义或主义，多用于宗教、政治领域。

ex.en: Please read the first paragraph and answer the questions below.
ex.zh: 请阅读第一段，并回答下面的问题。

words.note: 由 para-(旁)加 graph(写)构成，指段落。

words.cn: 调解；斡旋；经调解解决；经斡旋促成

ex.en: A senior official was sent to mediate between the two sides.
ex.zh: 一位高级官员被派去在双方之间调解。

words.note: mediate between 指在双方间调解，名词为 mediator。

words.cn: 追求；寻求；追赶；追逐；事；嗜好；消遣

ex.en: She moved abroad in pursuit of a better career.
ex.zh: 为了追求更好的职业，她移居国外。

words.note: in pursuit of 表追求，动词形式为 pursue。

ex.en: In ancient times people often turned to a prophet for guidance.
ex.zh: 古时候人们常向先知寻求指引。

words.note: 指先知、预言者，注意与 profit 区分。

words.cn: 自行车、 摩托车；循环

ex.en: Lack of sleep can create a vicious cycle of stress and illness.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足会造成压力与疾病的恶性循环。

words.note: 指循环或自行车，vicious cycle 指恶性循环。

words.cn: 放大；增强；扩大；详述；进一步阐述

ex.en: The speakers amplified her voice so that everyone could hear.
ex.zh: 扩音器把她的声音放大，让每个人都能听见。

words.note: 指放大声音，也指增强效果或详述观点。

words.cn: 吸引；引诱；诱惑；吸引力；诱惑物；诱饵；鱼饵

ex.en: Higher salaries lured many young engineers to the private sector.
ex.zh: 更高的薪水吸引了许多年轻工程师进入私营部门。

words.note: lure sb into doing 指诱使某人做某事，多含贬义。

words.cn: 丢掉；销毁；处理；排列；布置

ex.en: Proper waste disposal is a serious problem in many cities.
ex.zh: 妥善处理垃圾在许多城市都是严峻的问题。

words.note: at sb's disposal 表供某人使用，也指处理。

words.cn: 解决；协议；居留地；小社区

ex.en: The two firms reached a settlement out of court last week.
ex.zh: 两家公司上周在庭外达成和解。

words.note: reach a settlement 指达成和解，动词为 settle。

words.cn: 旋转；急转；发晕；变混乱；旋转；回旋；混乱；一连串的事

ex.en: The dancers whirled around the floor to the music.
ex.zh: 舞者们伴着音乐在地板上旋转。

words.note: 指快速旋转，也指思绪纷乱；in a whirl 表忙乱。

words.cn: 退；退去；渐渐远去；向后倾斜；缩进

ex.en: As the flood waters receded, villagers returned to their homes.
ex.zh: 洪水退去后，村民返回了家园。

words.note: 指潮水退去、记忆变淡或发际线后移。

words.cn: 文学；文学作品；文献；图书资料

ex.en: She studied English literature at university and later became a teacher.
ex.zh: 她在大学学习英国文学，后来当了老师。

words.note: 指文学或文献，为不可数名词，没有复数形式。

ex.en: It took me a while to digest all the information in the report.
ex.zh: 我花了一段时间才消化报告中的全部信息。

words.note: 作动词读 /daɪˈdʒest/，作名词时指文摘。

words.cn: 大幅度下降；暴跌；突然倒下；萧条期；低潮

ex.en: Sales slumped sharply after the new tax was introduced.
ex.zh: 新税实施后销量大幅下跌。

words.note: 指销量、价格暴跌，也指经济萧条期。

words.cn: 偏见；成见；使有偏见；对…不利；损害

ex.en: She grew up in a small town where prejudice against outsiders was common.
ex.zh: 她在一个对外来者常有偏见的小镇长大。

words.note: prejudice 常与 against 连用，表对某群体的成见。

words.cn: 净空；余隙；许可；批准；票据交换；清算；清除；清理；出空

ex.en: The goods were held at the border until customs clearance was completed.
ex.zh: 这批货物在边境被扣留，直到完成清关。

words.note: clearance 指清理或官方许可，由动词 clear 加 -ance 构成。

words.cn: 习惯上的；惯常的；合乎习俗的

ex.en: In this region it is customary to remove your shoes before entering a home.
ex.zh: 在这个地区，进屋前脱鞋是一种习俗。

words.note: customary 来自 custom（习俗），多形容合乎惯例的做法。

ex.en: Many immigrant families work hard to give their children a better education.
ex.zh: 许多移民家庭努力工作，为了让孩子接受更好的教育。

words.note: immigrant 指移入者，emigrant 指移出者，两者方向相反。

ex.en: The court appointed her uncle as the child's legal guardian.
ex.zh: 法院指定她的叔叔为孩子的法定监护人。

words.note: guardian 由 guard 加 -ian 构成，法律上专指监护人。

ex.en: The president threatened to veto the bill if it reached his desk.
ex.zh: 总统威胁说，如果该法案送到他桌上，他将予以否决。

words.note: veto 复数形式为 vetoes；作名词常与 exercise 连用。

ex.en: A thorn stuck in his finger as he picked the roses.
ex.zh: 他摘玫瑰时一根刺扎进了手指。

words.note: a thorn in one's side 指长期令人烦恼的人或事。

words.cn: 性情；性格；意向；倾向；排列；部署

ex.en: Her cheerful disposition makes her popular with both colleagues and clients.
ex.zh: 她开朗的性格使她受到同事和客户的欢迎。

words.note: disposition 指天生性情，也可指财产处置或部队部署。

words.cn: 法人团体的；公司的；全体的；共同的

ex.en: The new manager tried to change the corporate culture from the top down.
ex.zh: 新经理试图自上而下改变企业文化。

words.note: corporate 来自 corporation，指公司的、法人的，也可指全体的。

ex.en: The central bank raised interest rates to stabilize the economy.
ex.zh: 央行提高利率以稳定经济。

words.note: stabilize 由 stable 加 -ize 构成，英式拼写为 stabilise。

ex.en: Nothing can compensate for the loss of a close friend.
ex.zh: 失去挚友是任何东西都无法弥补的。

words.note: compensate for 表示弥补不足或损失，后接名词或动名词。

words.cn: 意识到的；自觉的；神志清醒的；有意的；存心的

ex.en: She was conscious of someone watching her from across the street.
ex.zh: 她意识到街对面有人在看着她。

words.note: be conscious of 后接名词或动名词，反义词为 unconscious。

ex.en: The bank charges a small fee for every international transaction.
ex.zh: 银行对每笔国际交易收取少量手续费。

words.note: transaction 由 trans-（跨越）加 act 构成，指买卖或业务往来。

words.cn: 经常的；不断的；连续发生的；永恒的；忠实的；忠诚的；常数；恒量

ex.en: The machine keeps the room at a constant temperature day and night.
ex.zh: 这台机器昼夜把房间保持在恒温状态。

words.note: constant 强调持续不断，continual 指反复发生但有间断。

words.cn: 向…贿赂；买通；贿赂；行贿物

ex.en: The official was arrested for taking a bribe from a local businessman.
ex.zh: 这名官员因收受当地商人的贿赂而被捕。

words.note: bribe 可作名词和动词，bribe sb into doing 指买通某人做某事。

ex.en: A doctor must certify that the patient is fit to travel.
ex.zh: 必须由医生证明该病人适合出行。

words.note: certify 后常接 that 从句，或用 certify sb/sth as sth。

ex.en: The intermittent noise from the building site made it hard to concentrate.
ex.zh: 工地断断续续的噪音让人难以集中注意力。

words.note: intermittent 由 inter- 加 mitt（送）构成，指时断时续的。

words.cn: 义愤；愤慨；暴行；骇人听闻的事件；激起…的义愤；激怒

ex.en: The decision to close the library sparked public outrage across the city.
ex.zh: 关闭图书馆的决定在全市激起了公愤。

words.note: outrage 作名词指义愤，作动词指激怒，形容词为 outrageous。

words.cn: 单独的；独自的；单个的；唯一的；孤独的；隐居的

ex.en: He lived a solitary life in a cabin far from the village.
ex.zh: 他在远离村庄的小屋里过着孤独的生活。

words.note: solitary 强调独自一人；alone 只作表语，不能作定语。

words.cn: 扩散；弥漫；传播；散布；冗长的；漫无边际的；四散的；弥漫的

ex.en: The internet has made it easier to diffuse knowledge around the world.
ex.zh: 互联网使知识在全球传播变得更容易。

words.note: diffuse 作动词指扩散、传播，作形容词指分散的、冗长的。

words.cn: 攀登；爬；争夺；抢夺；扰乱；搞乱；攀登；爬行；争夺；抢夺

ex.en: Investors scramble for safe assets whenever the market falls sharply.
ex.zh: 每当市场大幅下跌，投资者就争相抢购安全资产。

words.note: scramble 指手脚并用攀爬或慌乱争抢，常用 scramble for sth。

ex.en: The orchestra played for nearly two hours before the audience went home.
ex.zh: 管弦乐队演奏了近两个小时，观众才散去。

words.note: orchestra 指管弦乐队，在美式英语中也可指剧场前座。

words.cn: 使浸没；使沉浸在；使专心于

ex.en: She immersed herself in her research and forgot to eat lunch.
ex.zh: 她埋头研究，忘了吃午饭。

words.note: immerse 本指浸入液体，引申为专心于，常接 oneself in。

ex.en: There is not sufficient evidence to prove that he was involved.
ex.zh: 没有足够的证据证明他参与其中。

words.note: sufficient 比 enough 正式，常用 sufficient for。

words.cn: 元帅；最高指挥官；总指挥；司仪；执法官；警察局长；消防队长；整理；排列；集结

ex.en: He took a deep breath to marshal his thoughts before speaking.
ex.zh: 他深吸一口气，在发言前整理思路。

words.note: marshal 作动词指整理、集结，注意词尾只有一个 l。

ex.en: They opened a bottle of champagne to celebrate the deal.
ex.zh: 他们开了一瓶香槟庆祝交易达成。

words.note: champagne 源自法国产地名，指香槟酒，通常不可数。

words.cn: 声称；主张；对…提出要求；索取；使失踪或死亡；需要；值得；要求；认领；索赔；声称；断言

ex.en: The company claims that the new battery lasts twice as long.
ex.zh: 该公司声称新电池的续航时间翻了一倍。

words.note: claim 后接 that 从句或 to do，作名词可表索赔或主张。

ex.en: The new policy has won widespread support among young voters.
ex.zh: 新政策赢得了年轻选民的广泛支持。

words.note: widespread 由 wide 加 spread 合成，常修饰 support。

words.cn: 古时的；古老的；古物；古玩；古董

ex.en: She bought an antique chair at a small shop near the market.
ex.zh: 她在市场附近的小店里买了一把古董椅子。

words.note: antique 指有年代的器物，ancient 指古代的，两者不可混用。

words.cn: 通讯；交流；交际；通信工具；交通联系

ex.en: Good communication between parents and children prevents many problems.
ex.zh: 亲子之间良好的沟通可以避免许多问题。

words.note: communication 表交流时多不可数，指通讯系统时常用复数。

words.cn: 慢性的；久病的；长久的；不断的；积习难改的

ex.en: The city faces a chronic shortage of affordable housing.
ex.zh: 这座城市长期缺乏可负担的住房。

words.note: chronic 指长期的、慢性的，反义词为 acute（急性的）。

ex.en: The factory was fined for dumping toxic waste into the river.
ex.zh: 该工厂因向河中倾倒有毒废料而被罚款。

words.note: toxic 指有毒的，源自 toxin（毒素），可引申为有害的。

words.cn: 竞赛；争夺；争夺；与…竞争；对…提出质疑；辩驳

ex.en: Hundreds of students entered the speech contest this year.
ex.zh: 今年有数百名学生参加了演讲比赛。

words.note: contest 作名词重音在前，作动词重音在后，意为质疑。

ex.en: The author spent five years collecting material for the book.
ex.zh: 这位作者花了五年时间为这本书收集素材。

words.note: author 指作者、著作家，比 writer 更正式。

words.cn: 杠；杠杆；途径；手段；工具；撬动；撬起

ex.en: He pulled the lever and the heavy door slowly opened.
ex.zh: 他一拉操纵杆，沉重的门慢慢打开了。

words.note: lever 指杠杆，也可喻为施加影响的手段或筹码。

words.cn: 保护；维持；保存；保藏；腌制

ex.en: The village has worked hard to preserve its traditional culture.
ex.zh: 这个村庄一直努力保护自己的传统文化。

words.note: preserve 强调保持原状、免遭破坏，也可指腌制食物。

ex.en: The two universities established a joint research center last year.
ex.zh: 这两所大学去年成立了一个联合研究中心。

words.note: establish 后接机构、关系、事实等，注意词尾是 -ish。

ex.en: Rapid expansion brought the company new markets and new problems.
ex.zh: 快速扩张给公司带来了新市场，也带来了新问题。

words.note: expansion 来自 expand，注意与 expenditure（支出）区分。

words.cn: 猛拧；猛扭；挣脱；使扭伤；痛苦；难受；猛扭；猛拉；扳手

ex.en: He wrenched the door open and rushed out of the burning room.
ex.zh: 他猛地拉开门，冲出燃烧的房间。

words.note: wrench 指猛扭，也指扳手，过去式为 wrenched。

ex.en: Please include only information that is relevant to the question.
ex.zh: 请只写与问题相关的信息。

words.note: relevant 常与 to 连用，反义词为 irrelevant。

ex.en: The company plans to expand into overseas markets next year.
ex.zh: 公司计划明年向海外市场扩张。

words.note: expand 可指规模扩大，也可指气体膨胀，名词为 expansion。

ex.en: She stood at the window and gazed at the falling snow.
ex.zh: 她站在窗前，凝视着飘落的雪花。

words.note: gaze 指长时间凝视，常与 at 连用，比 look 更专注。

ex.en: The government proclaimed a state of emergency after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水过后，政府宣布进入紧急状态。

words.note: proclaim 多用于正式宣布重大事项，比 announce 更庄重。

words.cn: 地方行政官；地方法官；治安官

ex.en: The case was heard by a magistrate in the small town court.
ex.zh: 此案由小镇法庭的一名地方法官审理。

words.note: magistrate 指基层法官或治安官，处理较轻的案件。

words.cn: 重新得到；取回；收回；挽回；补救；检索

ex.en: The program can retrieve data from the server in seconds.
ex.zh: 这个程序能在几秒内从服务器检索数据。

words.note: retrieve 指取回、找回，也指检索数据，名词为 retrieval。

words.cn: 俯瞰；眺望；全面审视；调查；测量；勘定；[sə'veɪ]

ex.en: Researchers conducted a survey of two thousand college students.
ex.zh: 研究人员对两千名大学生进行了一项调查。

words.note: survey 作名词重音在前，作动词可指审视，重音偏后。

ex.en: Skipping safety checks could jeopardize the lives of the crew.
ex.zh: 跳过安全检查可能会危及机组人员的生命。

words.note: jeopardize 由 jeopardy（危险）加 -ize 构成，意为危及。

words.cn: 当间谍；暗中监视；间谍；看见；发现

ex.en: The neighbors complained that someone was spying on them at night.
ex.zh: 邻居们抱怨有人在夜里监视他们。

words.note: spy 作动词常用 spy on sb，作名词指间谍。

words.cn: 取代；替代；迫使…离开家园；使离开原位

ex.en: Rising sea levels could displace thousands of people along the coast.
ex.zh: 海平面上升可能使沿海数千人被迫迁移。

words.note: displace 指取代或迫使迁离原处，名词为 displacement。

ex.en: Agriculture remains the predominant industry in this part of the country.
ex.zh: 农业仍然是该国这一地区的主导产业。

words.note: predominant 指占主导地位的，名词为 predominance。

words.cn: 烹饪法；食谱；方法；秘诀；诀窍

ex.en: This soup is easy to make if you follow the recipe carefully.
ex.zh: 只要照着食谱仔细做，这道汤很容易做。

words.note: recipe 指食谱，也比喻方法，a recipe for 后常接灾难。

ex.en: The two parties differ sharply in their political ideology.
ex.zh: 两党在政治意识形态上差异很大。

words.note: ideology 指系统的思想观念体系，常与 political 连用。

words.cn: 心理的；精神的；思想上的；精神病的；智力的

ex.en: Schools are paying more attention to students' mental health.
ex.zh: 学校越来越关注学生的心理健康。

words.note: mental 指心理的、精神的，与 physical（身体的）相对。

words.cn: 像样的；过得去的；体面的；宽厚的；大方的；正派的；合乎礼仪的；得体的

ex.en: Everyone deserves a decent job and a safe place to live.
ex.zh: 每个人都应有一份像样的工作和安全的住所。

words.note: decent 指还过得去的、得体的，注意别与 descent 混用。

ex.en: The old tent was leaking along every seam after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后，旧帐篷的每条接缝都在漏水。

words.note: seam 指缝线、接缝，burst at the seams 指过于拥挤。

ex.en: Police will investigate the cause of the fire in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 警方将调查仓库失火的原因。

words.note: investigate 后直接接宾语，名词为 investigation。

ex.en: The law was passed to end racial discrimination in hiring.
ex.zh: 该法律旨在终止招聘中的种族歧视。

words.note: racial 来自 race（种族），注意与 ethnic（民族的）区分。

words.cn: 幻想；错误的观念；错觉；幻觉；假象

ex.en: The mirror created the illusion that the room was twice its size.
ex.zh: 镜子造成假象，仿佛房间大了一倍。

words.note: illusion 指错觉、假象；delusion 指精神上的妄想。

ex.en: The project required a considerable amount of time and money.
ex.zh: 这个项目需要大量的时间和金钱。

words.note: considerable 意为相当大的；considerate 意为体贴的。

ex.en: New machinery greatly increased the factory's productivity last year.
ex.zh: 新机器大大提高了工厂去年的生产率。

words.note: productivity 指生产率，由 productive 加 -ity 构成。

words.cn: 论点；主张；建议；提案；命题

ex.en: The board rejected the proposition as too risky and too expensive.
ex.zh: 董事会否决了这项提议，认为它风险太大、成本太高。

words.note: proposition 指提议或命题，比 proposal 更正式、更抽象。

words.cn: 保留；留存；预订；储备；保留；拘谨；矜持；替补队员；后备部队；自然保护区

ex.en: I called the restaurant to reserve a table for six people.
