ex.zh: 我打电话给餐馆预订了一张六人桌。

words.note: reserve 作动词指预订、保留，作名词可指储备或保护区。

words.cn: 残暴的；凶猛的；粗鲁的；未开化的；野蛮的；野蛮人；粗鲁的人；乱咬；激烈抨击

ex.en: The novel drew savage criticism from several well-known reviewers.
ex.zh: 这部小说招致了几位知名评论家的猛烈批评。

words.note: savage 作形容词指凶残的，作动词指猛烈抨击，贬义较强。

ex.en: There was a heap of clothes on the floor beside the bed.
ex.zh: 床边的地板上有一堆衣服。

words.note: heap 指堆；动词短语 heap A on B 表示大量给予。

ex.en: She has great sympathy for families who lost their homes.
ex.zh: 她非常同情那些失去家园的家庭。

words.note: sympathy 后接 for 表同情对象，express sympathy 也指慰问。

ex.en: New rules give consumers more protection when they shop online.
ex.zh: 新规定在网上购物时给予消费者更多保护。

words.note: consumer 由 consume 加 -er 构成，注意与 customer 区别。

words.cn: 跛子；伤残人；使跛；使受伤致残；严重削弱；使陷入瘫痪

ex.en: The strike crippled the country's transport system for a week.
ex.zh: 罢工使该国的交通系统瘫痪了一周。

words.note: cripple 本指使残疾，现多用于比喻严重削弱、使瘫痪。

words.cn: 简短的；短暂的；向…介绍基本情况；做…的提要；概要；摘要

ex.en: The manager gave the staff a brief explanation of the new rules.
ex.zh: 经理向员工简要说明了新规定。

words.note: brief 作动词常用 brief sb on sth，意为介绍基本情况。

words.cn: 安慰；慰问；控制台；操纵台

ex.en: She tried to console her friend after the failed interview.
ex.zh: 面试失败后，她试着安慰朋友。

words.note: console 重音在后时作动词，意为安慰；重音在前指控制台。

words.cn: 主动性；首创精神；主动的行动；倡议；主动权

ex.en: She took the initiative and called the client before the deadline.
ex.zh: 她主动在截止日期前给客户打了电话。

words.note: initiative 常与 take 连用，意为采取主动。

ex.en: It took him three months to recover from the operation.
ex.zh: 他花了三个月才从手术中恢复过来。

words.note: recover from 后接疾病或打击，recover costs 指收回成本。

ex.en: Turn the handle clockwise until the lid is tightly closed.
ex.zh: 顺时针转动把手，直到盖子拧紧。

words.note: clockwise 由 clock 加后缀 -wise 构成，表方向。

ex.en: After graduation he embarked on a career in journalism.
ex.zh: 毕业后他开始了新闻业生涯。

words.note: embark 本指上船，embark on 引申为着手某事，后接名词。

ex.en: The doctor told him to take the medication twice a day.
ex.zh: 医生让他每天服两次药。

words.note: medication 指药物与治疗，为不可数名词，take 常与之搭配。

words.cn: 钻；打；训练；钻头；操练；训练

ex.en: The school holds a fire drill at the start of every term.
ex.zh: 学校每学期初都会举行消防演习。

words.note: drill 指钻头、钻孔，也指反复操练，如 fire drill。

ex.en: Constant delays caused friction between the two departments.
ex.zh: 不断的延误在两个部门之间引起了摩擦。

words.note: friction 指物理摩擦，也指人际不和，常与 between 连用。

ex.en: The judges conferred with each other before announcing the winner.
ex.zh: 评委们在宣布获奖者前相互商议。

words.note: confer 与 with 连用表商议，与 on 连用表授予，注意区分。

ex.en: It was an intelligent decision to wait for more information.
ex.zh: 等待更多信息是明智的决定。

words.note: intelligent 指有智慧的，intellectual 指智力的或知识分子。

ex.en: The clerk at the front desk helped me find the right office.
ex.zh: 前台的职员帮我找到了正确的办公室。

words.note: clerk 指办事员、店员，bank clerk 是常见搭配。

words.cn: 承认；承认…的权威；告知收到；确认；对…表示谢意；报偿

ex.en: He finally acknowledged that he had made a serious mistake.
ex.zh: 他终于承认自己犯了一个严重的错误。

words.note: acknowledge 后可接名词、that 从句或 doing，比 admit 中性。

ex.en: The lab is equipped with the latest measuring instruments.
ex.zh: 实验室配备了最新的测量仪器。

words.note: equip 常用 equip sb with sth，注意过去式要双写 p。

ex.en: The young assistant spoke to the director in a deferential tone.
ex.zh: 年轻的助理用恭敬的语气跟主管说话。

words.note: deferential 来自 defer（顺从），指恭敬的、恭顺的。

ex.en: The publisher asked her to submit the manuscript by June.
ex.zh: 出版商要求她在六月前提交手稿。

words.note: manuscript 由 manu（手）加 script（写）构成，指手稿。

ex.en: They spent one night in a luxury hotel near the beach.
ex.zh: 他们在海滩附近的一家豪华酒店住了一晚。

words.note: luxury 指奢侈或奢侈品，作定语时表示豪华的。

words.cn: 推翻；打倒；使终止；摒弃；推翻；终止；结束

ex.en: The rebels tried to overthrow the government but failed within days.
ex.zh: 叛军试图推翻政府，但几天内就失败了。

words.note: overthrow 过去式为 overthrew，过去分词为 overthrown。

words.cn: 编结；编织；愈合；编结；编织；使紧密地结合；使紧凑；皱紧；皱

ex.en: My grandmother knitted a sweater for me last winter.
ex.zh: 去年冬天我奶奶给我织了一件毛衣。

words.note: knit 指编织，knit one's brows 意为皱眉，过去式 knitted。

words.cn: 把…强加给；使…遭受；使…承担

ex.en: The storm inflicted serious damage on the coastal villages.
ex.zh: 暴风雨给沿海村庄造成了严重破坏。

words.note: inflict 常与 on 连用，指使遭受打击、痛苦或损失。

ex.en: Volunteering at the shelter is a worthwhile experience for students.
ex.zh: 在收容所做志愿者对学生来说是一段有价值的经历。

words.note: worthwhile 可作定语或表语；be worth doing 中不用它。

words.cn: 在内地；向内地；内陆的；内地的

ex.en: They travelled inland to visit the ancient temples.
ex.zh: 他们向内陆旅行，去参观古老的寺庙。

words.note: inland 可作形容词或副词，作副词时前面不加介词。

words.cn: 绊脚；绊倒；跌跌撞撞地走；结结巴巴

ex.en: He stumbled over a loose stone and dropped the papers.
ex.zh: 他被一块松动的石头绊了一下，手里的文件掉了下来。

words.note: stumble 指绊倒，也可指说话结巴，stumble upon 为偶然发现。

words.cn: 特产；名产；特色菜；专业；专长

ex.en: The restaurant is famous for its grilled fish, a local specialty of the region.
ex.zh: 这家餐厅以烤鱼闻名，那是当地的特色菜。

words.note: 美式常用 specialty 指特色菜和专长，英式多用 speciality。

words.cn: 变化；有差异；改变；使多样化

ex.en: Prices of fresh vegetables vary greatly from season to season in this market.
ex.zh: 这个市场上新鲜蔬菜的价格随季节变化很大。

words.note: 常与 from...to... 或 in 搭配；名词为 variety。

words.cn: 乐意地；欣然地；容易地；很快地；立即

ex.en: Information about the course is readily available on the university website.
ex.zh: 关于这门课程的信息在大学网站上很容易查到。

words.note: readily 兼有「容易地」与「乐意地」两义；readily available 高频。

words.cn: 条理清楚的；连贯的；一致的；协调的

ex.en: She gave a coherent account of what had happened that night.
ex.zh: 她对那天晚上发生的事情做了条理清楚的叙述。

words.note: co- 表共同，her 表粘；coherent 强调逻辑连贯、不散乱。

ex.en: The two countries have long enjoyed peaceful commercial intercourse along the border.
ex.zh: 两国长期在边境地区保持着和平的商业往来。

words.note: 现多用于 social／commercial intercourse，指正式的往来交流。

ex.en: Please reply to this email at your earliest convenience.
ex.zh: 请在您方便时尽早回复这封邮件。

words.note: at your convenience 是礼貌说法；不说 I am convenient。

words.cn: 得体；宽容；大方；正派；合乎礼仪；体面

ex.en: He had the decency to apologize for the mistake he had made.
ex.zh: 他还懂得体面，为自己犯的错误道了歉。

words.note: 来自 decent（得体的）；have the decency to do 指讲体面地做。

ex.en: The witness was accused of spreading falsehoods about the company.
ex.zh: 这名证人被指控散布有关该公司的谎言。

words.note: false 加后缀 -hood 构成，指谎言或虚假，比 lie 正式。

words.cn: 纪律；训练；惩罚；学科；训练；惩罚；处罚

ex.en: Learning a language requires discipline and a little patience every day.
ex.zh: 学一门语言需要自律，还需要每天一点耐心。

words.note: 作名词指纪律、学科，作动词指训练或惩戒。

ex.en: She sat by the window and pondered over the offer for a long time.
ex.zh: 她坐在窗边，长时间思索着那个提议。

words.note: 比 think 正式，多与 over／on 搭配，指仔细思量。

words.cn: 客观的；无偏见的；目标；目的

ex.en: A good journalist tries to give an objective view of the events.
ex.zh: 优秀的记者会努力对事件给出客观的看法。

words.note: 作形容词是客观的，作名词是目标；反义词 subjective。

ex.en: Parents can exert a strong influence on how their children study.
ex.zh: 父母能对孩子的学习方式产生很大影响。

words.note: exert 多与 influence、pressure、effort 搭配。

words.cn: 丑事；丑闻；流言蜚语；反感；愤慨

ex.en: The scandal forced the minister to resign from his post last week.
ex.zh: 这桩丑闻迫使那位部长上周辞去了职务。

words.note: 指丑闻，形容词 scandalous 意为令人愤慨的。

words.cn: 混合成的；综合成的；合成物；复合材料

ex.en: The wing is made of a light composite material that resists heat.
ex.zh: 机翼由一种耐热的轻质复合材料制成。

words.note: com- 表共同，pos 表放；指由多个部分合成的。

ex.en: Heavy rain hindered the rescue team from reaching the village.
ex.zh: 大雨妨碍了救援队抵达那个村庄。

words.note: hinder sb from doing 为固定结构，语气比 prevent 弱。

words.cn: 香味；气味；臭迹；踪迹；线索；香水；嗅到；察觉

ex.en: The scent of fresh coffee filled the small kitchen.
ex.zh: 新鲜咖啡的香气充满了这间小厨房。

words.note: 指淡淡香味或气味，也可指踪迹；follow the scent 追踪。

words.cn: 估计；评价；估计；评价；看法

ex.en: Experts estimate that the project will take about two more years.
ex.zh: 专家估计这个项目还需要大约两年时间。

words.note: 作动词重音在后，作名词重音在前；rough estimate 为粗估。

words.cn: 毕业文凭；毕业证书；资格证书

ex.en: She earned her diploma in nursing after three years of study.
ex.zh: 她学习三年后获得了护理专业文凭。

words.note: 指毕业文凭；degree 指学位，二者不可混用。

ex.en: Several of her paintings will be on exhibit at the museum this spring.
ex.zh: 她的几幅画今年春天将在博物馆展出。

words.note: 作名词指展品；on exhibit 相当于 on display。

words.cn: 商标；牌子；铭刻；打烙印于；加污名于；谴责

ex.en: The company spent millions building a brand that customers trust.
ex.zh: 该公司花费数百万打造了一个受顾客信任的品牌。

words.note: 作动词指打烙印、加污名；brand name 是品牌名。

words.cn: 暂停；中止；暂令停止参加；暂时剥夺；悬架；悬置机构；悬浮液；悬；挂；吊

ex.en: The suspension of the talks surprised everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 会谈的中止让房间里的所有人都感到意外。

words.note: suspend 是动词；suspension bridge 指悬索桥。

ex.en: The doctor advised him to avoid alcohol while taking the medicine.
ex.zh: 医生建议他服药期间不要饮酒。

words.note: 不可数名词；alcoholic 指含酒精的或酗酒者。

ex.en: Some delay was inevitable once the snow began to fall.
ex.zh: 雪一开始下，某种延误就不可避免了。

words.note: in-（不）+ evit（避开）+ able，常与 delay、decline 搭配。

ex.en: The manager continues to deny taking money from the company account.
ex.zh: 经理仍否认从公司账户里拿过钱。

words.note: 后接 doing 而非 to do；deny sb sth 意为拒绝给予。

ex.en: Workers dug a deep trench along the road to lay new pipes.
ex.zh: 工人们沿路挖了一条深沟以铺设新管道。

words.note: 指沟渠，也指战壕；trench coat 即风衣。

phr.zh: 从 B 中减去 A

ex.en: If you subtract three from ten, you get seven.
ex.zh: 十减去三等于七。

words.note: subtract A from B 表示从 B 减去 A，介词用 from。

ex.en: The park offers plenty of space for outdoor recreation.
ex.zh: 这个公园为户外娱乐提供了充足的空间。

words.note: re-（再）+ create，由「恢复精力」引申为消遣娱乐。

ex.en: He threw the broken phone away in frustration.
ex.zh: 他沮丧地把坏掉的手机扔到一边。

words.note: 不可数，常用 in frustration；动词 frustrate 使受挫。

ex.en: Her parents send a small monthly allowance to help with rent.
ex.zh: 她父母每月寄一笔小额零用钱帮她付房租。

words.note: make allowance for 意为考虑到、体谅，为常考短语。

ex.en: The hurricane destroyed hundreds of houses along the coast.
ex.zh: 这场飓风摧毁了沿海数百所房屋。

words.note: 指大西洋飓风；太平洋的称 typhoon，印度洋的称 cyclone。

words.cn: 徒步旅行；徒步旅行；增加；上升；提高

ex.en: We plan to hike up the mountain early tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我们打算明天清早上山徒步。

words.note: hike 作名词可指徒步，也可指价格上调，如 a price hike。

words.cn: 古代的；古老的；年老的；看上去很老的

ex.en: The museum displays pottery from an ancient civilization in the region.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了该地区一个古代文明的陶器。

words.note: ancient 多作定语，修饰历史久远的事物。

ex.en: The team was sent on a mission to rescue the trapped climbers.
ex.zh: 这支队伍被派去执行营救被困登山者的任务。

words.note: mission 指使命、任务；on a mission 表正在执行任务。

ex.en: Reading aloud helps children develop their cognitive skills.
ex.zh: 朗读有助于儿童发展认知能力。

words.note: 来自拉丁语 cognoscere（认识），常修饰 skills、process。

words.cn: 收养；采用；采取；正式通过；批准

ex.en: The council adopted a new policy on waste sorting last month.
ex.zh: 议会上个月通过了一项垃圾分类新政策。

words.note: adopt 是采用、收养；adapt 是适应、改编，勿混。

ex.en: My passport will expire next March, so I need to renew it.
ex.zh: 我的护照明年三月到期，所以我需要续办。

words.note: 指期限终止，多用于证件、合同、会员资格。

words.cn: 走私；非法私运；偷运；偷带

ex.en: Customs officers found two men trying to smuggle watches into the country.
ex.zh: 海关人员发现两名男子正试图把手表走私入境。

words.note: 常接 into／out of；smuggler 指走私者。

words.cn: 催促；赶紧做；猛推；挤；强迫；忙碌；奔忙；挤

ex.en: We had to hustle to catch the last bus home.
ex.zh: 我们不得不赶紧去赶最后一班回家的公交车。

words.note: 名词常用 the hustle and bustle，指城市的忙碌喧嚣。

ex.en: Many residents oppose the plan to build a factory near the river.
ex.zh: 许多居民反对在河边建工厂的计划。

words.note: be opposed to 中 to 是介词，后接名词或 doing。

words.cn: 器械；装置；设计；手段；策略

ex.en: This small device can measure the temperature of your coffee.
ex.zh: 这个小装置能测量咖啡的温度。

words.note: 指器械、装置；device 与 devise（设计）形近易混。

words.cn: 实况报道；解说词；评论；评论文章

ex.en: He provided live commentary on the match for a local radio station.
ex.zh: 他为当地一家电台解说了这场比赛的实况。

words.note: 指实况解说或评论；comment 是较短的意见。

ex.en: The workers decided to sue the company for unfair dismissal.
ex.zh: 工人们决定以不当解雇为由起诉该公司。

words.note: sue sb for sth 是常用结构，后可接 damages。

words.cn: 保守的；守旧的；不时兴的；传统的；保守的人

ex.en: Even by a conservative estimate, the repairs will cost a fortune.
ex.zh: 即便按保守估计，维修也要花一大笔钱。

words.note: conservative estimate 指偏低的估计；反义词 liberal。

ex.en: The baby lay on its belly and watched the toy roll away.
ex.zh: 婴儿俯卧着，看着玩具滚到一边。

words.note: belly 比 stomach 口语化；on one's belly 指俯卧。

words.cn: 接近；通道；入口；接近的机会；存取

ex.en: Students have free access to the online library all year round.
ex.zh: 学生全年可免费使用在线图书馆。

words.note: access to 中 to 为介词；accessible 是形容词。

ex.en: She will attend an international conference on climate change in June.
ex.zh: 她将于六月参加一个关于气候变化的国际会议。

words.note: conference 指正式会议；press conference 是记者招待会。

words.cn: 原始的；早期的；简单的；粗糙的；原人；原始事物

ex.en: These primitive tools were made of stone and animal bone.
ex.zh: 这些原始工具由石头和兽骨制成。

words.note: 指原始的、简陋的；prim 词根含「最初」之义。

words.cn: 球形把手；球形柄；旋钮；小块

ex.en: She turned the knob slowly and pushed the door open.
ex.zh: 她慢慢转动门把手，把门推开了。

words.note: 指球形把手或旋钮；词首 k 不发音。

ex.en: It is advisable to book your ticket well before the holiday.
ex.zh: 最好在假期前提前订好票。

words.note: advisable 常用 It is advisable to do 句型。

words.cn: 战胜；克服；压倒；使受不了

ex.en: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
ex.zh: 她努力克服在公开场合讲话的恐惧。

words.note: overcome 过去式为 overcame，过去分词为 overcome。

ex.en: They spent the weekend in a small log cabin by the lake.
ex.zh: 他们在湖边一间小木屋里度过了周末。

words.note: 指小木屋，也指船舱、机舱；cabin crew 指乘务员。

words.cn: 背诵；朗诵；列举；一一说出

ex.en: Each student had to recite a short poem from memory.
ex.zh: 每个学生都必须凭记忆背诵一首短诗。

words.note: 强调背诵或朗诵；re-（再）+ cit（引用）。

words.cn: 压迫；压制；使沉重；使烦恼

ex.en: The new laws were used to oppress anyone who spoke out.
ex.zh: 新法律被用来压迫任何敢出声的人。

words.note: oppress 指压迫或使心情沉重；oppression 是名词。

words.cn: 当前的；通用的；流行的；流传的；潮流；电流；趋势；倾向

ex.en: He reads the news every morning to keep up with current affairs.
ex.zh: 他每天早上看新闻以了解时事。

words.note: 作形容词是当前的；作名词指水流、电流、潮流。

ex.en: Her new shoes hurt because the heels were too high.
ex.zh: 她的新鞋磨脚，因为鞋跟太高了。

words.note: 指脚后跟、鞋跟；Achilles' heel 喻致命弱点。

ex.en: The news of the layoffs cast a gloom over the office.
ex.zh: 裁员的消息给办公室蒙上了一层阴影。

words.note: gloomy 是形容词；cast a gloom over 指蒙上阴影。

words.cn: 崇拜；敬慕；爱慕；热爱；非常喜欢

ex.en: She adores walking along the beach at sunset.
ex.zh: 她非常喜欢在日落时沿着海滩散步。

words.note: adore 语气强于 like，后接 doing，也可指敬慕。

ex.en: If the pain persists, you should see a doctor at once.
ex.zh: 如果疼痛持续，你应当立刻去看医生。

words.note: persist in doing sth 指坚持；也可指持续存在。

words.cn: 小心；谨慎；注意；警告；警告；劝…小心

ex.en: Drivers were told to proceed with caution on the icy road.
ex.zh: 司机被告知在结冰的路面上要小心行驶。

words.note: with caution 表谨慎地；caution 作动词接 against。

words.cn: 冒犯的；无礼的；使人不快的；进攻的；攻击性的；进攻；攻势

ex.en: His offensive remarks upset several people at the dinner table.
ex.zh: 他在餐桌上的无礼言论让好几个人不快。

words.note: 出自 offend；take the offensive 指转为攻势。

ex.en: This bread has a soft texture and a slightly sweet taste.
ex.zh: 这种面包质地柔软，味道微甜。

words.note: texture 指质地、手感；常与 smooth、rough 搭配。

words.cn: 私下的；隐蔽的；橱；壁橱；把…引进密室会谈

ex.en: She hung her coat in the closet and went into the kitchen.
ex.zh: 她把外套挂在衣橱里，然后走进厨房。

words.note: closet 是美式壁橱；作形容词可指秘密的，如 closet fan。

words.cn: 推测；推断；投机；做投机买卖

ex.en: Reporters continued to speculate about the reason for his sudden exit.
ex.zh: 记者们继续猜测他突然离职的原因。

words.note: speculate about 表推测；speculate in 表做投机。

ex.en: Workers began to dismantle the old stage after the concert.
ex.zh: 音乐会结束后，工人们开始拆除旧舞台。

words.note: dis-（去除）+ mantle（覆盖物），指拆卸、拆除。

words.cn: 大的；庞大的；怪物；极其残酷的人；巨人；巨兽；巨大的东西

ex.en: The film tells the story of a monster living deep in the lake.
ex.zh: 这部电影讲的是一个生活在深湖中的怪物的故事。

words.note: monster 作形容词可指巨大的，如 a monster truck。

ex.en: The trees are in bud, and the garden looks alive again.
ex.zh: 树木正在抽芽，花园又显得生机勃勃。

words.note: in bud 指含苞待放；nip sth in the bud 指防患未然。

ex.en: Please confirm your booking by email at least two days in advance.
ex.zh: 请至少提前两天通过邮件确认您的预订。

words.note: confirm 指证实或确认；名词 confirmation。

words.cn: 虫子；小病；故障；缺陷；窃听器；烦扰；纠缠；在…装窃听器

ex.en: Engineers spent the whole night fixing a bug in the system.
ex.zh: 工程师们花了一整夜修复系统里的一个漏洞。

words.note: 可指电脑漏洞或小毛病；作动词还有烦扰之意。

ex.en: Her prescient warning about the risks turned out to be right.
ex.zh: 她关于风险的有先见之明的警告后来被证明是对的。

words.note: pre-（预先）+ sci（知道），与 science 同源。

ex.en: New staff are given a week to acquaint themselves with the office.
ex.zh: 新员工有一周时间熟悉办公室的情况。

words.note: acquaint sb with sth 表使了解，常用于被动。

words.cn: 有弹性的；灵活的；松紧带

ex.en: The waistband is elastic, so the trousers fit almost anyone.
ex.zh: 裤腰是松紧的，所以这条裤子几乎适合任何人。

words.note: elastic 指有弹性的，也可喻灵活的；名词 elasticity。

words.cn: 作为结果的；随之发生的

ex.en: Heavy rain and the consequent flooding closed several roads.
ex.zh: 大雨以及随之而来的洪水使几条道路封闭。

words.note: consequent 后常接名词；consequently 意为因此。

ex.en: The vast majority of students supported the new library plan.
ex.zh: 绝大多数学生支持新建图书馆的计划。

words.note: the vast majority of 是高频搭配；vast 强调数量巨大。

ex.en: The teacher had to intervene when the two boys started shouting.
ex.zh: 两个男孩开始大喊时，老师不得不介入。

words.note: intervene in 指干预某事；intervene between 指居中调解。

ex.en: The dove is often used as a symbol of peace.
ex.zh: 鸽子常被用作和平的象征。

words.note: a symbol of 表象征；symbolize 意为象征，是动词。

ex.en: A single spark can ignite the dry grass in seconds.
ex.zh: 一颗火星就能在几秒内点燃干草。

words.note: ignite 指点燃，也可指引发争论；名词 ignition。

words.cn: 商业的；商务的；商品化的；商业性的

ex.en: The film was a commercial success but critics disliked it.
ex.zh: 这部电影在商业上很成功，但评论家不喜欢它。

words.note: 作形容词指商业的；名词 commercial 指电视广告。

words.cn: 被提示的真相；新发现；揭示；透露；显示

ex.en: The report contained a shocking revelation about the company's finances.
ex.zh: 这份报告包含了一个关于该公司财务的惊人内幕。

words.note: revelation 指揭露的真相；动词 reveal 表示揭示。

words.cn: 现成可使用的；通用的；可取的；联系的；可得到的

ex.en: Tickets are still available at the box office until Friday.
ex.zh: 周五之前售票处仍有票出售。

words.note: 可作定语或表语；be available to sb 表某人可用。

ex.en: Innumerable stars appeared once the clouds had cleared.
ex.zh: 云散之后，无数星星显现出来。

words.note: in-（不）+ numer（数）+ able，指数不清。

words.cn: 拥护；提倡；主张；拥护者；提倡者；辩护者；律师

ex.en: She has long advocated stricter rules on food safety.
ex.zh: 她长期以来主张对食品安全实行更严格的规定。

words.note: advocate 后接 doing 或 that 从句，不接 to do。

words.cn: 限制；使局限；使不外出；禁闭

phr.zh: 把 A 限制在 B

ex.en: The illness confined him to bed for almost a week.
ex.zh: 这场病使他卧床近一周。

words.note: confine A to B 把 A 限制在 B；be confined to 表局限。

ex.en: He travelled the world in quest of rare birds.
ex.zh: 他走遍世界寻找稀有鸟类。

words.note: in quest of 相当于 in search of；也作 quest for。

words.cn: 屡次；次数；频率；经常发生

ex.en: The frequency of online meetings has risen sharply this year.
ex.zh: 今年线上会议的频率急剧上升。

words.note: frequency 是 frequent 的名词；常与 high、low 连用。

ex.en: The question failed to elicit any response from the audience.
ex.zh: 这个问题没能引起听众的任何回应。

words.note: elicit 指诱出、引出；与 illicit（违法的）易混。

words.cn: 使降位；使降级；把…委托给

ex.en: The team was relegated to the second division last season.
ex.zh: 这支球队上赛季被降到了乙级。

words.note: relegate A to B 指把 A 降到 B，也指使降级。

ex.en: Don't waste time arguing about such trivial matters.
ex.zh: 不要把时间浪费在争论这种琐事上。

words.note: tri-（三）+ via（路），原指路口闲谈，故为琐碎。

ex.en: The village held a simple burial for the old fisherman.
ex.zh: 村里为这位老渔夫举行了简朴的葬礼。

words.note: bury 是动词，burial 是名词，指埋葬或葬礼。

ex.en: You can take only one piece of hand luggage on board.
ex.zh: 你只能携带一件手提行李登机。

words.note: 不可数名词，用 a piece of luggage；美式用 baggage。

ex.en: The main drawback of the flat is its lack of parking space.
ex.zh: 这套公寓的主要缺点是缺少停车位。

words.note: drawback 指不利条件，近义于 disadvantage。

ex.en: Scientists are studying the diet and habits that contribute to human longevity.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究有助于人类长寿的饮食和习惯。

words.note: 常与 increase、extend 搭配，指长寿或事物的持久。

words.cn: 军事的；军用的；军队；武装力量

ex.en: He served in the military for ten years before entering politics.
ex.zh: 他从政前在军队服役十年。

words.note: 作名词指军队，多用 the military；作定语修饰名词。

words.cn: 动力的；动力学的；动态的；有活力的；有生气的

ex.en: The city has a dynamic economy that attracts young graduates.
ex.zh: 这座城市经济充满活力，吸引着年轻毕业生。

words.note: 强调有活力、不断变化，与 static（静态的）相对。

ex.en: She hung her coat in the wardrobe and went downstairs.
ex.zh: 她把外套挂进衣柜，然后下了楼。

words.note: 指衣柜，也可指一个人的全部衣物，别与 clothes 混用。

ex.en: Many students are reluctant to speak English in front of the class.
ex.zh: 许多学生不愿在全班同学面前说英语。

words.note: 后接 to do，不接 doing；近义词 unwilling。

ex.en: She is a conscientious student who checks every answer twice.
ex.zh: 她是个认真的学生，每道题的答案都检查两遍。

words.note: 源于 conscience（良心），形容勤勉尽责、一丝不苟。

ex.en: His passion for music began when he was a child.
ex.zh: 他对音乐的热爱始于童年。

words.note: passion for sth 表热爱；复数 passions 指强烈情感。

ex.en: The new plant can generate enough electricity for the whole town.
ex.zh: 新电厂发的电足够全镇使用。

words.note: 多接 power、income、interest 等宾语，表“产生”。

words.cn: 极度的；最后的；极端；过分

ex.en: Extreme weather has become more frequent in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年来极端天气越来越频繁。

words.note: go to extremes 走极端；常修饰 weather、measures。

words.cn: 把边塞到下面；把…夹入；把…藏入；褶；裥

ex.en: She tucked the letter into her pocket and left quickly.
ex.zh: 她把信塞进口袋，快步离开了。

words.note: 核心义“塞、掖”；tuck in 还可口语指“大吃一顿”。

words.cn: 有权威性的；可信的；专断的；命令式的

ex.en: The report is based on authoritative sources such as official statistics.
ex.zh: 这份报告依据官方统计等权威来源。

words.note: 由 authority 变来，既指权威可信，也指专断。

ex.en: The young athlete trains six hours a day for the national games.
ex.zh: 这名年轻运动员为全国运动会每天训练六小时。

words.note: 指田径等运动员；形容词 athletic 表“运动的”。

words.cn: 挺直着；竖立着；垂直的；正直的；诚实的

ex.en: Please sit upright and keep your back against the chair.
ex.zh: 请坐直，让背部靠住椅背。

words.note: 指身姿挺直，也可形容人正直；常与 sit、stand 连用。

words.cn: 取出；抽出；采掘；提炼；榨取；获得；索取；摘录['3kstrækt]；摘录；选段；提出物；精；汁

ex.en: Researchers managed to extract useful data from the old records.
ex.zh: 研究人员从旧档案中提取出了有用的数据。

words.note: 名词重音在前，指摘录或提取物；动词重音在后。

words.cn: 不著名的；不重要的；费解的；模糊不清的；使变糊；掩盖

ex.en: The meaning of the poem remains obscure to most readers.
ex.zh: 这首诗的含义对多数读者来说仍然晦涩。

words.note: 兼指不出名和难懂；作动词表“遮掩、使模糊”。

words.cn: 失望；气馁；惊恐；使失望；使气馁；使惊恐

ex.en: To her dismay, the train had already left when she arrived.
ex.zh: 让她沮丧的是，她赶到时火车已经开走了。

words.note: to one's dismay 是固定结构；dismayed 后接 at/by。

ex.en: They expended a great deal of effort on the experiment.
ex.zh: 他们在这个实验上花了大量精力。

words.note: 比 spend 正式，常接 energy、effort、resources。

ex.en: The two countries forged a close partnership over the past decade.
ex.zh: 过去十年间，两国建立了紧密的合作关系。

words.note: 本义“锻造”，引申为“建立关系”和“伪造”。

ex.en: The teacher demonstrated how to use the new software step by step.
ex.zh: 老师一步步演示了如何使用新软件。

words.note: 既指演示、示范，也指论证、表明，后可接 that 从句。

words.cn: 地区；地带；区域；范围；幅度

ex.en: This region is famous for its tea and mild climate.
ex.zh: 这个地区以茶叶和温和的气候闻名。

words.note: in the region of 表“大约”；形容词为 regional。

ex.en: He was deceived by a false advertisement and lost a lot of money.
ex.zh: 他被一则虚假广告骗了，损失了很多钱。

words.note: 强调让人信假为真；deceive sb into doing 骗某人做。

ex.en: The magazine gave readers a preview of the new film.
ex.zh: 这本杂志向读者预告了新片的内容。

words.note: pre- 加 view，指放映或展出前的预览，也可作动词。

words.cn: 设计独特的；别致的；巧妙的；灵巧的；善于创造发明的

ex.en: The engineer came up with an ingenious way to save water.
ex.zh: 这位工程师想出了一个节水的巧妙办法。

words.note: 强调设计巧妙；别与 ingenuous（天真的）混淆。

ex.en: Two hundred students filled in the questionnaire about online study.
ex.zh: 两百名学生填写了关于线上学习的问卷。

words.note: 常用 fill in/out a questionnaire；指问卷表格本身。

words.cn: 突破；突破性进展；重要的新发现

ex.en: Scientists made a major breakthrough in cancer research last year.
ex.zh: 科学家去年在癌症研究上取得重大突破。

words.note: 常与 make、achieve 连用，后接介词 in。

ex.en: She had a quick snack before the meeting started.
ex.zh: 会议开始前她匆匆吃了点东西。

words.note: 指正餐之间的少量食物；snack bar 是小吃店。

words.cn: 牛轭；束缚；枷锁；结合；联结

ex.en: The farmers yoked the two oxen together to pull the cart.
ex.zh: 农夫把两头牛套在一起拉车。

words.note: 本义牛轭，引申为枷锁、束缚，常用 under the yoke of。

ex.en: The island has become a popular destination for young travellers.
ex.zh: 这座岛已成为年轻游客的热门目的地。

words.note: 指旅程终点；常与 reach、arrive at 连用。

ex.en: The young king came to the throne at the age of eighteen.
ex.zh: 这位年轻的国王十八岁登上王位。

words.note: come to/ascend the throne 表登基；也指宝座。

words.cn: 个人自由；隐私；私生活；私事

ex.en: Many users worry that the app may invade their privacy.
ex.zh: 许多用户担心这款应用会侵犯他们的隐私。

words.note: 不可数名词；常用 protect 或 invade one's privacy。

ex.en: The two schools signed a reciprocal agreement on student exchange.
ex.zh: 两所学校签署了学生交换的互惠协议。

words.note: 强调双方对等互惠；名词形式是 reciprocity。

ex.en: Draw a vertical line from the top of the page to the bottom.
ex.zh: 从页面顶端到底部画一条垂直线。

words.note: 与 horizontal（水平的）相对；副词是 vertically。

ex.en: The store checks its inventory at the end of every month.
ex.zh: 这家店每月末核对库存。

words.note: take inventory 指盘点；也可指详细目录、清单。

words.cn: 鲜艳的；生动的；栩栩如生的

ex.en: She still has a vivid memory of her first day at school.
ex.zh: 她对上学第一天仍记忆犹新。

words.note: 指色彩鲜艳或描述生动；副词 vividly，如 vividly remember。

ex.en: Her cheeks flushed with embarrassment when she heard her name.
ex.zh: 听到自己的名字时，她窘得脸都红了。

words.note: 表“脸红”常接 with；flush 也指表面齐平。

ex.en: As the only child, he is the sole heir to the family business.
ex.zh: 作为独子，他是家族企业的唯一继承人。

words.note: heir 后接介词 to；h 不发音，冠词用 an heir。

words.cn: 螺丝；用螺钉固定；拧；拧紧

ex.en: He screwed the shelf firmly to the wall so it would not fall.
ex.zh: 他把架子牢牢拧在墙上，以免掉落。

words.note: 作动词指用螺钉固定；screw up 口语指搞糟。

words.cn: 成套工具；成套用品；配套元件；装备

ex.en: Every car should carry a first-aid kit and a spare tyre.
ex.zh: 每辆车都应备有急救包和一个备用轮胎。

words.note: 指成套工具或装备；kit out 表配备装备。

ex.en: He got the job by virtue of his long experience in teaching.
ex.zh: 他凭借长期的教学经验得到了这份工作。

words.note: by virtue of 是固定短语表“凭借、由于”，很常考。

ex.en: The doctor emphasized the importance of regular exercise and sleep.
ex.zh: 医生强调了规律运动和睡眠的重要性。

words.note: 名词形式是 emphasis，短语 put emphasis on。

words.cn: 营业额；成交量；人员调整；人员更替率

ex.en: The company's annual turnover rose by ten percent last year.
ex.zh: 公司去年的年营业额增长了百分之十。

words.note: 可指营业额，也可指人员更替率，要看语境。

words.cn: 终有一死的；致命的；你死我活的；不共戴天的；凡人；人类

ex.en: All human beings are mortal, so we should value our time.
ex.zh: 人终有一死，所以我们应当珍惜时间。

words.note: 与 immortal（不朽的）相对；mortal enemy 指死敌。

ex.en: The trial received wide media coverage across the country.
ex.zh: 这场审判在全国获得了广泛的媒体报道。

words.note: 指新闻报道的覆盖，也可指保险的保障范围。

words.cn: 出现；合乎情理；数字；人物；算术；体型；风姿；轮廓；画像；塑像；图；图形；计算；认为；猜想

ex.en: It took me a while to figure out how the machine worked.
ex.zh: 我花了一会儿才弄明白这台机器怎么运作。

words.note: figure out 表“弄懂、算出”；figure 还可指数字、身材。

words.cn: 野兽般的；残忍的；无情的；冷酷的；难以忍受的

ex.en: The film describes the brutal reality of life during the war.
ex.zh: 这部影片描写了战争期间生活的残酷现实。

words.note: 语气比 cruel 更强，强调无情、野兽般；名词 brutality。

words.cn: 轻微的；微小的；侮慢；轻视；冷落

ex.en: There has been a slight improvement in his condition since yesterday.
ex.zh: 从昨天起他的病情略有好转。

words.note: not in the slightest 表“一点也不”；动词义“轻视”少用。

ex.en: The region is rich in iron ore and other minerals.
ex.zh: 这个地区富含铁矿石和其他矿物。

words.note: 多与金属名搭配，如 iron ore、copper ore，通常不可数。

words.cn: 堕落的；腐败的；贪赃舞弊的；腐蚀；使堕落

ex.en: Several corrupt officials were removed from office after the investigation.
ex.zh: 调查之后，几名贪官被免职。

words.note: 兼指“腐败的”和“使腐化”；名词是 corruption。

ex.en: Bad weather precluded us from finishing the work on time.
ex.zh: 恶劣天气使我们无法按时完成工作。

words.note: preclude sb from doing 表使不能；较正式，近义 prevent。

ex.en: She had no previous experience, but she learned the job quickly.
ex.zh: 她此前没有经验，但很快就学会了这份工作。

words.note: 指紧接的前一个；previous to 表“在…之前”。

ex.en: The new regime promised to improve education and health care.
ex.zh: 新政权承诺改善教育和医疗。

words.note: 指政权或制度；也可指饮食、训练等固定制度。

words.cn: 传送；传递；传染；播送；发射

ex.en: The disease can be transmitted through close contact with animals.
ex.zh: 这种病可通过与动物密切接触传播。

words.note: 指传送、传播；名词是 transmission。

ex.en: A ceremony was held to commemorate the soldiers who died in battle.
ex.zh: 人们举行仪式纪念阵亡的士兵。

words.note: 指用仪式或纪念物纪念；名词是 commemoration。

words.cn: 争论；争辩；辩论；主张；说服

ex.en: Some experts argue that online learning is as effective as classrooms.
ex.zh: 一些专家认为线上学习与课堂学习同样有效。

words.note: argue with sb about sth 争吵；argue for 表支持。

ex.en: Rising energy consumption has become a serious problem for the city.
ex.zh: 不断上升的能源消耗已成为这座城市的严重问题。

words.note: 指消耗、消费；动词是 consume，consumer 指消费者。

words.cn: 比预期时间早的；不成熟的；仓促的

ex.en: It is premature to draw any conclusion before all the data arrive.
ex.zh: 在全部数据到达之前就下结论为时过早。

words.note: pre- 加 mature，指过早、仓促，常与 decision 连用。

words.cn: 上级的；较高的；优越的；有优越感的；高傲的；上级；长官

ex.en: This model is clearly superior to the one we bought last year.
ex.zh: 这个型号明显优于我们去年买的那个。

words.note: 比较时用 to 不用 than；反义词是 inferior。

ex.en: The long drought has destroyed most of the crops in the area.
ex.zh: 长期干旱毁掉了该地区大部分庄稼。

words.note: 常与 severe、long 搭配；gh 不发音，读作 /draʊt/。

words.cn: 周期的；定期的；时而发生的；期刊

ex.en: The library subscribes to several academic periodicals every year.
ex.zh: 图书馆每年订阅几种学术期刊。

words.note: 作名词指期刊；形容词指定期的，近义 periodic。

words.cn: 散发传单；传单；散页印刷品；小册子

ex.en: Volunteers handed out leaflets about saving water in the square.
ex.zh: 志愿者在广场上散发了节水的传单。

words.note: leaf 加 -let（小），指散页印刷品；作动词指散发传单。

words.cn: 附件；零件；配件；装饰品；同谋；帮凶；包庇犯

ex.en: Her shop sells handbags, scarves and every kind of fashion accessory.
ex.zh: 她的店出售手提包、围巾和各类时尚配饰。

words.note: 表配饰常用复数；法律语境指帮凶，后接 to。

words.cn: 妥协；危及；放弃；妥协；和解；折中办法

ex.en: After hours of talks, the two sides finally reached a compromise.
ex.zh: 经过数小时会谈，双方终于达成妥协。

words.note: 常用 reach a compromise；compromise on 表在…让步。

ex.en: When criticized, she retorted that the plan had actually worked well.
ex.zh: 受到批评时，她反驳说这个计划其实很奏效。

words.note: 指立即反驳，常接 that 从句，语气较尖锐。

words.cn: 使充电；使电气化；使激动；使兴奋

ex.en: His final performance managed to electrify the whole audience.
ex.zh: 他的最后一场表演让全场观众激动不已。

words.note: 由 electric 变来，既指通电、电气化，也指使人振奋。

ex.en: She attended a seminar on climate change at the university last week.
ex.zh: 上周她参加了大学里一场关于气候变化的研讨会。

words.note: 指研讨会或研究讨论课，常与 attend、hold 搭配。

words.cn: 附加的；刘海；饰以流苏的边；边缘；外围；成为…的边缘

ex.en: Their new flat lies on the northern fringe of the city.
ex.zh: 他们的新公寓位于城市北部的边缘地带。

words.note: fringe 指边缘、外围；fringe benefits 指额外福利。

ex.en: Small shops face fierce competition from large online retailers.
ex.zh: 小店铺面临来自大型网络零售商的激烈竞争。

words.note: 常与 with/from 搭配；动词是 compete，名词 competitor。

words.cn: 在更远处；再往后；在…的那边；远于；迟于；越出

ex.en: The task is beyond the ability of a single student.
ex.zh: 这项任务超出了一个学生的能力范围。

words.note: beyond 表超出范围；beyond doubt 毫无疑问，很常考。

words.cn: 危险；公害；尝试着做；冒…风险

ex.en: Smoking is a serious health hazard for both smokers and others.
ex.zh: 吸烟对吸烟者和他人都是严重的健康隐患。

words.note: 指危险、隐患；形容词是 hazardous，表危险的。

ex.en: Nothing can justify treating loyal employees so badly and unfairly.
ex.zh: 再没有什么能为如此恶劣不公地对待忠实员工开脱。

words.note: justify 后接动名词；名词 justice 表公平、正义。

words.cn: 糟透了的；极不合意的；极端的；极其大的；可怕的

ex.en: We had dreadful weather during our holiday in the mountains.
ex.zh: 我们在山里度假期间天气糟透了。

words.note: dread 加 -ful，表极糟的；口语中近义 terrible。

ex.en: She does voluntary work at the local hospital every weekend.
ex.zh: 她每个周末都在当地医院做志愿工作。

words.note: 指自愿的、志愿的；名词和动词都是 volunteer。

words.cn: 连接；联系；连接物；连接点；亲戚

ex.en: The police are questioning a man in connection with the robbery.
ex.zh: 警方正在审问一名与抢劫案有关的男子。

words.note: in connection with 是固定短语表“关于、与…有关”。

words.cn: 耐…的；能防…的；证据；证明；校样；样张

ex.en: You need to show proof of identity before entering the building.
ex.zh: 进入大楼前你需要出示身份证明。

words.note: proof 常接 of；也作后缀表“防…的”，如 waterproof。

words.cn: 激进的；好斗的；激进分子；斗士

ex.en: The militant group refused to accept the government's new proposal.
ex.zh: 该激进组织拒绝接受政府的新提议。

words.note: 词根 milit 表战斗，指好斗、激进；名词形式相同。

ex.en: The software can simulate the conditions of a real flight.
ex.zh: 这个软件能模拟真实飞行的条件。

words.note: 指模拟或假装；名词 simulation，形容词 simulated。

ex.en: The intricacy of the watch design surprised every visitor.
ex.zh: 这块手表的精巧设计让每位参观者惊讶。

words.note: 常用复数 intricacies 指复杂细节；形容词 intricate。

ex.en: The project has entered a new phase of development.
ex.zh: 这个项目已进入新的发展阶段。

words.note: phase out 指逐步停止使用；in phase 表同相、协调。

words.cn: 稀释的；冲淡的；稀释；冲淡

ex.en: The nurse diluted the medicine with water before giving it to the child.
ex.zh: 护士用水把药稀释后才给孩子服用。

words.note: 指稀释、冲淡，也可比喻削弱效果；反义 concentrate。

words.cn: 包括一切的；包括一切费用在内的；所有数目包括在内的

ex.en: The price is inclusive of breakfast and free internet access.
ex.zh: 该价格包含早餐和免费上网。

words.note: inclusive of 表包括在内；反义词是 exclusive。

ex.en: New machines have greatly improved the efficiency of the factory.
ex.zh: 新机器大大提高了工厂的效率。

words.note: 由 efficient 变来，常与 improve、raise 搭配。

ex.en: The city is home to many ethnic groups with different customs.
ex.zh: 这座城市居住着许多习俗不同的族群。

words.note: 指种族的、民族的；ethnic group 比 race 更常用。

words.cn: 演出；场面；景象；壮观；眼镜

ex.en: The fireworks over the river were a magnificent spectacle.
ex.zh: 河面上的烟花是一幅壮观的景象。

words.note: 指壮观场面、景象；make a spectacle of oneself 指出丑。

words.cn: 在头顶上；在头顶上的；架空的；经常费用；管理费用

ex.en: A plane flew low overhead and drowned out our conversation.
ex.zh: 一架飞机从头顶低飞而过，盖过了我们的谈话声。

words.note: 作名词常用复数 overheads 指经常费用，如 overhead costs。

words.cn: 缩小；订合同；感染；染上；契约；合同

ex.en: The company signed a two-year contract with a local supplier.
ex.zh: 公司与当地一家供应商签了两年合同。

words.note: 名词重音在前，动词指收缩时重音在后。

words.cn: 结束；终了；推断出；推论出；缔结；议定

ex.en: The report concluded that the policy had done more harm than good.
ex.zh: 报告得出结论认为该政策弊大于利。

words.note: 指结束、推断或缔结；名词 conclusion，短语 in conclusion。

ex.en: The restaurant became profitable only in its third year.
ex.zh: 这家餐馆到第三年才开始盈利。

words.note: profit 加 -able，指有利可图的；也指有益的。

words.cn: 不幸；厄运；逆境；不幸事故；灾难；灾祸

ex.en: She never lost her sense of humour despite her misfortunes.
ex.zh: 尽管屡遭不幸，她从未失去幽默感。

words.note: mis- 表坏，指不幸、灾祸；可数时指具体的不幸事件。

words.cn: 理解；理解力；领悟；理解力测验

ex.en: The teacher gave us a short test on reading comprehension.
ex.zh: 老师给我们做了一次简短的阅读理解测验。

words.note: 指理解、理解力；beyond comprehension 表无法理解。

words.cn: 易受影响的；过敏的；能经受的；容许的

ex.en: Young children are more susceptible to infection in winter.
ex.zh: 幼儿在冬天更容易受到感染。

words.note: susceptible to 表易受…影响；to 后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: She bought a black leather jacket at the market last weekend.
ex.zh: 上周末她在市场上买了一件黑色皮夹克。

words.note: 常作定语，如 leather shoes；真皮说 genuine leather。

words.cn: 洞察力；洞悉；深刻的见解

ex.en: The book offers valuable insights into how children learn languages.
ex.zh: 这本书对儿童如何学习语言提出了宝贵见解。

words.note: 常用搭配 insight into sth；具体见解多用复数 insights。

words.cn: 完整无缺的；未经触动的；未受损伤的

ex.en: Despite the earthquake, the old temple remained intact.
ex.zh: 尽管发生了地震，这座古庙仍完好无损。

words.note: 多与 remain、keep 连用；in-（不）+tact（接触）即未被触动。

words.cn: 起作用的；有帮助的；用乐器演奏的

ex.en: She was instrumental in setting up the school's reading programme.
ex.zh: 她在建立学校阅读计划中起了重要作用。

words.note: 表“起重要作用”：be instrumental in doing sth。

ex.en: The curtains are made of a light cotton fabric.
ex.zh: 窗帘是用轻薄的棉布做的。

words.note: 除织物外还指结构，如 the fabric of society。

ex.en: The new treatment is considered revolutionary in the fight against cancer.
ex.zh: 这种新疗法在抗癌方面被视为革命性的。

words.note: 由 revolution 加 -ary 构成；作名词指革命者。

ex.en: The unemployment rate rose sharply during the economic crisis.
ex.zh: 经济危机期间失业率急剧上升。

words.note: 不可数名词；常见于 unemployment rate 等搭配。

words.cn: 少年的；少年特有的；幼稚的；不成熟的；未成年人；少年

ex.en: Juvenile crime has fallen in the city over the past five years.
ex.zh: 过去五年该市青少年犯罪有所下降。

words.note: 正式用语，指少年的；法律语境常与 crime 搭配。

words.cn: 强迫；用力推动；用力打开；军队；兵力；暴力；武力；力；力气；影响力；效力

ex.en: The new safety rules will come into force next month.
ex.zh: 新的安全规定将于下个月生效。

words.note: force sb to do sth；come into force 指生效。

words.cn: 同情的；和谐的；赞同的；支持的；合意的

ex.en: Her teacher was sympathetic and gave her more time to finish.
ex.zh: 老师很体谅她，给了她更多时间完成。

words.note: 除同情外还表赞同，如 be sympathetic to a plan。

words.cn: 周期的；定期的；时而发生的

ex.en: The equipment needs periodic checks to make sure it is safe.
ex.zh: 设备需要定期检查以确保安全。

words.note: periodic 指定期的；periodical 作名词指期刊。

ex.en: The charity handles the distribution of food to local families.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构负责向当地家庭分发食物。

words.note: 由 distribute 变来；兼指分发、分配、分布。

words.cn: 起源；衍生；取得；得到；追溯…的起源或来由

ex.en: Many English words derive from Latin and Greek.
ex.zh: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语和希腊语。

words.note: derive from 表来源；derive sth from 表获得。

words.cn: 容量；能力；能量；才能；身份；地位

ex.en: The hall has a seating capacity of about five hundred.
ex.zh: 这个大厅可容纳约五百人就座。

words.note: 兼指容量与能力；in one's capacity as 指以某身份。

ex.en: Many students find it hard to cope with the pressure of exams.
ex.zh: 许多学生觉得难以应对考试压力。

words.note: 必须与 with 连用；比 deal with 更强调承受力。

ex.en: I often overhear my colleagues talking about football by the coffee machine.
ex.zh: 我常无意中听到同事在咖啡机旁聊足球。

words.note: 过去式 overheard；强调无意中听到，不同于 listen。

words.cn: 猛冲；飞奔；投射；飞镖；飞镖游戏；急驰；飞奔

ex.en: He threw a dart at the board, but it missed the centre.
ex.zh: 他朝镖盘掷了一支飞镖，但没打中中心。

words.note: 作动词指猛冲；dart a glance at sb 指飞快看一眼。

ex.en: The engineers found a serious flaw in the design of the bridge.
ex.zh: 工程师们在大桥设计中发现了一个严重缺陷。

words.note: 常用搭配 a flaw in sth；形容词 flawed 指有缺陷的。

words.cn: 使湿透；浸透；使充满；使饱和

ex.en: Heavy rain will saturate the fields and flood the low roads.
ex.zh: 大雨会使田地浸透，并淹没低洼的道路。

words.note: 常用被动 be saturated with；名词 saturation。

words.cn: 特征；特色；面貌；特写；专题节目；故事片；突出；由…主演

ex.en: The film features a young actress from a small town.
ex.zh: 这部电影由一位来自小镇的年轻女演员主演。

words.note: 作动词指以…为特色、由…主演；key feature 指特点。

words.cn: 平直地；直截了当地；平的；固定的；漏气的；单调的；沉闷的；浅的；一套房间；单元住宅

ex.en: We had to stop because the car had a flat tyre.
ex.zh: 我们不得不停车，因为车胎瘪了。

words.note: flat 还指一套公寓；flat tyre 指瘪胎。

words.cn: 肯定地说；断言；维护；坚持；坚持己见

ex.en: She asserted that the report was based on false information.
ex.zh: 她断言那份报告基于虚假信息。

words.note: 后接 that 从句表断言；assert oneself 指显自信。

words.cn: 高潮；最令人兴奋的部分

ex.en: The argument reached its climax when both sides refused to talk.
ex.zh: 双方拒绝交谈时，争论达到了高潮。

words.note: 常用 reach a climax；形容词 climactic 指高潮的。

words.cn: 回忆；召回；叫回；收回；撤销

ex.en: I cannot recall meeting him before, though his face looks familiar.
ex.zh: 我想不起以前见过他，虽然他的脸看着眼熟。

words.note: recall doing 表记得做过；recall a product 指召回。

ex.en: The garden is small and rectangular, with a path down the middle.
ex.zh: 花园不大，呈长方形，中间有一条小路。

words.note: 由 rectangle 加 -ular 构成，重音在第二音节。

words.cn: 飘动；拍动；振翅；片状垂悬物；飘动；摆动；振动；激动；慌忙状态；使拍动；使飘动

ex.en: The bird flapped its wings and rose slowly above the trees.
ex.zh: 那只鸟拍打翅膀，慢慢升到树梢上方。

words.note: 指翅膀或布片拍动；in a flap 表慌乱。

ex.en: Please give me the precise time and place of the meeting.
ex.zh: 请告诉我会议的准确时间和地点。

words.note: 与 exact 近义，但更强调细节严谨；副词 precisely。

ex.en: It would be sensible to book the tickets well in advance.
ex.zh: 提前订好票是明智的做法。

words.note: 注意与 sensitive（敏感的）区分，sensible 指明智。

ex.en: The neighbours raised an objection to the plan for a new road.
ex.zh: 邻居们对新修道路的计划提出了异议。

words.note: 常用 objection to sth；动词 object 也接 to。

ex.en: Clean water is a precious resource that many people take for granted.
ex.zh: 清洁的水是许多人想当然的宝贵资源。

words.note: 形容量少而宝贵；precious metal 指贵金属。

words.cn: 谋划；策划；设法做到；设计；想出

ex.en: Somehow she contrived to finish the report before the deadline.
ex.zh: 她不知怎么设法在截止前完成了报告。

words.note: 常接 to do，含费力设法之意；也可指策划、设计。

ex.en: The island has only a few hundred permanent inhabitants.
ex.zh: 这个岛只有几百名常住居民。

words.note: 由 inhabit 加 -ant 构成；搭配 inhabitant of。

words.cn: 小部分；片断；【数】 分数

ex.en: Only a small fraction of the students passed the final test.
ex.zh: 只有一小部分学生通过了期末考试。

words.note: 表小部分用 a fraction of；数学中表分数。

words.cn: 象征性的；装样子的；筹码；信物；标志；纪念品；代金券；礼券

ex.en: He gave her flowers as a token of his appreciation.
ex.zh: 他送她鲜花以表谢意。

words.note: a token of sth 指…的象征；by the same token 表同理。

ex.en: She spoke with great emotion about her years in the village.
ex.zh: 她满怀感情地谈起在村里的那些年。

words.note: 可数不可数皆可；with emotion 指带着感情。

words.cn: 大的；大而重的；大块的；大量的；大规模的

ex.en: The campaign attracted massive support from young voters.
ex.zh: 这项运动得到了年轻选民的大力支持。

words.note: 语气比 big 强，表巨大；副词 massively。

ex.en: Officials are still trying to assess the damage caused by the flood.
ex.zh: 官员们仍在设法评估洪水造成的损失。

words.note: 名词 assessment；强调评估价值或程度。

words.cn: 混合起来；相混合；相交往；相往来；使混合；使相混

ex.en: At the school party the students mingle with guests from several countries.
ex.zh: 在学校聚会上，学生们与几个国家的宾客交谈。

words.note: 常与 with 连用，指混合或与人交往。

words.cn: 处方；药方；药；开处方；开药方

ex.en: The doctor wrote out a prescription for painkillers.
ex.zh: 医生开了一张止痛药处方。

words.note: 动词 prescribe 指开药；prescription drugs 指处方药。

ex.en: Thousands of spectators watched the race from the side of the road.
ex.zh: 数千名观众在路边观看比赛。

words.note: 指看比赛的观众；spectator sport 指观赏性运动。

ex.en: Not all the berries in the forest are edible, so be careful.
ex.zh: 森林里并非所有浆果都能吃，所以要小心。

words.note: 反义 inedible；只表能吃，不表好吃。

words.cn: 易于…的；很有可能…的；俯卧的

ex.en: Children are more prone to colds in winter than in summer.
ex.zh: 孩子在冬天比夏天更容易感冒。

words.note: be prone to sth；另义俯卧的，如 lie prone。

words.cn: 合唱队；合唱；合唱曲；副歌；叠句；齐声；齐声说的话；齐声说；随声附和

ex.en: The whole class answered in chorus when the teacher asked.
ex.zh: 老师提问时全班齐声回答。

words.note: in chorus 表齐声；指副歌也用 chorus。

words.cn: 欠；应把…归功于；感激；感恩

ex.en: I owe my success to the support of my family.
ex.zh: 我把成功归功于家人的支持。

words.note: owe sth to sb；既指欠钱也指归功于。

words.cn: 资产；财产；有价值的特性或技能；优点

ex.en: Her experience abroad is a valuable asset to the company.
ex.zh: 她的海外经验是公司的宝贵财富。

words.note: 多用于褒义，指有价值的人或物；fixed assets。

words.cn: 阐述；讲解；展览会；博览会

phr.en: a clear exposition of the theory

ex.en: The book opens with a clear exposition of the main theory.
ex.zh: 这本书开头清晰地阐述了主要理论。

words.note: 指详细阐述；也可指博览会，如 world exposition。

words.cn: 最低的；最小的；最低限度；最小量

ex.en: The company raised the minimum wage for new workers.
ex.zh: 公司提高了新员工的最低工资。

words.note: 反义 maximum；keep to a minimum 表尽量减少。

ex.en: He made a public apology for his rude remarks.
ex.zh: 他为自己粗鲁的言论公开道歉。

words.note: 动词 apologise；apology for sth 指为某事道歉。

ex.en: The survey revealed that most workers were unhappy with their pay.
ex.zh: 调查显示大多数工人对自己的工资不满。

words.note: 可接 that 从句；名词 revelation 指揭露。

ex.en: The room was small but adequate for a short stay.
ex.zh: 房间不大，但短暂停留足够用了。

words.note: 表足够、可胜任，比 enough 正式。

ex.en: He is a night owl and rarely goes to bed before two.
ex.zh: 他是个夜猫子，很少两点前睡觉。

words.note: night owl 指熬夜的人；猫头鹰在西方象征智慧。

words.cn: 软木；软木塞；用瓶塞塞住

ex.en: He pulled the cork out of the bottle and poured the wine.
ex.zh: 他拔出瓶塞，倒出葡萄酒。

words.note: 指软木或瓶塞；作动词指用瓶塞塞住。

words.cn: 极大的；非常的；精彩的；了不起的

ex.en: The team worked under tremendous pressure to meet the deadline.
ex.zh: 团队在巨大压力下工作以按时完成。

words.note: 语气比 great 强；副词 tremendously。

ex.en: Working from home has become the norm in many companies.
ex.zh: 居家办公在许多公司已成为常态。

words.note: 表常态常用 the norm；复数 norms 指规范。

words.cn: 使冷凝；使凝结；浓缩；压缩；简缩

ex.en: She managed to condense the whole report into two pages.
ex.zh: 她成功地把整份报告压缩成了两页。

words.note: 指压缩文字或使冷凝；condensed milk 是炼乳。

ex.en: The report gave fresh impetus to the debate on climate policy.
ex.zh: 这份报告为气候政策辩论注入了新动力。

words.note: 常用 give impetus to sth，或 the impetus for。

ex.en: The decision to close the library caused great indignation among residents.
ex.zh: 关闭图书馆的决定引起了居民的极大愤慨。

words.note: 比 anger 正式，指因不公而生的义愤。

words.cn: 栅栏；检票口；屏障；障碍；隔阂

ex.en: Language can be a serious barrier to communication at work.
ex.zh: 在工作中，语言可能成为沟通的严重障碍。

words.note: 搭配 barrier to sth；break down barriers 指消除隔阂。

words.cn: 现实的；实际可行的；现实主义的；逼真的

ex.en: We need to set realistic goals for the coming year.
ex.zh: 我们需要为来年设定现实可行的目标。

words.note: 指现实可行或逼真；反义 unrealistic。

words.cn: 使转向；使改道；转移；转移…的注意力；使娱乐；使消遣

ex.en: The police diverted traffic away from the flooded road.
ex.zh: 警察把车辆从被淹的道路上引开。

words.note: 指改道或转移注意力；divert attention from。

ex.en: His red coat made him conspicuous in the grey crowd.
ex.zh: 他的红外套使他在灰暗的人群中格外显眼。

words.note: 反义 inconspicuous；多指显眼、易被注意。

ex.en: He wrote short verses about the countryside where he grew up.
ex.zh: 他写了一些关于自己成长乡村的短诗。

words.note: 不可数指诗体，可数指诗句；与 prose 相对。

words.cn: 犯罪的；刑事的；犯人；罪犯；刑事犯

ex.en: He has a criminal record and cannot enter the country.
ex.zh: 他有犯罪记录，不能入境。

words.note: 注意 criminal law 是刑法；名词指罪犯。

words.cn: 狂怒的；暴怒的；强烈的；激烈的

ex.en: She was furious with her brother for losing the keys.
ex.zh: 她因弟弟丢了钥匙而对他大发脾气。

words.note: be furious with sb about sth；名词 fury。

ex.en: Childhood obesity has become a serious public health problem.
ex.zh: 儿童肥胖已成为严重的公共健康问题。

words.note: 形容词 obese；正式医学用语，慎用 fat。

words.cn: 晒成棕褐色；使晒成棕褐色；硝制；棕褐色；棕黄色；晒成棕褐色；晒黑

ex.en: She spent two weeks on the beach and came back with a tan.
ex.zh: 她在海滩待了两周，回来时晒黑了。

words.note: 作动词指晒黑或鞣革；get a tan 指晒黑。

words.cn: 个别的；独特的；个人；个体

ex.en: The course is designed to meet the needs of individual students.
ex.zh: 这门课程旨在满足个别学生的需求。

words.note: 作形容词指个别的、独特的；作名词指个人。

ex.en: He put the documents in his briefcase and left the office.
ex.zh: 他把文件放进公文包，然后离开了办公室。

words.note: 由 brief（摘要）+ case（箱）构成。

ex.en: The noise from the building site is a real nuisance.
ex.zh: 工地的噪音真是讨厌。

words.note: make a nuisance of oneself 指惹人厌。

words.cn: 做好准备；振作精神；使防备；使受锻炼；支住；撑牢；使绷紧；支架；托架

ex.en: The residents braced themselves for the coming storm.
ex.zh: 居民们为即将到来的暴风雨做好了准备。

words.note: 常搭配 brace oneself for sth；也指支架、牙箍。

ex.en: Small budgets constrain what the school can offer students.
ex.zh: 预算有限限制了学校能为学生提供的条件。

words.note: 名词 constraint；be constrained by 表受限于。

words.cn: 轻快的；生气勃勃的；兴隆的；繁忙活跃的；寒冷而清新的

ex.en: A brisk walk before breakfast helps me stay awake all morning.
ex.zh: 早饭前快步走能让我一上午都清醒。

words.note: 常形容步伐轻快或生意兴隆；副词 briskly。

ex.en: The university has gained international prestige in recent years.
ex.zh: 这所大学近年来获得了国际声望。

words.note: 不可数，指因成就而得的威望；形容词 prestigious。

ex.en: Good insulation can cut heating bills by half.
ex.zh: 良好的隔热能把取暖费减少一半。

words.note: 由 insulate 变来，指隔热、绝缘。

ex.en: The electric cord was too short to reach the wall socket.
ex.zh: 电源线太短，够不到墙上的插座。

words.note: 指细绳、电线；注意与 chord（和弦）同音。

ex.en: The sudden noise startled the birds and they flew away.
ex.zh: 突然的响声惊动了鸟，它们飞走了。

words.note: 指使人突然受惊；形容词 startled 指受惊的。

words.cn: 暂时的；临时的；间歇；过渡期间

ex.en: The committee will publish an interim report before the final one.
ex.zh: 委员会将在最终报告之前发布一份中期报告。

words.note: in the interim 等于 meanwhile；也指过渡的。

ex.en: He was arrested for committing fraud against elderly customers.
ex.zh: 他因对老年客户实施诈骗而被捕。

words.note: 不可数指欺诈，可数指骗子；commit fraud。

ex.en: Her success is a testimony to the value of hard work.
ex.zh: 她的成功证明了努力工作的价值。

words.note: 法律语境指证词；a testimony to sth 表明证。

ex.en: The city council voted to build a new public library.
ex.zh: 市议会投票决定新建一座公共图书馆。

words.note: 注意与 counsel（建议、律师）区分。

ex.en: The two sides reaffirmed their commitment to the peace agreement.
ex.zh: 双方重申了对和平协议的承诺。

words.note: re-（再）+ affirm（断言），指再次确认立场。

words.cn: 实施；执行；强制；强迫；迫使

ex.en: Police officers have a duty to enforce traffic laws.
ex.zh: 警察有责任执行交通法规。

words.note: 指强制执行法律或规定；enforcement 指执行。

words.cn: 闪闪发光；闪耀；闪光；灿烂的光辉；耀眼；辉煌

ex.en: The Christmas tree glittered with hundreds of small lights.
ex.zh: 圣诞树上千百盏小灯闪闪发光。

words.note: 指闪光、闪耀；形容词 glittering 指闪亮的。

words.cn: 命中注定的；预定的；以…为目的地的

ex.en: He was destined to become one of the country's finest doctors.
ex.zh: 他注定会成为全国最优秀的医生之一。

words.note: be destined to do 或 be destined for sth。

ex.en: The report described years of political repression in the region.
ex.zh: 报告描述了该地区多年的政治压制。

words.note: 动词 repress；既指镇压，也指压抑情感。

words.cn: 易碎的；脆的；易损坏的；虚弱的；脆弱的

ex.en: The peace agreement remains fragile after months of fighting.
ex.zh: 经过数月战斗，和平协议依然脆弱。

words.note: 指易碎或脆弱，可形容物品、健康、和平。

ex.en: Drivers who ignore the rule will pay a heavy penalty.
ex.zh: 无视这条规定的司机将付出沉重的代价。

words.note: 指处罚、罚金；pay the penalty for 付出代价。

ex.en: She studied sociology and later worked for a social research group.
ex.zh: 她学的是社会学，后来在一家社会研究机构工作。

words.note: socio-（社会）+ -logy（学科）；形容词 sociological。

words.cn: 流放；流亡；被流放者；流亡国外者；流放；放逐；使流亡

ex.en: The writer spent ten years in exile before returning home.
ex.zh: 这位作家流亡十年后才回到家乡。

words.note: in exile 表流亡状态；be exiled from 指被流放。

words.cn: 大小；规模；等级；级别；天平；磅秤；比例；刻度；标度；鳞；攀登；爬越

ex.en: The project was carried out on a much larger scale than planned.
ex.zh: 这个项目的实施规模比计划大得多。

words.note: on a large scale 是常用短语；也指秤的刻度。

ex.en: The new stadium is a gigantic structure that can hold sixty thousand fans.
ex.zh: 新体育场是一座可容纳六万名观众的巨型建筑。

words.note: gigantic 由 giant（巨人）加 -ic 构成，比 huge 更夸张。

words.cn: 与其他不同的；清楚的；明确的

ex.en: Her writing style is quite distinct from that of her sister.
ex.zh: 她的写作风格与她姐姐的截然不同。

words.note: distinct 常与 from 连用，强调区别；distinctive 强调特色。

ex.en: Thick vegetation covered the hillside soon after the rainy season began.
ex.zh: 雨季开始后不久，茂密的植被就覆盖了山坡。

words.note: vegetation 是不可数名词，指一地草木总称；单株植物用 plant。

words.cn: 恢复；痊愈；追回；寻回；收复

ex.en: Doctors say she will make a full recovery within a few weeks.
ex.zh: 医生说她在几周内就能完全康复。

words.note: recovery 后接 from 表示从…中恢复；动词 recover 比名词少个 -y。

ex.en: He studied geology at university and now works for an oil company.
ex.zh: 他在大学学地质学，现在为一家石油公司工作。

words.note: geo- 表示地球，-logy 表示学科，geology 即研究地球的学问。

words.cn: 举起；升起；吊起；起重器械；举起；升起；吊起

ex.en: The workers used a crane to hoist the steel beams into place.
ex.zh: 工人们用起重机把钢梁吊装到位。

words.note: hoist 强调用绳索或机械向上吊起，比 raise 更具体。

ex.en: Few people were aware of the risks involved in the project.
ex.zh: 很少有人意识到这个项目涉及的风险。

words.note: aware 只作表语，常用 be aware of 或 that 从句。

ex.en: She bought a quart of milk and a loaf of bread on her way home.
ex.zh: 她在回家路上买了一夸脱牛奶和一条面包。

words.note: quart 是容量单位，一夸脱约合 0.95 升，多见于美式用法。

words.cn: 数字的；用数字表示的；数值的

ex.en: The report presents the results in both numerical and written form.
ex.zh: 报告以数字和文字两种形式呈现结果。

words.note: numerical 修饰数据或顺序；in numerical order 意为按数字顺序。

words.cn: 一瘸一拐地走；蹒跚；软弱的；无生气的；无精神的；软的；松沓的；跛行

ex.en: He limped off the field after twisting his ankle in the second half.
ex.zh: 下半场扭伤脚踝后，他一瘸一拐地走下球场。

words.note: limp 作动词指跛行，作形容词指松软无力，区别于 lame。

ex.en: Airport security has been tightened since the new rules took effect.
ex.zh: 新规定生效以来，机场安检更加严格。

words.note: security 指安全措施或保障；复数 securities 常指证券。

words.cn: 奖；奖品；判定；授予；给予；判给；裁定

ex.en: The young scientist was awarded a prize for her research on batteries.
ex.zh: 这位年轻科学家因电池研究获奖。

words.note: award 可接双宾语：award sb sth，即授给某人某物。

words.cn: 猛然弓背跃起；美元；澳元；雄鹿；雄兔

ex.en: He took a part-time job to make a few extra bucks during the summer.
ex.zh: 他夏天做兼职，想多挣几个钱。

words.note: buck 在美式口语中指美元，make a buck 意为谋生赚钱。

words.cn: 有条件被选中的；合适的；合意的

ex.en: Only students who have finished the course are eligible for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 只有修完课程的学生才有资格申请奖学金。

words.note: eligible 后常接 for 或 to do；反义词是 ineligible。

words.cn: 惊恐；忧虑；警报；使惊恐；使担心

ex.en: The fire alarm went off at midnight and everyone left the building.
ex.zh: 火警警报在午夜响起，所有人都撤出了大楼。

words.note: alarm 指警报或警报器；raise the alarm 意为发出警报。

words.cn: 虚弱的；衰弱的；无力的；无效的；无益的

ex.en: The patient was too feeble to walk without help after the operation.
ex.zh: 手术后病人太虚弱，无人搀扶就走不了路。

words.note: feeble 常形容人、声音或借口，比 weak 更带贬义。

ex.en: The manager gives each employee an annual performance appraisal in December.
ex.zh: 经理每年十二月对每位员工做绩效评估。

words.note: appraisal 多用于正式评估或估价，动词是 appraise。

ex.en: Continual interruptions made it hard for her to finish the report.
ex.zh: 不断的打扰使她难以完成报告。

words.note: continual 指反复发生；continuous 指不间断连续，勿混用。

ex.en: She grows herbs and vegetables in a small garden behind the house.
ex.zh: 她在屋后的小园子里种香草和蔬菜。

words.note: herb 指香草或药草；英式读音 h 不发音，美式要读出 h。

ex.en: Her latest book is written in simple prose that anyone can enjoy.
ex.zh: 她的新书用平实的散文写成，人人都能读懂。

words.note: prose 是不可数名词，与 verse（诗歌）相对而言。

ex.en: The climber fell and hurt his limbs, but he refused to give up.
ex.zh: 攀登者摔下来伤了四肢，但仍拒绝放弃。

words.note: limb 可指四肢，也可指大树枝；out on a limb 指孤立无援。

words.cn: 方向；目标；方位；熟悉情况；适应；情况介绍

ex.en: New students attend a week-long orientation before classes officially begin.
ex.zh: 正式开课前，新生要参加为期一周的入学介绍。

words.note: orientation 指方向、定位或迎新介绍；动词 orient 意为使适应。

words.cn: 茶点；点心；恢复；精神爽快

ex.en: Light refreshments were served after the lecture in the hall.
ex.zh: 讲座结束后，大厅里供应了简单茶点。

words.note: refreshments 指活动上的茶点，表示此义时常用复数。

ex.en: After months of practice, she spoke English with real confidence at the meeting.
ex.zh: 练习几个月后，她在会上自信地讲英语。

words.note: confidence 后接 in 表示对…有信心；形容词是 confident。

ex.en: Critics say the new tax rules are arbitrary and unfair to small firms.
ex.zh: 批评者说新税法武断，对小公司不公平。

words.note: arbitrary 强调凭个人意愿、缺乏依据；名词是 arbitrariness。

words.cn: 专心的；专注的；急切的；意图；意向；目的

ex.en: She was so intent on her work that she forgot to eat lunch.
ex.zh: 她太专注于工作，连午饭都忘了吃。

words.note: be intent on doing 意为专心做某事；intent 作名词指意图。

ex.en: Students should take part in class discussions instead of remaining passive.
ex.zh: 学生应参与课堂讨论，而不是一直被动听讲。

words.note: passive 与 active 相对；passive voice 指被动语态。

ex.en: Farmers here use less chemical fertilizer to protect the local river.
ex.zh: 这里的农民少用化肥，以保护当地的河流。

words.note: fertilizer 由 fertile（肥沃的）加 -ize、-er 构成，指肥料。

ex.en: Sales in May rose by ten percent compared with the corresponding month last year.
ex.zh: 与去年同期相比，五月份销售额增长了百分之十。

words.note: corresponding 表示相对应的；correspond 作动词指相符或通信。

ex.en: The witness took an oath to tell the truth before giving evidence.
ex.zh: 证人在作证前宣誓说实话。

words.note: oath 常用 take an oath；under oath 指已宣誓作证。

ex.en: The company issued a short statement in response to the complaints.
ex.zh: 公司针对这些投诉发表了一份简短声明。

words.note: in response to 是固定搭配，后接名词；动词 respond 也要接 to。

ex.en: The two countries signed a peace treaty after years of difficult talks.
ex.zh: 经过多年艰难谈判，两国签署了和平条约。

words.note: treaty 指国家间的正式条约，比 agreement 更正式。

ex.en: She faced her long illness with dignity and never complained in public.
ex.zh: 她从容面对久病，从不在公开场合抱怨。

words.note: dignity 常与 with 连用；形容词 dignified 意为庄重的。

words.cn: 挑战；邀请比赛；艰巨的任务；怀疑；质问；反对；公然反抗；向…挑战；对…质疑

ex.en: Rising costs are the biggest challenge facing small businesses this year.
ex.zh: 成本上升是今年小企业面临的最大挑战。

words.note: challenge 作动词直接跟宾语，不说 challenge against sb。

words.cn: 竞争的；对抗的；竞争对手；敌手；可与匹敌的人；与…竞争；与…匹敌；比得上

ex.en: The two rival companies have been competing for the same customers for years.
ex.zh: 这两家竞争公司多年来争夺同一批客户。

words.note: rival 可作名词、形容词和动词；rival sb 意为比得上某人。

essays.en: It is not until we lose our health that we realize how precious it is.
essays.zh: 直到失去健康，我们才意识到它有多么宝贵。
essays.usage: 强调句 not until，适合开头点题或结尾警示

essays.en: Only by stepping out of our comfort zone can we discover how much potential we really have.
essays.zh: 只有走出舒适区，我们才能发现自己真正的潜力有多大。
essays.usage: Only by 倒装，适合论证段或结尾鼓劲

essays.en: There is no denying that technology has brought us convenience, but it has also quietly taken away our patience.
essays.zh: 不可否认，科技给我们带来了便利，但它也悄然带走了我们的耐心。
essays.usage: 让步转折，科技类作文万能开头

essays.en: What matters most in learning is not how much we memorize, but how well we can apply it.
essays.zh: 学习中最重要的不是记住多少，而是能多好地运用。
essays.usage: not...but...，适合论述学习方法

essays.en: As the saying goes, "Rome was not built in a day," and neither is any meaningful achievement.
essays.zh: 俗话说“罗马不是一天建成的”，任何有意义的成就也是如此。
essays.usage: 引言 + 递进，适合坚持类论证

essays.en: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, the line between human creativity and machine efficiency is becoming blurred.
essays.zh: 随着人工智能的快速发展，人类创造力与机器效率之间的界线正变得模糊。
essays.usage: With 结构开头，AI 话题快速切入

essays.en: While enjoying the convenience of the digital age, we should also stay alert to the risk of losing our privacy.
essays.zh: 在享受数字时代便利的同时，我们也应对隐私流失的风险保持警惕。
essays.usage: While doing 让步，双刃剑型论证

essays.en: Compared with material wealth, inner peace is far more difficult to obtain and far more worth pursuing.
essays.zh: 与物质财富相比，内心的平静更难获得，也更值得追求。
essays.usage: Compared with 比较，价值观类结尾

essays.en: It goes without saying that reading broadens our horizons and enriches our inner world.
essays.zh: 毋庸置疑，阅读开阔我们的视野，丰富我们的内心世界。
essays.usage: 万能论点句，阅读类作文开头

essays.en: Were it not for the support of my teachers, I would never have come this far.
essays.zh: 如果没有老师们的支持，我绝不可能走到今天。
essays.usage: 虚拟条件倒装，适合感恩 / 记叙结合

essays.en: Not only does volunteering help those in need, but it also gives us a sense of purpose.
essays.zh: 志愿服务不仅帮助了需要帮助的人，也让我们找到了意义感。
essays.usage: Not only 部分倒装 + 递进，公益类

essays.en: What deserves our attention is that many young people are sacrificing sleep for short-term productivity.
essays.zh: 值得我们注意的是，许多年轻人正在用睡眠换取短期效率。
essays.usage: What deserves our attention，现象类开头

essays.en: Faced with fierce competition, graduates are supposed to improve their practical skills rather than merely collect certificates.
essays.zh: 面对激烈竞争，毕业生应提升实践能力，而不是仅仅收集证书。
essays.usage: Faced with 分词状语，就业类论证

essays.en: There is a growing awareness that environmental protection is not a burden but an investment in our future.
essays.zh: 越来越多人意识到，环保不是负担，而是对未来的投资。
essays.usage: There is a growing awareness，环保类开头

essays.en: It is high time that we took concrete action to reduce plastic waste instead of merely talking about it.
essays.zh: 我们该采取切实行动减少塑料垃圾了，而不是仅仅谈论它。
essays.usage: It is high time + 过去式，结尾呼吁

essays.en: Nothing is more rewarding than watching a child's eyes light up when he finally understands something.
essays.zh: 没有什么比看到一个孩子终于弄懂问题时眼睛发亮更让人欣慰的了。
essays.usage: Nothing is more...，教育价值类

essays.en: The more we communicate face to face, the less we rely on screens to express our feelings.
essays.zh: 我们越面对面交流，就越不依赖屏幕表达情感。
essays.usage: the more...the more，对比论证

essays.en: Instead of complaining about the unfairness of life, we had better ask ourselves what we can change.
essays.zh: 与其抱怨生活的不公，不如问问自己能改变什么。
essays.usage: Instead of 对比，心态 / 行动类

essays.en: A person who never fails has probably never tried anything difficult.
essays.zh: 一个从未失败过的人，大概从未尝试过困难的事。
essays.usage: 定语从句，失败话题反证

essays.en: Failure is not the opposite of success; it is part of success.
essays.zh: 失败不是成功的对立面，而是成功的一部分。
essays.usage: 短句对比，结尾金句

essays.en: It is our choices, rather than our abilities, that shape who we are.
essays.zh: 塑造我们的，是我们的选择，而不是我们的能力。
essays.usage: 强调句 + rather than，价值观类

essays.en: Although the road to success is long and bumpy, every small step counts.
essays.zh: 尽管通往成功的路漫长而崎岖，但每一小步都有意义。
essays.usage: Although 让步，结尾鼓励

essays.en: Cultural heritage is not a relic to be locked in museums, but a living tradition to be passed on.
essays.zh: 文化遗产不是锁在博物馆里的遗物，而是需要传承的活的传统。
essays.usage: not...but... 并列结构，文化类

essays.en: It would be a pity if traditional festivals were reduced to shopping promotions.
essays.zh: 如果传统节日被简化成购物促销，那将是一种遗憾。
essays.usage: 虚拟语气，传统节日类评述

essays.en: Chinese calligraphy teaches us that beauty grows out of patience and practice.
essays.zh: 中国书法告诉我们，美源自耐心与练习。
essays.usage: that 从句做宾语，文化类举例

essays.en: Globalization does not mean the loss of local identity; it means a dialogue between cultures.
essays.zh: 全球化不意味着本土身份的丧失，而意味着文化间的对话。
essays.usage: 分号对比，全球化论证

essays.en: Learning a foreign language is more than memorizing words; it is learning to see the world through another pair of eyes.
essays.zh: 学外语不只是记单词，而是学会用另一双眼睛看世界。
essays.usage: more than 结构，语言学习类

essays.en: Critical thinking enables us to question what we are told instead of accepting it blindly.
essays.zh: 批判性思维让我们能质疑被告知的东西，而不是盲目接受。
essays.usage: enables us to，教育目标类

essays.en: It is essential for schools to teach students how to think rather than what to think.
essays.zh: 学校教学生如何思考，而不是思考什么，这一点至关重要。
essays.usage: It is essential for...to，教育观点

essays.en: Cooperation is not about doing the same thing; it is about combining different strengths.
essays.zh: 合作不是做同样的事，而是把不同的长处结合起来。
essays.usage: 对比定义，合作类

essays.en: A team without trust is like a ship without a compass.
essays.zh: 没有信任的团队，就像没有指南针的船。
essays.usage: 比喻句，团队话题段首

essays.en: Self-discipline, in the long run, is a form of self-respect.
essays.zh: 从长远看，自律是一种自尊。
essays.usage: 插入语，自律类结尾

essays.en: Time is the only currency that cannot be earned back once spent.
essays.zh: 时间是唯一一种一旦花掉就再也赚不回来的货币。
essays.usage: 定语从句 + 比喻，时间管理类

essays.en: Managing time well is not about doing more, but about choosing what matters most.
essays.zh: 管理好时间不是做更多的事，而是选择最重要的事。
essays.usage: not about...but about，方法类论证

essays.en: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
essays.zh: 预测未来最好的办法，就是去创造它。
essays.usage: 短句金句，结尾升华万能句

essays.en: Innovation rarely comes from comfort; it comes from the courage to ask "why not?"
essays.zh: 创新很少产生于安逸，而来自敢于问“为什么不行”的勇气。
essays.usage: 分号对比 + 引号，创新类

essays.en: Our generation is expected to turn challenges into opportunities.
essays.zh: 我们这一代被期待把挑战转化为机遇。
essays.usage: be expected to，青年责任类

essays.en: Youth is not a period of life but a state of mind.
essays.zh: 青春不是人生的一个阶段，而是一种心境。
essays.usage: not...but...，青年话题结尾

essays.en: Honesty may cost us in the short term, but it pays off in the long run.
essays.zh: 诚实短期内可能让我们付出代价，但长远来看是值得的。
essays.usage: 短长期对比，诚信类

essays.en: Trust is easy to break and hard to rebuild.
essays.zh: 信任易碎，且难以重建。
essays.usage: 对称短句，诚信类收尾

essays.en: Mental health deserves the same attention as physical health.
essays.zh: 心理健康值得与身体健康同等的重视。
essays.usage: deserves the same...as，心理健康类

essays.en: Asking for help is a sign of strength, not weakness.
essays.zh: 求助是坚强的表现，而非软弱。
essays.usage: 对比短句，心理 / 成长类

essays.en: Small acts of kindness can brighten someone's entire day.
essays.zh: 小小的善举也能照亮别人的一整天。
essays.usage: 日常善意类，适合举例段

essays.en: Volunteer work reminds us that we are part of something larger than ourselves.
essays.zh: 志愿服务提醒我们，我们属于比自己更大的事物。
essays.usage: that 从句，公益类论证

essays.en: Both cities and villages have their own charm, and neither should be sacrificed for the other.
essays.zh: 城市与乡村各有魅力，不应为了一方牺牲另一方。
essays.usage: neither...，城乡类平衡观点

essays.en: Urbanization should not come at the price of disappearing villages.
essays.zh: 城镇化不应以乡村消失为代价。
essays.usage: at the price of，城乡 / 发展类

essays.en: The family is where we learn our first lessons about love and responsibility.
essays.zh: 家庭是我们学习爱与责任的第一课堂。
essays.usage: where 定语从句，家庭类

essays.en: Spare-time education is not just about grades; it is about discovering who our children are.
essays.zh: 课外教育不只关乎成绩，更关乎发现孩子是谁。
essays.usage: 分号对比，“双减”类话题

essays.en: Consumerism tells us to buy happiness, but experience tells us to build it.
essays.zh: 消费主义告诉我们要买幸福，而经验告诉我们要去构建幸福。
essays.usage: 对称对比，消费观类

essays.en: Spending money wisely is a skill that schools rarely teach.
essays.zh: 理性花钱是一门学校很少教的技能。
essays.usage: 定语从句，理财类

essays.en: An aging society calls for both respect for the elderly and better public services.
essays.zh: 老龄化社会既需要对老年人的尊重，也需要更好的公共服务。
essays.usage: calls for both...and，老龄化类

essays.en: Every senior citizen carries a chapter of history that deserves to be heard.
essays.zh: 每一位老人都带着一段值得被倾听的历史。
essays.usage: 定语从句，情感升华

essays.en: Data has become the new oil, and our privacy is the price we may be paying for it.
essays.zh: 数据已成为新的石油，而我们的隐私可能是为此付出的代价。
essays.usage: 比喻 + 定语从句，数据隐私类

essays.en: Social media connects us to the world, yet it may disconnect us from the people beside us.
essays.zh: 社交媒体把我们与世界连接起来，却可能让我们与身边的人疏远。
essays.usage: yet 转折对称，社交媒体类

essays.en: The internet gives everyone a voice, but not everyone uses it responsibly.
essays.zh: 互联网给了每个人发声的机会，但并非每个人都负责任地使用它。
essays.usage: 转折，网络素养类

essays.en: We should treat information on the internet with the same caution as we treat unknown food.
essays.zh: 我们应对网络信息保持像对待陌生食物一样的谨慎。
essays.usage: the same...as 比喻，信息素养类

essays.en: Reading is a conversation with the wisest minds of the past.
essays.zh: 阅读是与历史上最智慧的头脑对话。
essays.usage: 比喻定义，阅读类开头

essays.en: Books are the quiet teachers that never scold us for being slow.
essays.zh: 书是安静的老师，从不因我们学得慢而责备我们。
essays.usage: 比喻 + 定语从句，阅读类

essays.en: Exercise is not a waste of study time; it is what makes study time effective.
essays.zh: 锻炼不是浪费学习时间，而是让学习时间有效的关键。
essays.usage: what 从句，健康 / 学习平衡

essays.en: Sleep is not a luxury but a necessity for a sharp mind.
essays.zh: 睡眠不是奢侈品，而是保持头脑敏锐的必需品。
essays.usage: not...but，睡眠话题

essays.en: The beauty of nature is not something we own, but something we borrow from our children.
essays.zh: 自然之美不属于我们，而是我们从子孙那里借来的。
essays.usage: not...but + 比喻，环保升华

essays.en: Green development means meeting today's needs without robbing tomorrow of its chances.
essays.zh: 绿色发展意味着满足今天的需求，而不剥夺明天的机会。
essays.usage: without doing，可持续发展类

essays.en: Technology is a good servant but a bad master.
essays.zh: 科技是好的仆人，却是坏的主人。
essays.usage: 经典对称句，科技类结尾

essays.en: AI can imitate answers, but it cannot imitate the curiosity that produces questions.
essays.zh: 人工智能可以模仿答案，却无法模仿产生问题的好奇心。
essays.usage: but 转折，AI 与人文类

essays.en: What machines cannot replace is our ability to care.
essays.zh: 机器无法取代的，是我们关怀他人的能力。
essays.usage: What 从句主语，AI 类升华

essays.en: The gap between what we know and what we do is where most problems lie.
essays.zh: 知道与做到之间的差距，正是大多数问题之所在。
essays.usage: where 表语从句，知行合一类

essays.en: Good habits are hard to build and easy to lose, while bad habits are the opposite.
essays.zh: 好习惯难养成、易失去，坏习惯则恰恰相反。
essays.usage: while 对比，习惯类

essays.en: Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
essays.zh: 我们最大的荣耀不在于从不跌倒，而在于每次跌倒后都能站起来。
essays.usage: 名言式结尾，失败 / 坚持

essays.en: If we want a better world, we must begin by being better people.
essays.zh: 如果我们想要一个更好的世界，就必须从成为更好的人开始。
essays.usage: If 条件 + 递进，责任类

essays.en: A responsible citizen is one who does the right thing even when nobody is watching.
essays.zh: 负责任的公民，是即使无人旁观也会做正确之事的人。
essays.usage: 定语从句，责任类论证

essays.en: Listening is often more powerful than speaking.
essays.zh: 倾听往往比诉说更有力量。
essays.usage: 短句对比，沟通类

essays.en: Understanding begins the moment we stop assuming.
essays.zh: 理解始于我们停止臆断的那一刻。
essays.usage: the moment 引导时间状语，沟通类

essays.en: Goals without deadlines are merely wishes.
essays.zh: 没有期限的目标，不过是愿望而已。
essays.usage: 短句判断，目标类

essays.en: Progress is measured not by speed but by direction.
essays.zh: 衡量进步的标准不是速度，而是方向。
essays.usage: not by...but by，目标类

essays.en: It is better to light a candle than to curse the darkness.
essays.zh: 点亮一支蜡烛，胜过诅咒黑暗。
essays.usage: It is better to...than to，行动类结尾

essays.en: A country's strength lies not only in its economy but also in its culture.
essays.zh: 一个国家的力量不仅在于经济，也在于文化。
essays.usage: not only...but also，文化自信类

essays.en: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
essays.zh: 教育是你能用来改变世界的最有力武器。
essays.usage: 名言，教育类开头或结尾

essays.en: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
essays.zh: 未来属于那些相信梦想之美的人。
essays.usage: 名言式结尾，梦想 / 青年
